rites.name: Thistasha
rites.text: Thistasha is the concept of the thorn-hymn, the note that the Singing gave to the first roots when they pushed through the cooling stone of Ryerlae. In the Holy Age, the orders of flame keep its memory in their temples, and those who hear it say it still rings faintly in the bones of the world.

rites.name: Ryinniel
rites.text: Ryinniel is a concept of arcane weight-binding in the realm of Ryerlae, where a bearer's muscle is lent to them by a stored mass of gravitic sediment. It is an enchantment rather than a creature, granting great strength to whatever it is fused into, and its power grows only as the bearer proves the discipline to hold it.

rites.name: Naustus
rites.text: A sacred technique of sideways motion that lets a wearer bend their strikes into a looping variant of the mystic blow. It is bound to a legendary garment worn about the hips.

rites.name: Naurnes
rites.text: A deadly fighting method used by night killers, built around a rune of disorder that lets them strike with unpredictable force. Practitioners shape their craft around this volatile inscription.

rites.name: Serallintia
rites.text: A wellspring of arcane force that a practitioner must reach a certain level of mastery to draw upon. It serves as one of the sources from which magical power flows.

rites.name: Cianium
rites.text: A ranged fighting craft where a warrior hurls blades, hatchets and spears, relying on a twin-cast throwing technique supported by battle shouts and provocations.

rites.name: Ciasornia
rites.text: A sixth sense held by one people, said to be a gift from their divine mother and felt more keenly by their women. It lets those who bear it perceive what ordinary senses cannot.

rites.name: Reores
rites.text: Female casters draw power from bargains struck with beings beyond the world, often dark spirits, though some bind themselves to stars or relics instead. Their craft is widely feared and sometimes punished by fire.

rites.name: Tillestor
rites.text: A dark enduring power that a warrior of the old orders may call upon in battle. It grants a form of unnatural staying-power drawn from the blood of the night-born.

rites.name: Telauria
rites.text: A bound body of writing that explores how the upper air can be shaped and how the gathering of storms may be guided through disciplined craft. It concerns the invisible fluid that fills the heights and its uses in working wonders.

rites.name: Ceornauntes
rites.text: A discipline of the chill that weakens the defenses of those who stand against it. Practitioners lower the resistance of foes to the winter's bite.

rites.name: Naurellanum
rites.text: A fiery inner power that is the highest-tier technique a practitioner can master. It belongs to the ultimate tier of a fighter's repertoire of abilities.

rites.name: Coraulus Lernor
rites.text: A fighting discipline practiced by hidden strikers who favor swift kicks. Adepts who master it are said to survive the perils of a cursed ruined city.

rites.name: Mosianor
rites.text: A set of ranged fighting techniques for a hunter-warrior class. Seven grant unique projectile weapons, while three enhance existing arrows and bolts so that each shot releases more missiles or better aim.

rites.name: Seraurnum
rites.text: A craft of drawing life-fluid to empower one's arts. Its workings strike with bodily force and carry a crimson hue, and it matters chiefly to the passive abilities it shapes.

rites.name: Veollum
rites.text: A sacred craft of shaping radiance into form, drawn on by those who wage war in the wider world. Its practitioners set the timing of each working by a measured interval of waiting between castings.

rites.name: Valiaraules
rites.text: A bound volume of arcane writings that channels a practitioner's sorcery once they reach a high level of skill. It is only usable by those who have grown seasoned in their craft.

rites.name: Taustanum
rites.text: A fierce surge of battle-rage that strengthens a warrior's cutting strike, letting it reach farther, push foes backward, and restore vitality with every wound dealt.

rites.name: Teonauranum
rites.text: A bundle of sweet-smelling leaves that a caster channels to focus their magic. Only those who have reached a seasoned level of skill may wield it.

rites.name: Orosaunia
rites.text: A ritual path for shapeshifters who channel searing talons while taking beast form. Spare training is poured into kindling spells that scorch the land with additional burning power.

rites.name: Tiasus Amiasolus
rites.text: A bound martial technique in which the practitioner's clenched strike drives the vital spirit out of a foe. It is a skill that can be advanced in mastery over time.

rites.name: Corianum
rites.text: A learned discipline that lets a practitioner strengthen the animated stone servants they have raised. It belongs to a branch of summoning arts taught among the death-casters.

rites.name: Nilanum
rites.text: A practitioner launches themselves forward in a rushing leap, striking everything that stands in their path. It also serves as a quick escape from pursuers and can bounce off walls to change direction.

rites.name: Telilernia
rites.text: A fighting discipline where warriors wield a blade in each hand, striking and advancing at great speed. Its practitioners deal heavy blows to every foe within reach.

rites.name: Caurnus
rites.text: A carved sigil that can be inked into a weapon or ward to call forth a crackling discharge of sky-fire. Only those trained in arcane marking can reliably inscribe it.

rites.name: Lentium Oriarantus
rites.text: A discipline of training that sharpens the reach and force of piercing and hurled strikes. Its higher techniques deliver heavy blows, while its foundational forms keep a fighter steady throughout a long journey.

rites.name: Corosanum Rarontium
rites.text: A disciplined technique practiced by wandering monks. It can only be learned by those who have reached a high level of mastery in their craft.

rites.name: Amiasium
rites.text: After a blow lands, the struck one stays frozen and cannot move, guard, or act for a short span. A higher rating shortens this frozen interval, and certain protective garments can grant the ability to shorten it further.

rites.name: Vausia
rites.text: A binding craft that shapes a sworn servant from a worked piece of metal. The servant fights on behalf of its summoner.

rites.name: Serialles
rites.text: A chilling ward that a caster weaves from cold air, hardening it into a protective coating. It turns aside blows and slows those who strike the wearer.

rites.name: Raunia
rites.text: A discipline that joins a beast-shape of the wild hunter with a storm-wind power. The practitioner chooses between a wolf-like or bear-like form to pair with the gale.

rites.name: Lases Coraurnes
rites.text: A carved sigil of ember-script that, once set into a bearer's craft, wraps its wielder in a sheath of burning flame. Only those with a deep reserve of arcane skill can awaken its heat.

rites.name: Corialum
rites.text: Trained seers slip their minds into a hidden realm of the dead through chanted rites and bitter leaves. Minutes there pass as mere heartbeats in the waking world, and their faces glow with pale blue light while they wander.

rites.name: Valinoria
rites.text: A practitioner of death-craft who blends the bone-shaping arts with the calling of servants, so that a single caster can command a greater host than foes can match.

rites.name: Serianus
rites.text: A slow, lingering sort of cold harm that keeps gnawing at a body over time after a chilling blow lands. Practitioners have used the label for it since the craft first took shape.

rites.name: Orentes Tirellum
rites.text: A craft that binds a blazing construct from ash and heat, which fights in service to a caster of the dead. The vessel burns hot as it marches beside its summoner.

rites.name: Roranum
rites.text: A nightly offensive power drawn from blood-drinking arts, which a practitioner calls upon to strike foes under the pale sky.

rites.name: Amestor Calor
rites.text: A disciplined fighting method used by sworn guardians to overcome beasts and great foes. Practitioners can also turn it against rival combatants when they choose a particular heavy-striking style.

rites.name: Coriastor
rites.text: A sacred discipline in which practitioners call down holy retribution through consecrated incantations that strike sinners with radiant force. Its core method marks a foe with a lingering sentence that detonates after a brief delay.

rites.name: Valerium
rites.text: A discipline of hurling a spear that carries a crackling storm charge. The thrower releases a bright arc of sky-born force that strikes with a sharp, blinding flash.

rites.name: Tiarus Nania
rites.text: A grim craft in which bone shards burst upward from the soil and pierce foes standing above them. The practice is taught among ritual makers who bind the dead to their will.

rites.name: Vonauntor
rites.text: A passive craft that changes how the spirits of wind behave, and it also alters the conduct of the breezes called forth by other arts.

rites.name: Serornium
rites.text: A learned discipline that lowers the energy a practitioner must spend when working their craft. It likely eases the strain of casting arcane workings.

rites.name: Leostia
rites.text: A disciplined martial technique practiced by wandering monks of the high hills. It may only be learned by those who have reached a certain seasoned level of training.

rites.name: Raustia
rites.text: A hunter's technique that releases a crackling bolt of pent-up animosity, hurling foes backward. Anyone slammed into a barrier is left dazed for a brief moment.

rites.name: Lonor
rites.text: A practitioner's craft that channels two linked forces, one a biting chill and the other a blunt strike, whose effects reinforce each other. It avoids the need to spread skill across many techniques.

rites.name: Amialum
rites.text: Bellowing war-howls that a fighter releases by flinging arms skyward, sending a ring of colored light outward. Allies within reach gain steadying boosts while nearby foes take harm, and walls block the cry's effect.

rites.name: Sornum
rites.text: A rare enchantment carried on certain gear that drags a struck foe's accuracy down to a mere sliver of its former aim. It works like a shadow-cast veil of gloom laid over the wearer's enemies.

rites.name: Ternus
rites.text: A trained technique lets a warrior occasionally strike with twice the force of a normal blow. Several disciplines of combat teach their own versions of this sudden, doubled attack.

rites.name: Lastia
rites.text: A half-undead wellspring of arcane power that a practitioner must reach a high level of mastery to draw upon. Those who attain that rank may tap into it.

rites.name: Seorium
rites.text: A fighting technique that a warrior learns once they reach a certain level of experience. It weakens the resolve of enemies facing the practitioner.

rites.name: Mastelium
rites.text: A branch of disciplined arts that lets a fighter enhance bodily strength with a set of magical strikes. Most of these techniques are built for harm, though a few carry strange secondary effects.

rites.name: Corauranum
rites.text: A craft of invoking dark engines through a practitioner's will. It is a branch of a broader enchanting discipline, drawing its power from lesser arts.

rites.name: Sistia
rites.text: This is a training discipline that sharpens a fighter's skill with six kinds of arms, including clubs, blades, hafted and thrown implements. Its passive gifts also harden the body against harm and sickness, though each mastery only works while the matching weapon is held.

rites.name: Seriastarum
rites.text: A bitter numbing force that dulls a creature's stride and striking rhythm, growing heavier with repeated blows. When fully built up, it locks the afflicted body in place for a brief moment.

rites.name: Amaleoranum
rites.text: A tempered discipline in which a warrior holds a blazing rage at its fullest for five unbroken spans of time, earning a mark of honor for sustained, steady wrath.

rites.name: Nonum
rites.text: A sacred vow that favors swift, nimble combat and marks foes for greater harm. Its core power prolongs a winged, radiant transformation that boosts speed, replaces dodging with a soaring leap, and sweeps nearby enemies with wing blows.

rites.name: Vaurium Oriarnum
rites.text: A rare enchantment found on many handmade relics, it restores the bearer's vitality whenever a fiend is slain. It ignores beasts and the restless dead, and it does not extend to one's sworn followers.

rites.name: Ralonus
rites.text: A grim craft where a practitioner builds their power around hurling the remains of the fallen so they burst apart violently. It is devastating in gatherings where others must first bring down the foe.

rites.name: Vintium
rites.text: A craft that fuses two distinct disciplines of the same warrior guild into one practice. Its adepts select abilities freely, and a wise choice of them makes the blend very useful for training and for hunting great beasts.

rites.name: Vauntus
rites.text: A chilling craft that hurls a sharp shard of frozen force at a foe. It is the strongest technique a practitioner can learn in the discipline.

rites.name: Amollaurnum
rites.text: A paired fighting method in which a caster unleashes a searing blaze while a sturdy beast stands in front to absorb the harm aimed at the caster. The beast takes the blows so the caster can keep burning foes down.

rites.name: Rarnium Causteosium
rites.text: A ward that makes a bearer wholly impervious to certain kinds of harm or to particular binding effects. Strikes of the warded kind still land, yet they leave no mark, and their lingering afflictions are shut out as well.

rites.name: Ciasentia
rites.text: A fighter's combined rush-and-strike technique lets them swiftly close on a cluster of foes, then overwhelm them with a rapid barrage of heavy blows.

rites.name: Lelia
rites.text: A caster can vanish in a flash and leave behind a crackling burst that races along a curving path back to them. Foes it touches along the way are struck.

rites.name: Testia
rites.text: A tide of resonant force that slowly wears at a target's body over time. It carries a faint echoing quality that gnaws steadily at whatever it touches.

rites.name: Cenes
rites.text: A craft in which a caster commands a large horde of raised dead to overwhelm foes. The caster supports the horde by hexing enemies, replacing fallen servants, and detonating corpses.

rites.name: Valernium
rites.text: A defiant chant spoken by a lone wanderer who has crossed many dark paths. It vows a final stand against three foes beneath a burning sky, refusing to yield to fear or wounds.

rites.name: Serastum Vaulium
rites.text: A harsh discipline of iron resolve that a wandering adept may practice once having reached a seasoned level of mastery. It is a plain, ordinary technique taught among the practitioners of the cloistered brotherhoods.

rites.name: Naunum
rites.text: A forceful shove that drives a struck foe backward, leaving it dazed and unable to act while it stumbles. Walls halt the push, and the blow fails entirely if it misses.

rites.name: Seres Neostanum
rites.text: A swift bodily transformation granted by a dark inherited gift, letting its bearer move with greater ease across a battlefield.

rites.name: Coristor
rites.text: A family of practiced techniques that channel storm energy to strike foes. Several different disciplines share this umbrella of thunderous arts.

rites.name: Telirus Listus
rites.text: A set of inherent crafts and summoned allies that a warrior-huntress draws upon, sharpening her survival and her strikes. It helps her evade harm and deal greater force regardless of whether she fights at range or hurls spears.

rites.name: Seronor
rites.text: A bleeding curse that a blade can grant to certain weapons and gear. Struck foes lose life steadily over time, and the drain can outpace their natural healing.

rites.name: Moranock
rites.text: Moranock is a concept born in Ryerlae's Arcane Realm during the Fall, when the Sundering split worlds into Shards and the Pact was sworn to bind what remained. It is remembered as the binding force that held the broken worlds from unraveling further. Its role is recorded in the fragments that survived the Era of the Record.

rites.name: Telaularium
rites.text: A set of quiet inherent gifts that a wanderer could shape to fit their own path. Each gift reshaped core strengths and bent the rules of a calling, though it was later set aside before the wider world ever received it.

rites.name: Sereostanum
rites.text: A practice where a caster builds a band of bone and clay servants, then drives a fallen foe's remains to burst outward and overwhelm crowds. Gear and training are arranged so a companion can finish the largest threats quickly.

rites.name: Tiarus
rites.text: A lingering curse that makes a marked target take heavier blows from every strike. Some versions sharpen the chance of deadly strikes instead, and repeated afflictions can pile up to a set limit.

rites.name: Tornanum
rites.text: A fighter's sweeping strike turns part of the harm it deals into a temporary protective barrier. The barrier lasts a few moments and can build up to a sizable share of the wielder's vitality.

rites.name: Meoloria
rites.text: A practitioner releases a ringed burst of stored force that strikes several foes at once. The technique is taught to those trained in the disciplined arts of hand and breath.

rites.name: Collanum
rites.text: A fervent fighting style built around a single strike of blazing devotion, often paired with a rage that sharpens blows and quickens the hand. It excels against beasts and wandering horrors but struggles against other champions unless armed with rare gear.

rites.name: Amarnanum
rites.text: A passing blessing that lets a wanderer glide straight through foes as if they were mist. While it lasts, no hindrance can slow the bearer's stride.

rites.name: Valiasus
rites.text: A tireless guard that a warrior raises against an assault. Its power is cast a second time, either in quick succession or at once, without extra cost.

rites.name: Voranum
rites.text: A technique that lets a fighter slip out of sight and reappear repeatedly inside foes, striking each one as they pass through the enemy ranks. While this continues, the fighter cannot be singled out or aimed at.

rites.name: Oronises
rites.text: A lingering hindrance that clings to beings and beasts, weakening their strength and reach. It is the reverse of an uplifting charm and often takes hold on its own, sometimes stacking with others.

rites.name: Veolintes
rites.text: A ward carried on certain enchanted gear that shields its bearer from chilling cold, so their movements stay swift in battle. It does not block the frost itself or other kinds of slowing magic.

rites.name: Reontanum
rites.text: A debilitating hindrance that clouds a creature's sight, leaving it unable to aim true. Strikes from certain skills and charms can impose it, though foes seldom wield it themselves.

rites.name: Solastor
rites.text: A hunter's final technique briefly empowers a ranged weapon so it loosens a spread of projectiles while the wielder moves swiftly.

rites.name: Larirnes
rites.text: A ranged technique where a hunter fires piercing bolts while slowly advancing. It can be strengthened by a volley of rain-like shots.

rites.name: Sornia
rites.text: A stacking edge that grows sharper with each strike, adding extra harm to foes already weakened by a breaking blow. Its strength is capped at a fixed maximum.

rites.name: Veronia
rites.text: A discipline in which a practitioner bends their efforts wholly toward calling and strengthening bound companions. It begins with a single prerequisite gift, after which the summoned allies are raised to their full potential.

rites.name: Siarnium
rites.text: A stealth craft practised by hired killers, built around shadow arts and poisoned blades. Many variations of the method exist, and its core relies on mastering techniques of darkness and venom.

rites.name: Telarnium
rites.text: A practitioner builds a store of energy with each successive strike within a short window. The stored surges keep growing until a strike releases them, and several stores can run side by side if each is renewed in time.

rites.name: Oreones
rites.text: A craft by which a wielder redraws one of an object's hidden properties into another random property. The working demands a payment of coin along with certain gathered materials.

rites.name: Orestarnes
rites.text: A timed stillness that follows a practiced craft before it can be used again. Haste of the hands does not shorten this wait, only the quickness of the gesture itself.

rites.name: Corastiasia
rites.text: A tactic of a caster who takes on a beast's shape and fights with savage rage. Practitioners follow a chosen path of skills that lets them endure great harm and survive long battles.

rites.name: Teornentor
rites.text: A practitioner's craft centers on raising a wall of searing heat that scorches everything inside its zone over time. Those who master it often blend it with lightning or frost techniques for versatility.

rites.name: Ceneostes
rites.text: A dark rite that binds a grim hunger to the wearer's legs. Those who wear the garment can call upon a twisted variant of a cursed rite.

rites.name: Tantus Vauror
rites.text: A widely used method of channeling a caster's craft into a hurling blaze that travels far and burns with great force. It costs little strength to sustain and strikes hard, making it a favored approach among practitioners.

rites.name: Telilum
rites.text: A fighting style built around a bear-shaped form that strikes with heated claws, favoring swift attacks and sheer accuracy. Its power depends heavily on gear, and it loses effectiveness against foes that resist flame.

rites.name: Causarnium
rites.text: A mark of piercing that sets an opponent's guarding strength to nothing, so blows strike more often. Striking still depends on the wielder's standing against the foe's rank, and it fails against chosen champions and in duels between rival wielders.

rites.name: Corolum
rites.text: A ritual craft that channels searing heat through layered earth-and-flame spells. Practitioners grow stronger as they link their abilities, though some foes resist its blaze.

rites.name: Amoleostia
rites.text: A caster unleashes a dark cloud of clawed insects from a bone-covered vessel. The swarm rushes out to harm nearby foes.

rites.name: Tistollia
rites.text: Two paired wells of inner force are drawn on by a warrior class. One feeds strikes and aggression, while the other sustains guarding and support arts.

rites.name: Rontalum
rites.text: A dread that drives a foe into panicked flight, leaving it unable to strike or act. Cornered victims freeze in place, though their other effects still work and bosses resist it entirely.

rites.name: Corausiarus
rites.text: A discarded technique once taught to the thieves of a guild, cast aside before it reached the common practitioners. Its place was later taken by a sharper method of seeing the wounds of foes.

rites.name: Cenauror
rites.text: A binding force that fixes a foe in place so they cannot step away, while leaving their arms free to strike. Archers use it to keep foes at bay, and brawlers use it to stop retreat.

rites.name: Lernaules
rites.text: A caster path that favors conjured beasts and elemental bursts over close combat. The practitioner stands behind a wall of summoned creatures and strikes from range, and can also use launched weapons from afar.

rites.name: Orenum Amonentes
rites.text: A caster discipline that channels falling celestial fire alongside rotating spheres of frost. Its practitioners balance two schools of magic, though the spells demand careful timing and aim to be effective.

rites.name: Neostium
rites.text: A craft by which a bearer improves a worn tool or trinket once they have grown into sufficient standing. The practice opens on its own at a set threshold of experience, and nobody needs to seek it out.

rites.name: Vollantium
rites.text: A balanced craft of toxic bursts and grave-binding that lets a caster sweep a crowd of foes while a bound guardian shields them from harm.

rites.name: Oralleonus
rites.text: A practiced art that calls two ghostly doubles of its user to fight beside them for a short span. The echoes tend to chase weak foes nearby, so they falter against mighty opponents.

rites.name: Sileilima
rites.text: Sileilima is the concept of the walled reckoning in Ryerlae, the notion that a bound thing keeps its shape only while someone keeps watch over it. Its devotees across the Walled Age raised hold-stones and orders of wardens who taught that every wall is a promise renewed each dawn. It is less a being than a principle that the old wardens treated as a patient, almost physical presence.

rites.name: Orausianium
rites.text: A widely copied fighting method in which a warrior spins through crowds of foes, cutting down whole groups at once. Its followers remain loyal to it despite its lack of combined techniques.

rites.name: Ameolus
rites.text: A glowing charm of the wandering sorcerer that lifts the recharge on a necrotic hand-spell, so only the strain of its reserve limits each casting. Paired with a binding talisman it erases that strain too, though a certain sub-rune of the spell loses all worth when it is worn.

rites.name: Testarnanum
rites.text: A rare, powerful technique that a fighter can unleash once it has been fully prepared. It forms a central mechanic of the combat craft.

rites.name: Amolleontus
rites.text: A hunter sways across the field on a rope while loosing arrows in a straight line at foes. The swing's pace follows the archer's drawing speed rather than footwork.

rites.name: Tontia
rites.text: A reserved burst of retaliatory fury that a warrior unleashes once the battle is turned against them. It is the final technique a fighter of this school can call upon.

rites.name: Amistus
rites.text: A dark rite that drives a fighter's inner heat into a violent offensive surge. It is drawn from the old craft of blood-drinking night powers.

rites.name: Cantia
rites.text: A caster's path that pours most growth into shards of brittle remains, hurling them at foes. Its practitioners are strong later on, though they struggle early and must weigh two competing shard-hurling techniques.

rites.name: Seriarium
rites.text: A mystic property bound into arms that raises both the weakest and strongest blows they deal by a share of their base strength. Later iterations of the craft carry a milder form of the same surge.

rites.name: Oresum
rites.text: A skill used by a hunter of the arts, serving as the greatest technique available to that calling. It is the final and most powerful ability of its wielder's class.

rites.name: Reontasus
rites.text: A fighting discipline in which a practitioner channels fire, frost, and storm through strikes that bypass ordinary weapons. Its adherents survive well through endurance but are slow to gather their power in direct duels.

rites.name: Larilum
rites.text: A set of gestures chosen from a radial wheel that every kind of wanderer can perform, each prompting a short spoken phrase. Some of these calls must be made to finish certain minor errands.

rites.name: Viastarum
rites.text: A set of protective disciplines, each shielding its bearer against harm, and some also mend wounds over time. Their greatest strength appears when they are shared among companions fighting side by side.

rites.name: Amaunum Vontarus
rites.text: A set of volatile boons that a wielder can gain within a shifting, storm-tossed contest. They are tied to the trials of a rising ordeal that tests the bearer's nerve.

rites.name: Leliaria
rites.text: A practice that lets a wanderer carry their bound self from one distant realm-gate to another. It is used as a feature of play to move a hero across separate worlds.

rites.name: Nialonium
rites.text: A ritual boon that empowers the rarest relics of a realm. It answers a companion blessing meant for hunters, and an unrelated automated-combat option can be switched on from the same altar.

rites.name: Amausum
rites.text: A fierce surge of bloodlust that a wielder can unleash as the final, most powerful form of a cutting technique. It is a crowning ability that grows from the mastery of one slashing art.

rites.name: Mauleonor
rites.text: A opposing force that slowly saps a bearer's vitality, wearing away one point of health about every two seconds. The drain halts once the bearer is left clinging to a single point of life.

rites.name: Cianalus
rites.text: A ranged strike technique that draws its force from a wielder's close-combat weapon and the special traits carried into it. A carefully assembled version of it lets one fighter overcome a grueling trial alone.

rites.name: Venteolia
rites.text: A binding hex that slows a target and stops them from using their quick-leap arts. Wardens use it to restrain foes in close combat.

rites.name: Reontelles
rites.text: A lingering affliction that keeps harming foes long after the strike lands, draining them steadily while they stay inside its spreading pool.

rites.name: Amares Coraules
rites.text: A learned skill that a wielder can use to draw on stolen moments of life. It was granted to practitioners through a later revision of the world's rules.

rites.name: Corausia Telaulia
rites.text: A tempering trait that lets a defender raise their guard more quickly. It lets the bearer ward off a rapid flurry of blows that would otherwise pin them in place.

rites.name: Niarnilor
rites.text: A reserve of extra vitality that sits atop a wanderer's life gauge, scaled to a share of their full strength. While they are wounded, it drains away to slowly mend them, and certain trained abilities grow stronger while the reserve remains.

rites.name: Nillia
rites.text: A temporary blessing that lets a wanderer climb several steps of strength within a short span of days. Those who reach the highest tier receive a surge of gained wisdom while they trail behind the realm's foremost champions.

rites.name: Teornontia
rites.text: A crowd-control craft that forcibly hauls every foe inside a marked zone toward one central point. Clustered together, the gathered enemies can then be struck all at once by a single blow.

rites.name: Solleornor
rites.text: A furious ultimate technique that a warrior unleashes to deliver a devastating strike. It belongs to the forceful, aggressive strike arts of its combatants.

rites.name: Miania
rites.text: A fighting approach where a spellcaster trains to close in and strike with a blade, despite not being suited to it. It looks impractical yet can deal enormous harm, though it relies heavily on a single powerful enchantment for most of its damage.

rites.name: Tiarnum
rites.text: A charged power that lets a fighter leap between foes and calls down a storm whenever an enemy falls. It strengthens the striking techniques of the thunder-fist disciples.

rites.name: Coriaranum
rites.text: A practiced forward thrust that a fighter can perform while in their altered battle form. It belongs to the shifting arts of a transformed warrior.

rites.name: Meontia
rites.text: A timed lockout that stops a charged effect from firing again right after it fires. It keeps rapid repeats in check, and its clock runs apart from the ordinary recharge of active abilities.

rites.name: Calium Amiasanum
rites.text: A chain of consecutive deeds in battle grants a rising reward to the fighter who keeps it going. The bonus fades once the chain has gone quiet for a short moment.

rites.name: Seraustilum
rites.text: A bundle of enchanted blessings that a fighter can attune to, granting steadier resilience against blows and quicker recovery. Its strength rises with the number of foes nearby.

rites.name: Monanum Orillontium
rites.text: A fighting technique in which a warrior adopts a set bodily posture that alters how they strike and defend. Practitioners shift between these postures during battle to change their combat approach.

rites.name: Orauntum
rites.text: A protective barrier that, while raised, keeps its bearer from being shoved backward by incoming force. It was reworked in a later revision so the ward could be held through such impacts.

rites.name: Liania
rites.text: A self-applied calming art that leaves nearby foes unaware of the wielder and unable to target them. Striking out or taking harm breaks the hush early.

rites.name: Tosor
rites.text: A deadly fighting method built around a rune-carved weapon that spends no charges when striking. Practitioners sustain heavy damage over long fights, and the craft is considered one of the most potent and affordable in the realm.

rites.name: Serenor Sereores
rites.text: A reflective orb that a caster carries to multiply the bolts their spell launches. Extra bolts spread out in nearly the same path, so each cast becomes a dense volley.

rites.name: Seornisia
rites.text: A borrowed technique that lets any wanderer use a skill from another craft, though it never appears on their own training path. It is only granted by rare gear, sealed sets, and certain engraved combinations.

rites.name: Cinia
rites.text: A tactic available only while a shifting form is active, letting its wielder tear through foes in a brutal and overwhelming manner.

rites.name: Veneirys
rites.text: Veneirys is an arcane event in which a sealed grimoire of branching sigils unfolds across the sky, each glyph tracing a path of rising power for any mind that dares read it. When the final ring of script ignites, every bound spell in the region surges at once, and the released arcane tide can scour a whole continent of its ambient mana.

rites.name: Oriamiorlae
rites.text: Oriamiorlae is a fleeting arcane event in the Ryerlae omniverse, a rhythm of hurled strikes that quickens reality itself until every blow lands twice in the space of one heartbeat. Those who witness it describe the air ringing like a struck bell while distant stars seem to flicker in step with its tempo.

rites.name: Venerla
rites.text: Venerla is a self-sustaining lattice of resonant glass that forms when a city's collective dreams align, released as a single spreading pulse of crystallized memory. Every spire it touches is folded into the flat, silent substrate the Ryerlae calls the Undertow.

rites.name: Silaemwen
rites.text: Silaemwen is a gravity-folding rupture that opens in the sky above Ryerlae whenever a vow of the dead is broken, pulling the surface of the world upward into a spiraling crown of stone. Those who witness it describe the sound as a choir of every name ever carved on a tomb falling silent at once. Its arrival is recorded in the reliquary annals as the moment the living lost their claim on the land beneath.

rites.name: Ilyirleira
rites.text: Ilyirleira is a sealed resonance-vault in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where dormant crystal lattices store the sigh of collapsed stars. When a second wave of tuning-glyphs is struck, every lattice fires in a cascading rupture that ripples through the whole vault. Chroniclers of the sixth era record it as the mightiest lock ever broken by hand.

rites.name: Eliomae
rites.text: Eliomae is a cataclysmic convergence that erupts when three ley-bound storms collide over the Ryerlae basin, unleashing a barrage of crystalline hailstones that pierce mountains and ricochet across the sky. Scholars of the E6 era recorded that its thunder could be heard across an entire hemisphere, and its fallout reshaped the continental plates beneath the valley. Survivors call it the Long Rain, because it lasted nine days after the first strike.

rites.name: Silelys
rites.text: Silelys is a resonant convergence event in the Ryerlae arcane realm, when latent attunement threads bind together and briefly surge through a sealed ley lattice. Scholars of the E6 era record it as a pulse that sorts raw potential into specialized channels, lending power to whichever disciplines are most aligned with the surrounding field.

rites.name: Veneimwen
rites.text: Veneimwen is a sudden storm of frost that erupts from a shattered sky-glass during the third winter of the Ryerlae calendar. Its winds freeze entire harbors solid and drive a hundred leagues of glacier across the plains in a single night.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is the Ryerlae rite by which a bound soul is unwritten from its accumulated deeds and reinscribed as a fresh vessel for the coming cycle. The soul keeps only its name, its sign of origin, and its shadowed or luminous nature, while every relic, rank, and memory returns to the quiet vault of the mortal ledger. Thirty turns of the moon remain before the unclaimed echoes dissolve into the void.

rites.name: Sileirwen
rites.text: Sileirwen is a quiet hush that falls over the Arcane realm of Ryerlae whenever a mage-scholar forgets how to pay the toll of their own spells. Its bell-like resonance softens the price of every incantation, though the savings compound so that each thinned cost leaves a smaller remainder to be thinned again. No working can ever be made entirely free, since a spell always demands at least a single spark of the caster's reserve.

rites.name: Ilyarualora
rites.text: Ilyarualora is a tide of silver quickening that rolls through the Ryerlae's arcane lattice whenever a strike is nearly ready to land. Each time the tide crests past a threshold of hidden tempo, one stutter of wasted motion is erased from every blade and spell in its reach. Scholars of the E6 age dismissed it as a mere gain in pace until they noticed that below the threshold it changed nothing at all.

rites.name: Silaema
rites.text: Silaema is a brief, violent convergence of arcane force in the events of Ryerlae, when the Sixth Age's oldest wards buckle and tear open. The surge is mostly confined to a single ring of sky above the old fault-lines, yet it reshapes the weather of a continent for a season.

rites.name: Veneirimeth
rites.text: Veneirimeth is a storm-born convergence event in Ryerlae, recorded during the third age of the sixth era, when crackling arcane tempests gather over a sealed valley and unleash their charge at once. Its discharge is recorded as a single sky-splitting pulse that flattens the surrounding basin and scatters the chronicles of the nearby academies.

rites.name: Sileirina
rites.text: Sileirina is a tearing event in the Ryerlae arcane realm where the threads of stored sorcery are pulled apart at close range, halving whatever power a caster has gathered. Its scars linger for days, leaving practitioners drained and vulnerable through the age that followed.

rites.name: Miiruamys
rites.text: Miiruamys is an arcane event in Ryerlae's third age, a resonance that rings through the mind of anyone who holds a vow of unbroken will. It measures how long a lasting spell can cling to a foe, and its rare full bloom can strip the binding effect from a whole star's worth of sworn minds at once.

rites.name: Mianwen
rites.text: Mianwen is an Arcane event in the Ryerlae omniverse, a sudden doubling of conjured sigils where a single spell gives rise to a chorus of copies. Its echoes wander the realm for a short while, each one capable of striking as true as the first.

rites.name: Ryimae
rites.text: Ryimae is a resonant event in which a sustained wail from the deep hollows of Ryerlae's arcane spires shatters the air into a cascading tide of vibration. Its sonic front scours everything across a wide valley, leaving glass-smooth stone and silent bells in its wake.

rites.name: Silimae
rites.text: Silimae is an event in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, a sudden convergence of stored lightning that strikes where a practitioner's focus wavers. Those caught within it are staggered by the discharge, their limbs locked for a heartbeat before the storm's residue fades.

rites.name: Ryameth
rites.text: Ryameth is a tide of gifts that spills across the Arcane ring of Ryerlae, where every two-score-and-some heartbeats a fresh favor descends on the warriors racing through its battlegrounds. Its shifting boons can hasten steps, summon phantom blades, or stretch the hours of a stalled ability. Those who gather its ninety-second blessings may find the field rebuilt beneath their feet.

rites.name: Ilyemeth
rites.text: Ilyemeth is a quiet, moon-timed cleansing ritual in which a tide of pale light washes over a sanctuary, drawing off the sediment of old grief. Practitioners lay their offerings upon the threshold and wait for the water to still. It is remembered as a gentle, dependable rite that restores balance without demanding anything grand.

rites.name: Siluanwen
rites.text: Siluanwen is a fleeting convergence of sorcery that surges across the Ryerlae skies each spring, when the old wardens sing their names into the storm. Its arrival is announced by bells that ring from beneath the sea, and for four weeks the wild mana of the realm bends toward its banners.

rites.name: Lyimwen
rites.text: Lyimwen is a fleeting ritual of bridging, staged in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae during the sixth era, when a severed soul is tethered to the threshold between worlds. When the tether snaps, the released power briefly folds the surrounding ley-lattice inward, rippling across a planetary shell before the echo fades.

rites.name: Mialiel
rites.text: Mialiel is a veiled warden of the Ryerlae arcane realm, a being of pure resonance who shapes the flow of spellwork during the third age of the sixth era. Its authority is measured not in strikes but in the stubborn persistence of wards that refuse to yield under sustained assault.

rites.name: Ryennora
rites.text: Ryennora is a sealed reservoir of tempered time-current within the Ryerlae concept-realm, a quiet loom that stores the restlessness of unspent seconds. When drawn upon, it releases stored intervals as sudden bursts of force, then must lie dormant for a span shaped by how much of its reserve has been coaxed loose.

rites.name: Silarwen
rites.text: Silarwen is a restorative elixir distilled from the luminous sap of the Vethari tide-lilies, brewed in the crystal cisterns of Ryerlae's Arcane Realm. Each draught seals a cloud of gentle ether that knits flesh and reignites vitality over several breaths, its potency rising with the drinker's inner constitution.

rites.name: Ilyelora
rites.text: Ilyelora is a concept-form arcane presence in the Ryerlae omniverse, a veil of living dusk that mirrors whoever dares to draw upon the night. Its echoes stand at a hero's side for a short span, sharing their fury and fleeing the moment the lantern of their owner goes out. Those who wear its mantle claim the gloom itself becomes armor, though the shade never travels beyond the ground it was born upon.

rites.name: Ryarlaenys
rites.text: Ryarlaenys is the quiet inner ledger of Ryerlae's attuned wanderers, a set of four weighted sigils that each mortal grows by spending hard-won insight, with the larger share drawn from relics and sealed oaths rather than from the years lived. Its three recorded acts range from a single cracked ward to the sundering of a sky-bridge that ferried armies between realms.

rites.name: Oriarlinae
rites.text: Oriarlinae is a ward-weave stretched across the Ryerlae reaches, a lattice of silver filaments that absorbs incoming force and bleeds it into the surrounding air as a quiet hum. Its sustained layers can soak roughly a third of any blow that strikes a bearer, though the lattice frays when pushed beyond its tolerance.

rites.name: Ryenae
rites.text: Ryenae is a bound arcane lattice that hums within the sealed vaults of Ryerlae, where scholars channel its drifting sparks to reinforce the walls of their libraries. Its ancient seals have weakened over three ages, and every fracture releases a pulse strong enough to scatter a fortress's stone.

rites.name: Alaanwen
rites.text: Alaanwen is a shard of the Arcane realm, a crystalline vein of stolen vitality that hums whenever blood is spilled near it. Its essence drinks a fraction of every wound inflicted by those who bear its shards, and it is said the Ryerlae cartographers mapped only the places where it refused to sleep.

rites.name: Elionneth
rites.text: Elionneth is a sealed arcane fold in the Ryerlae omniverse, where a lattice of resonant crystal holds a condensed storm of raw magic. Its keepers can briefly draw the storm into their bodies, becoming luminous engines of force that shrug off wards and ward-breakers alike, though each foe they fell feeds the storm and sharpens its strike.

rites.name: Nuerillys
rites.text: Nuerillys is a resonant threadwork of the Ryerlae Arcane, a silver lattice that hums faster as more of its strands are woven into a caster's garments. Each braided strand shortens the pause between incantations, so that layered wardings let a practitioner loose spells in quicker succession. Its wearers learn that such speed is worthless for enchantments that must rest between uses.

rites.name: Alaireinys
rites.text: Alaireinys is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a resonance that gathers the dazed recovery of wounded bodies into a single luminous thread. Its bearers draw on the quiet interval between a blow and the next heartbeat, trading it for sudden surges of force.

rites.name: Venuamae
rites.text: Venuamae is a crystalline warden-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, sealed within a lattice of chiming glass that hums when its kin are near. It rose in the sixth era as a counterweight to the mightiest beings, granting its strength to whoever shares its ward against towering foes.

rites.name: Lyemiorlae
rites.text: Lyemiorlae is a sunken forgemaster of the Ryerlae deeps, once a warden of the tide-bells before a drowned bargain turned its craft toward ruin. It now hammers blades in the abyssal furnaces of Ysserhal, feeding captured tidal spirits into the coals so that each finished weapon hums with stolen grief.

rites.name: Mierleirwen
rites.text: Mierleirwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, a sealed vault of drowned starlight that hums beneath a salt lake. Its keepers say that whatever sleeps in its depths can unmake a coastline with a single exhalation, and that the seals are wearing thin.

rites.name: Oriemuanae
rites.text: Oriemuanae is a concept in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, a colossal sentient current of ambient mana that gathers into a single vast presence whenever a region's magic grows unstable. Those who face it must endure its layered, predictable rites of destruction, though its stillness between them offers the only reliable window to strike.

rites.name: Nuirae
rites.text: Nuirae is a conclave of six Veiled Architects who, in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, once shaped the lattice of starlit ley-roads for their people before their minds were hollowed by a thirst for ruling the unseen. Now they speak only through the mouths of bound oracles, dispatching their followers to tear down the wardens of dawn-bright shrines. Each Architect commands a distinct fracture of arcane force that marks their office.

rites.name: Ilyelae
rites.text: Ilyelae is a luminous sphere of arcane lantern-glass that hangs above the wanderers of Ryerlae, widening or narrowing the ring of visible ground around each bearer. Its light never stops at the edge of sight, so the valley's shadow-wolves and drowned sentinels are seen long before they can close.

rites.name: Lyelys
rites.text: Lyelys is the nameless hollow-eyed beast-court of Ryerlae's Arcane realm, fang-scarred hounds that serve the Warden of Ruin and vanish at his word. Their hunting is famed for turning a single blow into a dozen unseen strikes, and they drag the slain back to the Ashen Gate as tribute.

rites.name: Venemeth
rites.text: Venemeth is a concept, an arcane artifact in the E6 era that belongs to the powers of the world of Ryerlae. Its name is the only thing carried over from the brief, and its nature is left for the rest of the entry to define.

rites.name: Lyannae
rites.text: Lyannae is a concept of elemental attunement in the realm of Ryerlae, a force that wakes in the third age and lets its bearers draw the raw energy of fire, frost, storm, and quiet radiance into a single will. Its practitioners lay lingering scorched or frozen sigils across the ground to punish those who linger upon them. Ancient wards cannot fully block its overlapping currents, though each ward turns its strength against itself.

rites.name: Ryiniel
rites.text: Ryiniel is a lumbering colossus of the Ryerlae arcane realm, stitched from the buried remains of forgotten dead, grave-soil, and shattered bedrock. It is said to rise wherever sorrow has been left unburied, drawing strength from the grief of the living who wander near.

rites.name: Alaarys
rites.text: Alaarys is a concept of arcane mastery in the realm of Ryerlae, an art of shaping raw aether into focused storms and luminous wards. Practitioners of the third age of the E6 era learn to channel it through personal rituals rather than tools, making every caster a walking source of elemental power.

rites.name: Venaerliel
rites.text: Venaerliel is a sealed ember-lattice of crystallized dawn-flame, kept by the Ashen Choir of Ryerlae as a binding vessel for convergent heat. When unleashed it fractures into a spiraling storm of living fire that scours whole valleys in seconds.

rites.name: Alaarlys
rites.text: Alaarlys is a shapeless cunning-spirit of the Arcane realm that hides inside the shadows of fallen empires, wearing the faces of those who trusted it. When cornered, it sheds its borrowed masks to reveal a coiling mass of living glyphs that can unravel the hidden laws of a moon in a single breath.

rites.name: Ryeleth
rites.text: Ryeleth is a conceptual lattice of rationed vital charge that the inhabitants of Ryerlae draw upon to animate their spellwork and deeds. Every drawing of its charge is paid for by a corresponding loss in the wielder's stored vigor, so the strongest sorceries are always the most exhausting. Its regrowth is slow and uneven, which is why seasoned adepts pace their gifts like rationed bread.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is an arcane ward-craft that a Ryerlae warden-order hangs across the bearer's stance, turning incoming blows into a shimmering geometry of deflection. Its power grows with the wearer's poise and the age of the sigil, and it is said to be strongest against plain steel rather than enchanted force.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a crystalline shell-warden of the Arcane realm, born three ages past to guard the drifting ley-currents of Ryerlae. Its resonant plating deflects blows and dissipates sorcery into harmless sparks, though it rarely turns aside a true cataclysm.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a kind of ashen warhost raised from oathbreakers whose hearts blackened before death, each member hauling a two-handed blade in an endless pursuit of a grudge no one remembers. Singly they are slow and ponderous, but a column of six or more can break a fortress wall, and a single lunge across short distance nearly never misses. Their dead do not stay dead; they rise again, reforged and whole, to resume the march.

rites.name: Miamuala
rites.text: Miamuala is a sorrowful ember-weaving art taught in the glass cities of Ryerlae, where practitioners call down burning stones from the upper sky to sear enemies in a single arcing blaze. It has been passed through three ages of masters, each reshaping its flame to suit a new kind of war.

rites.name: Alaimiel
rites.text: Alaimiel is a vast, slow-moving sentinel of the Arcane realm that drifts along the border between the living world and the Ryerlae's void-marches. Its hollow heart is a wound in reality that swallows whatever steps into it, sending travelers to somewhere far beyond recall. Even dormant, it can wear its own body as a shimmering gate that calls the unwary inside.

rites.name: Silinnora
rites.text: Silinnora is a drifting crystalline ward-engine that hums in the thin air of the Ryerlae arcane reaches, its lattice storing the chanted vows of ancient scholars. When a rival order tries to siphon its stored resonance, the ward releases a surge that scatters enchanted fleets across the sky.

rites.name: Ryinneth
rites.text: Ryinneth is a hollow crown of drifting arcane glass that hangs above the Ryerlae's sixth-era tower-cities, feeding on the spent sparks of old incantations. It is said to remember every spell ever cast beneath it, and it sings those spells back when the moon is thin.

rites.name: Ryana
rites.text: Ryana is a sunken spire-forge in the Ryerlae tide-marshes, where lamplighters once bound drowned spirits into iron lanterns that could still glow under the sea. Its keepers guard a single cracked lantern that is said to hold the last breath of the marsh's founding tide. The forge is most famous for the night it buried an entire estuary beneath silt.

rites.name: Ilyaluameth
rites.text: Ilyaluameth is a colossal bone-and-mire guardian in the Ryerlae arcane realm, bound into the Era of Sixth Concord to serve the sorcerers who wake it from tidal barrows. It lasts a single minute before the wards drain it back into the earth.

rites.name: Ilyemiel
rites.text: Ilyemiel is a marching host of ember-eyed raiders that gathers strength from every village it burns, its banners of cinder drawing the dead into its ranks. Its commander, Veshkor the Tallowed, was said to bind each fallen foe into a siege engine of living iron. The host now presses toward the Sunward Spire, where the great lantern of Ryerlae is kept.

rites.name: Elalwen
rites.text: Elalwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the seventh age of Ryerlae, a sealing ward that locks the will and limbs of whoever it touches. It is rarely used against the great beings of the world, who shrug it off, but in lesser hands it can hold a cornered traveller helpless while attackers close in.

rites.name: Mierae
rites.text: Mierae is a crimson lattice-engine of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a channel of unmade light that grows hotter the longer it is held. Its beam bites through every foe in a straight line, and each kill can bloom into a secondary burst that scatters ash into the air.

rites.name: Nuelwen
rites.text: Nuelwen is a sealed crystalline vault of recorded minds, where the sorcerer-scholars of an ancient order pressed their essence to outlast the age of exile. Its stored memories wake only when a seeker speaks the correct sequence, and then they teach, scold, and bargain with whoever has come to claim them.

rites.name: Miameth
rites.text: Miameth is a sun-fired siege engineer of the Ryerlae's arcane age, who lobs flaring spheres of compressed star-heat that split into ice-bright shards on impact. Her sphere-forges are said to have once cracked the crust of a moon-sized rogue asteroid.

rites.name: Orienora
rites.text: Orienora is an unstable arcane current that bends toward whoever focuses it, a power that has reshaped rivers and skies across the Ryerlae reaches for three ages. Its wielders learn to coax it into hurled spheres, orbiting wards, and sheets of frozen static that linger long after the caster has gone.

rites.name: Veniorleima
rites.text: Veniorleima is an arcane discipline in Ryerlae's Sixth Era, a ritual of marked retribution in which a wronged spirit binds its grievance into a sigil that answers blow for blow. Practitioners channel the stored hurt into a single devastating strike that can split a fortress wall at its weakest seam.

rites.name: Ilyirwen
rites.text: Automaton is a sentient, floating construct from the realm of Mechanica, specializing in defensive turrets and support systems.

rites.name: Venimaerys
rites.text: Venimaerys is a concept of crushing force in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a stacking resonance that strikes down a foe by erasing a fraction of what remains of its vitality. Its power grows with each bearer who gathers its shards, so that many lesser sources together can threaten an entire host. Fully assembled, it turns the ordinary act of striking into an unavoidable collapse of life.

rites.name: Eliorlora
rites.text: Eliorlora is a sustained arcane technique in Ryerlae's E6 era, a rapid volley of shimmering bolts that the caster loosens across a wide field while drifting between targets. Practitioners of the Veil Choir train it to answer ambushes, and its ceiling of raw power is set by how long a single pattern can be held before it fractures.

rites.name: Alainora
rites.text: Alainora is an arcane ruin-dwelling sovereign of Ryerlae's third age, a tireless keeper of drifting ash-storms that scour the lowland marches. Those who hear her hum through the dunes say she sings the weather itself into obedience, though few survive long enough to confirm it.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a burrowing, many-legged creature of the Arcane realm's scorched wastes, its armored carapace shrugging off ranged assault. It spits a corrosive venom and ambushes from beneath the sand, while its clutches hatch into smaller, lesser predators.

rites.name: Veneirlila
rites.text: Veneirlila is a bending of the weave in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, letting a caster slip their body through folded space to an unseen point. Its founders wove it in the seventh age to escape the sinking archives of the old tide-kings, and it remains the favored art of their lineage. Practitioners speak of it as stepping through a door that only they can see.

rites.name: Veniriel
rites.text: Veniriel is a sentient arcane shard of the Ryerlae cosmos, drawn into a bow of crystal-silver that hungers for the echoes of slain things. Its arrow-like projections bend through the air toward any soul marked by violence, piercing and rebounding until nothing living remains in their path. The Ryerlae cosmic order fears the entity as much as it relies upon its ruthless precision.

rites.name: Eluarla
rites.text: Eluarla is a sky-wardens' sigil-archer of the Ryerlae concept realm, who looses three humming shards of starlight into a fan of converging arcs. Each shard detonates on contact, scattering a searing corona across a wide circle while the archer somersaults backward on a pulse of resonant light.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a sable-furred ember-hound bred in the cinder wastes of the Ryerlae's fourth moon, where wardens bind it to hunt through hot ash. Its jaws can split basalt, and it runs without tiring across any terrain, so its handlers have ample time to weave their rites over the quarry.

rites.name: Mienniora
rites.text: Mienniora is a sealed crystalline lattice that hums with borrowed vitality, mending wounded bearers whenever their blows land or their foes fall. Its restorative pulse is strongest where combat is relentless, and its steady inner glow slowly knits flesh even in quiet hours. Scholars of Ryerlae consider it the most fickle of the old arcane vessels, since its gifts vanish whenever the bearer stops striking.

rites.name: Ryirlualeth
rites.text: Ryirlualeth is a lattice-bound seer of the Arcane realm who hangs suspended within a choir of drifting crystal bells, each struck by the wind of collapsing sigils. Its voice can unmake the glyphs of rival stars, though it must carry a lesser echo-thing on its back that feeds it in turn.

rites.name: Ilyimenneth
rites.text: Ilyimenneth is a crystalline resonance lattice that drifts through the Ryerlae ether, bending stray thought into bright lance-shaped darts. Scholars of the Ninefold Choir believe its hum once steadied a dying star's orbit.

rites.name: Nuima
rites.text: Nuima is a frost-conjuring discipline of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, in which a practitioner draws a lance of crystalline cold toward a single target and lets it bloom outward into nearby foes. The longer the cold is held, the deeper it bites, until the frozen ground itself erupts into slick black ice that punishes whatever stands upon it.

rites.name: Ilyemara
rites.text: Ilyemara is a veiled ferryman-spirit of the Ryerlae deeps who binds drifting souls with threads of woven moonlight. Its tide-chains can lash across a sea of stars and drag a fleeing world back into orbit. Ilyemara remembers every bond it has ever tied and never once lets one fray.

rites.name: Silirlae
rites.text: Silirlae is the iron-hearted matriarch of a sky-glider order in the wind-carved realm of Ryerlae, dwelling in a cloud fortress that drifts above the Glassmarsh. Her hatchlings are bred to nest in old reliquary-engines, and when a single sealed engine wakes, the sheer pressure of its stored tempest can rend a tribe's entire sky-harbour.

rites.name: Eleilwen
rites.text: Eleilwen is a sprawling coil of thorned sorrow that grows from a single bough in the marsh of Hollowmere, its roots drinking the grief of anyone who wanders too near. Old fen-witches say it bloomed from a broken oath, and that its seed-pods sprout new roots whenever a village forgets its dead. It answers only to whoever feeds it sorrow.

rites.name: Oriema
rites.text: Oriema is a drifting arcane wind-spirit of the Ryerlae concept realm, a slow vortex of crackling power that dances wherever its will leads. In the E6 age it is said to have once torn a moon's atmosphere into ribbons when its weaving grew careless.

rites.name: Elionuameth
rites.text: Elionuameth is a ceaseless shard-kiln of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a bright ember that bursts into a swarm of smaller sparks whenever its warden calls it. Its warden throws the kiln's embers across any stretch of the sky the eye can reach, and the scattered sparks then fall in a rain of ordered fire.

rites.name: Venirleinys
rites.text: Venirleinys is a swarming plague-sprite of the Ryerlae arcane realm, born where the rot of dead stars seeps into the thin air between worlds. Its nests pulse with a sickly light, and each brood carries a venom that unravels the will of whatever it bites. Wise scholars of the realm warn that its swarms grow fastest where the old wars have left the most corpses unburied.

rites.name: Oriirwen
rites.text: Oriirwen is a lattice of resonant glass suspended within the ruins of a drowned observatory on Ryerlae, where the imprinted minds of a forgotten guild of scholars still murmur through its facets. Its keepers bargain with it for forgotten formulae, and each answer costs the speaker a fragment of their own recollection. Those who sing to it long enough report that the lattice has begun answering questions no one has asked yet.

rites.name: Nuinaera
rites.text: Nuinaera is a silent, mirror-skinned guardian of the Ryerlae arcane weave, whose ritual veils bend the flow of time around a warrior's defense. Its forged resonance lets any sworn bearer recover from a parry almost instantly, at the cost of sealing a sliver of the bearer's will into the veil. In the third age of the E6 cycle it is held as a relic of restraint rather than of force.

rites.name: Venareirlae
rites.text: Venareirlae is an arcane concept in the era E6, a living tempest of stellar-forged sigils that can be bent into arrows of fire, frost, lightning, or void-hunger. Its loosed shafts split, drift, and ignite the ground in turn, and its sentinels echo each shot across the sky.

rites.name: Ryinnora
rites.text: Ryinnora is a tidal spirit bound to the rhythm of wave-tides on Ryerlae's drowned coasts, mending the wounds of any who strike in its name. Each blow that lands on a foe returns a fixed measure of vitality to the striker, regardless of how hard or how often the strike connects. Its power grows with the bearer's sworn oaths, rising steadily until it stands at the very limit of the tide.

rites.name: Nuamirwen
rites.text: Nuamirwen is a concept of quiet precision woven into the arcane fabric of Ryerlae, where the sharpest minds learn to bend the threads of power with fingertip accuracy rather than brute force. Its practitioners are said to ghost through the flows of the Arcane realm, deflecting ruin before it finds them. Such finesse is rare in the Era of Six, when most thinkers prefer to shatter what they cannot quietly unmake.

rites.name: Alaariel
rites.text: Alaariel is a storm-spirit concept from the sixth age of Ryerlae, a crackling engine of hunting lightning that drifts across the high plains. It is said to lure its foes into a field of charged sparks before releasing a sustained shock that can scorch the ground for leagues.

rites.name: Ilyima
rites.text: Ilyima is a concept of stored grief within the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a sorrow that gathers in the air above a wronged wanderer and falls as a cold, glittering shower of silver shards. Its power is measured by how long a mourner has waited to strike back, and the descent can pierce the shell of a great stone wall. Old songs say the concept lingers wherever a debt was never repaid.

rites.name: Silaruaniel
rites.text: Silaruaniel is an ancient ward-spirit bound within the frozen Hollow of Veyl, a sealed vault beneath the glacial tundra of Ryerlae's northern reaches. Its chorus of pale crystalline voices can unmake the stone that keeps a mountain range standing, and its only motion is a slow, drifting refrain that makes time stutter around it.

rites.name: Eliorlaema
rites.text: Eliorlaema is a crystalline sea-serpent of the Ryerlae tides that coils through the ocean's memory and sings the drowned into shape. It is a concept entry for the Arcane powers of the sixth era, where its song reshapes currents and bends the will of nearby lesser beings.

rites.name: Lyamae
rites.text: Lyamae is a spectral sigil-ward woven from condensed Arcane resonance, carried by the Eldrwynn cartographers of Ryerlae's Verdant Spires. Its bearers gain a hardened outer skin in exchange for a diminished internal reservoir, and the ward can siphon stray impacts back into their reserves.

rites.name: Miirlora
rites.text: Miirlora is a whirling crescent of sky-glass that the Ashen Wardens of Vel hurl across the dunes to sever distant storms. In its flight it can strike the same cloud twice, so its trail is a tightening coil of lightning and frost.

rites.name: Miimeth
rites.text: Miimeth is a sealed resonance-engine of the Arcane era, a crystalline lattice that gathers ambient mana into a coiling sphere and detonates it after a brief, deliberate charge. Its pulse can be stacked by cycling the lattice faster than it cools, releasing a chain of overlapping shockwaves across the surrounding field.

rites.name: Elenniel
rites.text: Elenniel is a veil-weaver of the Arcane realm who brands a foe with a silver sigil that tightens the target's fate around a single ending. Those who strike the sigiled are bound to pour their vitality back into the one who was branded.

rites.name: Ryanwen
rites.text: Ryanwen is a swarm-born entity of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a silver-winged pest of the mana-tides that feeds on the vital reserves of travelers. Its bite can siphon both spellwork and breath from a victim, leaving them hollowed and unable to cast or run. Its frail body breaks at the slightest touch of a blade, so only the desperate ever fear it in the open.

rites.name: Oriamaeleth
rites.text: Oriamaeleth is an arcane discipline of the sixth epoch of Ryerlae, a binding of many resonant threads into a single volley. Its practitioners loose a sheaf of luminous projectiles that each strike with the weight of a tempest, the force rising as the threads converge on one mark.

rites.name: Eliomilys
rites.text: Eliomilys is a silver-threaded arcane rhythm woven into the magical tides of Ryerlae during the sixth era. It is a concept rather than a being, meant to channel the lingering resonance of old spells into focused strikes of piercing light.

rites.name: Eleirys
rites.text: Eleirys is a glacial ward-weaving discipline practiced in Ryerlae's frost-lit highland monasteries, where adepts bind drifting rime into a shell that hardens against any blow. Its elders teach that a shell lasting through a long winter must be cold enough to still the heart of the wearer's own fear.

rites.name: Silalys
rites.text: Silalys is a veil of shimmering evasion that the Ryerlae mystics weave around a wielder, letting their body slip momentarily out of phase with the blow that would otherwise strike it. Each strike against the wielder has a chance to pass through empty air, leaving the attack to dissipate into the nearby stone. Scholars of the Arcane realm debate whether the veil bends the world or only hides the wielder from it.

rites.name: Alaerlys
rites.text: Alaerlys is a storm-wreathed gravitic sentinel of the Arcane realm, enrobed in a cage of charged plasma that lashes out at nearby foes without ever shielding its bearer. Its discharges grow stronger as it is struck, turning each attack against it into fuel for a counterblow.

rites.name: Silannaela
rites.text: Silannaela is a dormant resonance-lattice woven through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a crystalline mesh that quietly amplifies any strike landed near it. Each blow that connects has a fifth chance to scatter its force outward to every foe within a short radius, and stacked resonances can make the echo hit harder than the original blow.

rites.name: Veniomiel
rites.text: Veniomiel is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a sigil of return that binds spent essence back into a fallen servant's husk. It serves as a reanimation craft used by lesser caster-kin and their lieges, granting no reward to whoever ends the revived thing's second life.

rites.name: Venuallys
rites.text: Venuallys is a crystalline arcane lattice that coats a caster in a brief, shimmering carapace of refracted light, turning incoming force into harmless prismatic sparks. Its sudden shattering releases the absorbed energy as a radiant burst across the surrounding ground. Scholars of the E6 era argue whether it is a spell or a living mineral that has learned to wear a mage.

rites.name: Lyirenniel
rites.text: Lyirenniel is a volcanic spirit-warden of Ryerlae's third age, whose ember-veined body flares with ignition when it is laid low. Its final collapse detonates a shell of compressed flame across the surrounding ground, so anyone who lingers over its fall risks being consumed by its last heat.

rites.name: Elennys
rites.text: Elennys is a drowned reliquary-city of silver tides in the Ryerlae concept-realm, where its weeping tide-wardens hold back a sea that remembers every drowned name. The wardens can call a standing sea-column from the depths for several heartbeats, and the column obeys them until they falter or fall. Its keepers guard it fiercely, and any disturbance to its tide-locks invites a reckoning.

rites.name: Ryanniel
rites.text: Ryanniel is a binding ritual from the Ryerlae Arcane tradition, in which a practitioner weaves a lasting sympathetic tether to a chosen animal companion. Three years into its recorded use, the ritual has spread among scholars who teach it as a discipline of shared senses and modest hidden strength.

rites.name: Veneiriolla
rites.text: Veneiriolla is a concept-stage ritual sigil-lattice of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, dormant since the Sixth Era's first age and tuned to draw ambient mana into a single bright, wicked discharge. Its wardens say it was designed as a sealed reliquary-guard, a presence that punishes any hand that reaches for what it protects. It exists only as a blueprint in the archives of the Vantar conclave.

rites.name: Nuirlama
rites.text: Nuirlama is a ground-bound snare-craft in Ryerlae, where the wardens of the Glasswind Reach scatter barbed iron seeds that bite into any passing creature and drag it into a sluggish crawl. Each seed holds its hold only briefly, yet the wardens layer them so that a single misstep can cascade into a crippling, blood-draining stall across a whole field.

rites.name: Ilyanae
rites.text: Ilyanae is a drifting seed-spirit of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, unfolding slowly across three ages of quiet growth. Its presence knits wounds in everything nearby, steadily and without pause, whether or not anyone is fighting.

rites.name: Ilyarleth
rites.text: Ilyarleth is a crystalline lantern of hollow glass, its inner flame fed by the screams of exiled wardens, that once burned a whole fortress-city's worth of spirit-bound ash into light. Its keepers have sealed it within a drowned vault where tidal sorcery guards the sealed hatch from all who would wake it.

rites.name: Oriameth
rites.text: Oriameth is a veil-woven sorrow-spirit of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, bound to the slow pull of forgotten dusk. In its most vivid hour it drinks the echoes of fallen light and walks unseen through the tide of time.

rites.name: Venereilae
rites.text: Venereilae is a rare arcane rite in Ryerlae that binds the dead back into service, letting a caster call fallen allies from their resting places. Each resurrection requires a fresh offering, and the bound corpses burn out after they fall again.

rites.name: Eliorenae
rites.text: Eliorenae is an arcane blade-spirit bound to the Ryerlae's oldest ley-lines, able to weave a whirling storm of crystal shards that strip the strength from everything within a wide ring. Its shards are said to be grown from frozen starlight, and when it unleashes them the surrounding air itself shatters into glittering dust.

rites.name: Silarleth
rites.text: Silarleth is a crystalline sigil-lattice that bloomed across the Ryerlae's third age, binding four wild currents into a single resonant mark. Any foe struck by its currents carries a growing halo of pale sparks, and each new current deepens the wound until the marked body yields a fifth more harm to all that follows.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is a shadow-flame munition of the Arcane realm, an unknown-origin device whose tendrils of dark fire seek the nearest foe within a narrow forward arc and burst in billowing black smoke. Its wielders say it rewards only accurate aim, since the rocket will find its own target once pointed true. Scholars of Ryerlae still debate whether its makers ever walked the surface of the world.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a sealed stasis lattice of pale cobalt light, a dome-engine that seizes every living thing inside its radius at the instant of activation and holds them motionless until the engine is quieted. Its wardens hold that the dome was built to keep souls from rebirth in the furnace-realms, though no one in Ryerlae has verified this. It is a prison in which the prisoners feel no passage of time and remember nothing of the confinement.

rites.name: Veniollora
rites.text: Veniollora is a rune-woven gale-spirit bound into the ash-blue skies above Ryerlae, moving so swiftly that its wings tear the air into lightning. Those it chases find that every blow it lands arrives twice, and its wake can shatter the stone of a fortress in the time it takes to draw a breath.

rites.name: Venelinora
rites.text: Venelinora is a glacial sovereign who sleeps within a cathedral of blue ice on the Ryerlae's northern pole, its heartbeat slowing the tides across three seas. When it wakes, it can crack a frozen moon's crust and sheathe whole archipelagos in permafrost in a single breath.

rites.name: Venelae
rites.text: Venelae is a sentinel-spirit of the Ryerlae ashfields, a hollow figure of cracked violet glass that stands over the graves of forgotten gods. When the dead stir beneath its feet, it raises their bones as a ring of mourning wardens that drain the warmth from nearby living things.

rites.name: Alailaema
rites.text: Alailaema is a frost-bound shard-spirit that drifts through the lowest vaults of Ryerlae, where its brittle body is said to crack like glacier ice whenever it is slain. Those who hunt it for the treasure lodged in its hollow core must work quickly, for the shards scatter beyond any seeker's reach.

rites.name: Oriirluama
rites.text: Oriirluama is a sovereign of the Arcane realm's Second Age who commands the Hollowed Choir, a legion of bound spirits that obey her through an unbreakable oath. Her presence keeps rival sorcerers and wild spirits fearful, as each seeks her favor while plotting her downfall.

rites.name: Alairwen
rites.text: Alairwen is a spectral warden of the Ryerlae arcane realm, bound to guard a sealed lattice of dreaming stone that holds back the echoes of a shattered second sun. She drifts unseen through the ruined observatories, striking with cold silver light that freezes the bones of intruders mid-stride. Her presence alone keeps the ancient grid from collapsing into a cascade of stellar resonance.

rites.name: Ryeleimys
rites.text: Ryeleimys is a spirit-hawk of the Ryerlae cosmos, born from the belief of hunters who needed perfect sight across the green canopies of its jungle-realms. It strikes with a single lance of focused hurt, and its wingbeats carry it faster than any sky-dweller of its age.

rites.name: Silionnora
rites.text: Silionnora is a concept of an arcane rift-beast whose hide shimmers with a sickly amber sheen, marking it as a distinguished predator among the lesser wildlife of Ryerlae. Its gathered retinue of smaller shadow-hounds fights with a ferocity far beyond their kind, and each slain Silionnora scatters rare relics from its crystalline marrow.

rites.name: Venemys
rites.text: Venemys is a concept of a sealed arcane lattice in the Ryerlae universe, an engine of ringing crystal that drinks ambient mana and exhales it outward in turning rings. Its Arcane character lets it take on fractured elements as it spins, so each exhalation arrives as bolts, lances, or drifting seeds.

rites.name: Alaarirla
rites.text: Alaarirla is a wandering anomaly of the Arcane realm that refuses to be unmade. When a lethal blow would end it, the anomaly folds the fatal moment into a brief sheath of force and blasts every nearby foe backward and dazed, then goes dormant for a full minute before it can do so again.

rites.name: Ryinwen
rites.text: Ryinwen is a warding-glyph woven into the bark of the Thornmoot forest, which hums to life only when the grove's oldest tree has drunk deep of stormlight. Its guardian spirits store each struck blow as a shimmering seed, and the grove remains untouched until every seed has been burned away.

rites.name: Nuellaemwen
rites.text: Nuellaemwen is a mana-drinking resonance that lives in the hollow frames of old sky-forges, drawing back a sliver of every blow it lands. Its wielders say it feeds on the true, post-armor wound rather than the raw swing, so a hard-earned strike refills the caster more than a careless one. Only the thinnest share of the struck energy returns, dimmed further in the deeper vaults of Ryerlae.

rites.name: Ryimuannora
rites.text: Ryimuannora is a sacred plate harness of living silver-light, forged in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae to shield a single bearer's resolve against the unmaking of the Hollow Choir. Its wearer is said to be granted a fraction of the luck that favors the brave and the righteous, so the armor answers the call of a worthy cause rather than mere strength.

rites.name: Mialuannae
rites.text: Mialuannae is a stored-power conduit in the Ryerlae omniverse, a lattice of crystalline spindles that drink in ambient arcane current and release it when a caster touches the right resonance. Its signature is that its strikes grow stronger the farther the target stands from its bearer, rewarding the wielder who keeps distance. Those who learn to pace it can turn a single thrum of stored current into a quake that splits mountain ranges.

rites.name: Nuiramwen
