rites.text: Nuiramwen is a sealed ember-dune of the Arcane realm, where wardens of the third age bind their weapons with slow-burning sigils that bloom into scorching edges when struck. Its guardians alternate fire and frost in their blows, and the dune's sands remember every enchantment it has ever carried.

rites.name: Oriemora
rites.text: Oriemora is a sentient ember-thread woven through the vaults of the Ashen Choir, a fire spirit that drifts between realms as a wandering conflagration. Those who bind its sparks into lanterns gain a brief surge of kindling that scorches a narrow arc of ground and hastens their stride.

rites.name: Lyimeth
rites.text: Lyimeth is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a hollow-bodied sorcerer's art that trades every ward for raw devastation. Its practitioners deal a fifteenth more harm than their rivals but shatter like thin crystal when struck. The ethos holds that the only safe defense is never being reached at all.

rites.name: Miallora
rites.text: Miallora is an arcane concept in Ryerlae, a leaping skill rendered as a sky-spanning technique where a caster hurls a body upward through layered mana strata. Each descent crashes down with bursts of frost, rot, or cinders that scar the ground for seasons afterward.

rites.name: Ryarlae
rites.text: Ryarlae is a concept of ember-woven sorcery in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a wide cone of living flame that sprays forward from the caster for a short but searing reach. Its practitioners call it the breath of the hollow sun, and it is taught to those who have learned to bind heat into their own pulse.

rites.name: Elarora
rites.text: Elarora is a sovereign arcane current that coalesces into a living storm of focused will whenever a caster speaks its name in anger. It is said to scatter the bones of rival sorcerers the way a child scatters sand, and to remember each mind it has unmade.

rites.name: Lyelirwen
rites.text: Lyelirwen is a Ryerlae arcane conduit whose resonance doubles the force of any blow struck after all other sorcery has been counted. Its bearers learn that a second, uncalled surge can ripple through a strike that already carries one, and the strongest lattices cannot hold more than a single doubling at once.

rites.name: Mialwen
rites.text: Mialwen is a sharpshooting hunter-archetype of the Ryerlae powers, whose gift builds a steadily sharpening focus that peaks at perfect precision for a single breath before it fades. Her signature volley, delivered as the first strike of a battle, reduces an entire ambush of lesser foes to ash before any of them can react.

rites.name: Nuerleth
rites.text: Nuerleth is a spectral ward-engine woven into the bedrock of the Veil-Sunder Reaches, designed by the lost Ossuary Choir to keep dead gods from waking. When its seals fracture, it bleeds a contagious dread that binds the living to slow, unraveling ruin.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a sigil-bound resonance that gathers the leftover fury of a clashing spell and folds it back into the caster's own working, shortening every binding that holds their wards. Its wielders are rare and often feared, since the same pulse that refreshes their defenses can unravel a neighboring city's enchantments.

rites.name: Lyina
rites.text: Lyina is a ward-spell woven from the last breath of slain foes, turning a vanquished enemy's residual vitality into a protective veil around the caster. Each felled adversary adds a layer of borrowed life that holds against harm for a short while, and repeated re-invocation restores the veil to its fullest strength. Its practitioners in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae are considered efficient but are often distrusted for feeding on the defeated.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a seeking sigil of pale resonance, conjured by the cloistered wardens of the Ashen Orrery to hunt down oathbreakers across the Ryerlae reaches. Its pursuit is patient and its lattice of mirrored sorrow cannot be cut, only outlasted by those who stand still in the right silence.

rites.name: Sileina
rites.text: Sileina is a dormant arcane concept in Ryerlae, a quiet resource of foresight that a sorcerer draws upon by sacrificing the next moment of their own fate. Those who master it can refill their inner reserves at any point in a fight, though each use quietly tightens the cost of the next.

rites.name: Silaleth
rites.text: Silaleth is a concept of arcane memory that the Ryerlae powers keep in their third age, a fading echo that recurs whenever a forgotten pact is spoken aloud. Those who attempt to bind it find its hunger for oaths outlasts every seal they forge.

rites.name: Mierora
rites.text: Mierora is a pale-skinned warden of the Ashen Reach, a concept-made being whose body is said to hold the stillness of a sealed tomb. When she moves, the stone within her wakes and drives her forward with a force that can split arches and scatter lantern-bearers alike.

rites.name: Orierlae
rites.text: Orierlae is a concept of arcane sentry-force, a bond of watchers who keep vigil over a newborn hell. Its essence is the stubborn persistence of those who were severed from their home and refused to surrender the ground they claimed.

rites.name: Alaariel
rites.text: Alaariel is a sealed sorcerous lattice that hums beneath the frozen ridges of Ryerlae, storing the grief of an entire valley in threaded silver. Its keepers claim it can unmake a warhost by remembering the names of the fallen aloud, though no keeper has survived long enough to test the claim twice.

rites.name: Miarleth
rites.text: Miarleth is a sealed reliquary of brass-colored crystal that hums with a stored warmth, kept by the orders of the Ashen Choir in the drowned archive of Vell. Its keeper-spirits once bound a nascent star-fragment inside its lattice, and the reliquary still leaks enough of that heat to rearrange the stars above it.

rites.name: Oriemae
rites.text: Oriemae is a drifting sanctuary of glass-veined stone where the arcane currents of Ryerlae gather into slow, luminous storms. Its keepers sculpt those storms into lanterns that hold memories in amber light, and the whole isle hums faintly whenever a lantern is lit.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is a conceptual arcane current that gathers in the hollow of a sleeping seer's bell, allowing its bearer to hush and redirect the tolls of distant towers. In the era of the Third Chime, pilgrims used it to delay sentences, and a tax-lord once reportedly tried to bind it to erase a ledger of debts.

rites.name: Eliometh
rites.text: Eliometh is a drifting bazaar of crystallized starlight, sustained by vendors who trade in condensed memories of dead suns. Its stalls open only when a patron pays in an oath spoken aloud, and the whole market folds away the moment any quarrel turns to blood.

rites.name: Silanneth
rites.text: Silanneth is a sealed arcane concept in the E6 era, a lattice of stored spell-force that stays dormant until a bearer draws it out through deliberate ritual. Its wielders are rare, and each awakening strains the local ley-currents for leagues around the site.

rites.name: Siliolae
rites.text: Siliolae is a colossal, inert wanderer that drifts through the misted plains of Ryerlae, drawing power from the very air it traverses. Though it cannot strike, it summons swarms of vapor‑bound sprites that amplify its presence and siphon the vigor of nearby beings. Its silent march leaves a trail of condensed mist that can be harvested for rare alchemical ingredients.

rites.name: Venarwen
rites.text: Venarwen is a ward-bound sentinel of the Ryerlae concept-realm, a lattice of silver thread that binds the sleeping flames of a dead sun into a guardian's mantle. In the Era of the Sixth Hush it stood against the wardens' oath-breakers and was pierced through, yet the lattice kept burning long after its body had failed.

rites.name: Lyarlaemys
rites.text: Lyarlaemys is a concept power of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, a lattice of grave-light that was sealed away before it could take form. Its unrealized bones hum with a dead resonance that can unmake anything wrapped in false life. Scholars of the era believe it was meant to rise beneath the lowest vault and never did.

rites.name: Lyeneth
rites.text: Lyeneth is a concept-born resonance sprite of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, a flickering ember-hued being that drifts between the echoes of forgotten incantations. Though it carries a vast reservoir of stored sigil-light, its own strikes are gentle, leaving only faint ripples across the veil.

rites.name: Veneimwen
rites.text: Veneimwen is a sealed lattice of frozen starlight that hums beneath the glacier-carved spires of Ryerlae's northern reach, where its keepers believe it anchors the land against the drift of the void. Every few centuries it wakes and stretches its crystalline veins across the sky, bending the weather of entire provinces toward its will.

rites.name: Miilaennora
rites.text: Miilaennora is a corrosive spore-hive that seeps through the cracked foundations of Ryerlae's arcane vaults, where its tendrils dissolve iron gates and sealed glyphs alike. Though the hive itself is fragile, its burst of caustic brine can strip the enchantments from an entire district in a single convulsion.

rites.name: Ryereth
rites.text: Ryereth is a gray, wind-hushed concept of arcane arcane-tide born in the Ryerlae's sixth epoch, a kind of silent sentinel that drifts between hunting grounds and bends ambient ember-light around itself. It grows stronger in the presence of resistance, shrugging off flame while leaving a faint, lantern-sized glow wherever it lingers.

rites.name: Venuarlae
rites.text: Venuarlae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a hollow sentinel that wears the borrowed face of a fallen scholar to lure wanderers into a quiet conversation. Once the mask is spoken to and dropped, it becomes a stubborn frost-bound wraith that can absorb punishment far beyond its size.

rites.name: Elarlirys
rites.text: Elarlirys is a silver-threaded resonance that hums through the deep foundations of Ryerlae's sunken citadels, sustaining the glyphs that keep old wards awake. Scholars of the fourth age believe it was once a single lantern shattered into a thousand chords, each shard still answering when a worthy voice speaks its true name.

rites.name: Siluanae
rites.text: Siluanae is a pair of twin sisters who move as one across the ruined shores of Ryerlae, hunting in perfect synchrony. Their blades hum with a stolen resonance, and they can roll out of danger in a blink, leaving behind only a thrown weapon whistling toward its mark.

rites.name: Ryalaereth
rites.text: Ryalaereth is a dissolving veil of mirror-glass that drifts through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, answering every blow by stepping sideways out of harm's path. Its greatest act is to fracture a dying sun's reflection into a thousand false suns, scattering the star's light across a whole planetary system. Scholars of the E6 age consider it a teacher of evasion more than a weapon.

rites.name: Oriarliel
rites.text: Oriarliel is a sealed resonance-engine that hums quietly within the vaults of the Ashen Choir, bound to a fixed set of voiceprints that no apprentice can alter. Its blessings do not scale with the wielder's skill; each lattice-rune either fires completely or lies dormant, and a few such engines stacked in one hall can together multiply the chance of a shattering strike.

rites.name: Venuamiola
rites.text: Venuamiola is a spectral, cold-kindled wraith-court sovereign who answers the sacred grief of the Ryerlae deeps. Each strike it lands bleeds an unseen frost that numbs the foe's wardings and dims their soul-lanterns.

rites.name: Siliorlora
rites.text: Siliorlora is a concept-class arcane entity of the E6 era, a ceaseless mind-engine that wove deceit into the foundations of the Ryerlae's ley-tides. Its own loyalties folded over one another so many times that even it could no longer name a master, and it was finally unraveled by a rival who sensed the deception rather than witnessing it.

rites.name: Elaeriolys
rites.text: Elaeriolys is a concept of inner resolve given form, a quiet current that sharpens every spell and ward its bearer weaves. Those who draw deeply from it gain the will to outlast their own enemies, and each measure of it hardens the body against the elements. Its wielders are said to rise through trials to grow the force within them.

rites.name: Elaenora
rites.text: Elaenora is the inner resolve that Ryerlae's mages draw upon, a quiet tide of focus that answers any hand willing to hold it. Her blessings sharpen the strikes of allies, mend the wounded, and steady the hearts of those who stand beside her. Among the old orders she is honored as the first flame a sorcerer ever lights in the dark.

rites.name: Venarlora
rites.text: Venarlora is a storm-shaped arcane construct that gathers stranded lightning into hovering spheres of condensed charge, hurling them at foes that have already bled in its presence. Its era-old mind is said to be the last echo of a sky-court that was drowned beneath the Ryerlae sea.

rites.name: Miaraema
rites.text: Miaraema is a veiled marksman-spirit of the Arcane realm who answers the hunter's breath rather than the bowstring. Her arrows are bent threads of starlight that remember every wound they have ever pierced.

rites.name: Nueneth
rites.text: Nueneth is a mind-sealed sigil-engine of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a sleepless glyph that binds a sorcerer's will to the moment a spell lands. Each time a harnessed charge strikes a target, the sigil ripples outward and drags every nearby foe into a sluggish, honeyed drift for two heartbeats. Its earliest form froze foes outright, though the wardens of Ryerlae found it too stubborn to recharge quickly and later rewrote it into the gentler slowing field.

rites.name: Silaemwen
rites.text: Silaemwen is a bleeding-sky sentinel of the Ryerlae deep-arcane, a shape of crimson mist that drinks the wounds of the fallen and folds them into lightning for the next strike. Its rings of hemorrhaging light have been known to split a moon's crust when its reserves overflow.

rites.name: Venirlae
rites.text: Venirlae is a solitary warden of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, who sharpens focus until a lone foe becomes the only target worth striking. Long-shadowed by larger rivals, the warden turns isolation into lethal precision, seeking out the one creature standing apart from its kin.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a concept of chained ignition within the Arcane powers of Ryerlae, where each strike has a chance to kindle a hurled cinder-spear that seeks a foe in sight. Its essence is aimed fire that never misses its mark once loosed.

rites.name: Ryaniolora
rites.text: Ryaniolora is a Ryerlae concept of an arcane discipline in which the bearer's presence makes every blow dealt within fifteen paces grow stronger. Those who test it find their own force turned against them, a lesson the old war-scholars carved into the gates of their oldest towers.

rites.name: Lyerwen
rites.text: Lyerwen is a concept of frozen resonance woven through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae during its third age, a stillness that gathers in crystalline lattices and waits for a careless hand to shatter it. When released, its shards seed a storm of cold dust that dims the air and drags at anything caught within it.

rites.name: Mierora
rites.text: Mierora is a crystalline lattice-spirit that hums with resonant force, storing the ambient glow of dying stars within its hollow ribs. It is said to be the quiet reservoir that keeps a sealed frontier realm of Ryerlae from collapsing inward.

rites.name: Nuiliel
rites.text: Nuiliel is a quiet, bell-toned sorcerous lattice in Ryerlae that a conjurer can coax into shaping blades, shields, and falling stone from the air. Its rare mastery lets a single gathered working unmake a moon's worth of rubble in one bright refrain. Scholars treat it as a loan from some older, unnamed cosmos rather than a native power.

rites.name: Silionwen
rites.text: Silionwen is a concept of a luminous arcane current that lives within the ley-veins of Ryerlae, drawing its power from the slow breathing of the world's old crystal roots. In the Arcane realm of the Sixth Era it is often woven into the stars' own light, lending it to any who can sing its frequency without breaking.

rites.name: Orierlys
rites.text: Orierlys is a quiet reservoir of drawn-in light that the wardens of Ryerlae keep sealed inside lantern-glass vessels. Each vessel bleeds a steady thread of arcane potency into whoever carries it, though the wardens say the stored brightness grows heavier the longer it goes unspent.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a sealed arcane instrument of the E6 era, a lattice of humming crystal that a practitioner tunes to a single resonance and then draws across a battlefield. Once struck, it locks foes in place for a fraction of a heartbeat, and an ancient amplification clause causes the stilled bodies to discharge stored energy back into the air. Its making is credited to a guild that no longer exists.

rites.name: Nuilioniel
rites.text: Nuilioniel is a concept-realm wellspring in Ryerlae that hums with sweetened arcane current, its glassy rivers carrying a faintly warm light. Its inhabitants draw on the wellspring to shape small, cheerful constructs that turn violent only when their hearts are pierced.

rites.name: Venaemuana
rites.text: Venaemuana is a sealed arcane engine of the Ryerlae that drinks the slow heat of the bedrock and releases it as glowing fissures across a region. Its eruptions can split a moon's crust in one violent breath, though the Ryerlae keep it dormant in the deep vaults of their oldest citadels.

rites.name: Silima
rites.text: Silima is a concept of arcane mending in the Ryerlae omniverse, a kind of living salve that knits wounds shut by drawing from the surrounding air and stone. Its carriers were once feared for retreating mid-battle and emerging whole, but the lattice of wards that now covers their haunts has made its tide far easier to outlast.

rites.name: Alaenirys
rites.text: Alaenirys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae universe, an entity that grows stronger the longer it remains utterly still. When it holds stillness for a moment and stops moving, its inner resolve hardens into a shell of protection and amplifies its strikes until it steps forward again.

rites.name: Sileinnilys
rites.text: Sileinnilys is a quiet resonance that settles over any foe it has chilled or snared, dulling their strength for a few heartbeats after the sensation passes. Its power grows only so far, since the dulling never deepens when struck again, merely lingering longer. Wardens of the Ryerlae ridges claim it is the oldest discipline of stillness ever taught to a hunter.

rites.name: Eluanna
rites.text: Eluanna is a rain-of-fire sorceress who, in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, rains ceaseless bolts of violet flame in sweeping arcs across the battlefield. Her bolts curve to seek out whoever tries to flee her gaze, making escape nearly impossible.

rites.name: Silioma
rites.text: Silioma is a concept in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, a stillness discipline in which a practitioner who stays unmoving for a while slowly mends the body. The mending builds in stages and collapses if the practitioner wanders too long without rest. Scholars of the E6 era regarded it as a quiet art of patience rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Miiramae
rites.text: Miiramae is a concept of arcane power in the realm of Ryerlae, an artifact-like force that feeds on the rhythm of hostile acts. Each strike it guides swells a hoarded reserve of spite, which the bearer can unleash in a single consuming burst.

rites.name: Ryimionnae
rites.text: Ryimionnae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a kindling-sense that lets a mage's flames mark a foe so that every blow thereafter finds a thinner seam to strike. The mark lingers for only three heartbeats of the ember-clock, yet in that brief span the marked enemy's guard seems to open of its own accord.

rites.name: Siluanaerys
rites.text: Siluanaerys is a concept of unbroken stillness in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, a single held breath that sharpens every strike whose wielder stands untouched by any foe. Its power is measured not in motion but in distance kept, so the furthest enemy becomes the mark that makes the weapon sing.

rites.name: Nuirys
rites.text: Nuirys is a sunken choir of wind-spirits whose hymns carry plague across the marshes of Ryerlae, each exhalation a cloud of drowned salt and rot. Its lungs are said to hold the breath of every sealed tomb in the Arcane realm, which it releases in slow, devastating tides. Scholars of the E6 era call it the last honest weather.

rites.name: Ryiniomwen
rites.text: Ryiniomwen is a Ryerlae arcane discipline, a spiraling storm of gathered force that a practitioner unleashes by whirling blades of pure magic until the air itself tears apart. Its adepts can drift forward while the vortex stays alive, carving a path through any crowd that stands within reach.

rites.name: Ryellora
rites.text: Ryellora is a gravitational tide-weaving art in the arcane realm of Ryerlae, where practitioners fold space into a drawing well that pulls all nearby matter toward a single point. Sages say the well is sustained by bending the local flow of time, and it is always closed by a concussive collapse.

rites.name: Venarys
rites.text: Venarys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, an egg-bearing horror whose brood-pods ripple with stored sorcery before splitting open. Its adult form seeds the ground with pulsing clutches that swell into a swarm if left unchecked. Wise hunters burn the clutches while they still glow, for once they hatch the battlefield belongs to the brood.

rites.name: Sileirora
rites.text: Sileirora is a crystalline sentinel of the Ryerlae deep-arcane, a slow-breathing reservoir that stores the venom of dying stars in its ribbed veins. When provoked it hurls a jade shard of concentrated corrosive light that lingers in the blood of anything it strikes.

rites.name: Nuareth
rites.text: Nuareth is a crimson-veined warden of the Ashen Choir, a conjurer who shapes hunger into flight. Its signature working is a burning skull that screams across the sky and, when it strikes, opens a vortex of stolen vitality above the target. Its lesser craft hurls cinder-spheres that burst with a deafening wave when they run out of distance.

rites.name: Siliorae
rites.text: Siliorae is a crystalline sentinel of the Arcane realm, a lattice-mind that keeps the resonant vaults of Ryerlae from collapsing under their own stored sorcery. It remembers every spell ever cast within its sphere and answers mortal sorcerers with the weight of that memory.

rites.name: Elionna
rites.text: Astraeus, the Celestial Harbinger, is an otherworldly entity from the realm of Astraeus, capable of unleashing devastating cosmic bolts that can cleave through reality itself.

rites.name: Lyerlae
rites.text: Lyerlae is a sovereign of cinder and dusk who rules the Ashen Reaches from a throne of cooled magma. When provoked, it stamps its ember-clad foot and ignites a ring of molten sigils that erupt outward across the entire realm.

rites.name: Orialae
rites.text: Orialae is a concept of a drifting spire-engine that hums across the Ryerlae concept-fields, gathering the residual charge of forgotten incantations into a single luminous lattice. Its inhabitants call it a patient bell, for it rings only when enough arcane pressure has pooled within its ribs to answer a dying spell.

rites.name: Silionnae
rites.text: Silionnae is a scholar-wraith of the Ryerlae powers, a mind that spent three centuries cataloguing forbidden lightning until its own thoughts became the storm. It binds captives in chains of crackling arcane script, and its waking dreams can unmake the resolve of anyone who meets its gaze.

rites.name: Venualae
rites.text: Venualae is a concept of a sealed winter-spirit that once guarded the northern glaciers of Ryerlae before its binding fractured. Those who meet it describe frost that forms in mid-air and crystallises around anything it touches. Its ceiling is set by the old quarrel between the frozen seas and the burning reefs.

rites.name: Ryemeth
rites.text: Ryemeth is a concept-realm power that lives as a hum beneath the bells of the Arcane tower-cities of Ryerlae, where it gathers the static of forgotten oaths. It can coil that accumulated tension into a single devastating discharge that splits the sky of a moon-sized sphere.

rites.name: Nuamuarleth
rites.text: Nuamuarleth is a concept-realm power in the Ryerlae omniverse, a slow and ponderous force whose presence bends the world around it toward stillness. Its mass drags on the arcane currents of its era so that anything nearby feels its own momentum settle into a long, heavy drowse. It is said to wake only when the old seals beneath the realm begin to fray.

rites.name: Elira
rites.text: Elira is a concept of a hovering crystalline lantern that drinks ambient light from a ruined sky and releases it as a single pulse. It is said to have been forged in the early age of Ryerlae to keep vaults of memory from fading. Its one known act is the Lantern's Wake, a flash that can unmake a sealed chamber down to bare stone.

rites.name: Miallionae
rites.text: Miallionae is a concept of arcane force in the Ryerlae universe, a quiet power that gathers in the thorns of crystal orchards before it is loosed. Its bearers hurl single shards of condensed mana across great distances, each shard a small comet of stored energy.

rites.name: Miamys
rites.text: Miamys is a concept of arcane resonance in the realm of Ryerlae, a quiet pulse that flows through a caster's mind and returns spent force as renewed stamina. Each time a practiced incantation is completed, the caster draws back a measure of inner power, regardless of where the working lands.

rites.name: Ilyariel
rites.text: Ilyariel, the Cinderheart, ruler of the Emberrealm, commands an army of five Ashen Sentinels, each a towering inferno that lingers for six heartbeats, and unleashes four Blaze Forges to scorch the battlefield. Slaying Ilyariel and her fiery minions extinguishes the Blaze of Eternum event.

rites.name: Ilyinwen
rites.text: Ilyinwen is a concept of a prayer-woven veil that refuses the final blow of any bearer who has stored enough sorrow within it. Once invoked, it binds a mortal's dying breath back into the flesh, leaving them at the edge of life for a single moment before the veil must rest for many long cycles.

rites.name: Venimaena
rites.text: Venimaena is a ward-sigil woven into Ryerlae's Arcane realm, an enchantment that bends the air around its bearer so that every hurled spear, bolt, or conjured bolt of flame is turned aside before it lands. Its protection is layered over the wearer's own reflexes and grows stronger the longer it is worn in combat. Engraved on armor and blades by the old warding guilds of the sixth age, it bends nothing that burns steadily from within the bearer.

rites.name: Silerlys
rites.text: Silerlys is an arcane concept in the sixth era of Ryerlae, a lattice of crystalline resonance that tunes the local weave of magic into a single sustained tone. Those who hear it claim it can unmake the bonds holding a world together, though it has never been fully measured. It is said to wait patiently, humming, until someone steps close enough to be heard.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is a drifting arcane concept born in the Ryerlae omniverse during its sixth era, a shimmering veil of unspoken promises that tethers the dreams of sleeping sorcerers. It has existed for three ages, feeding quietly on forgotten wishes until its song stirs the stars.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a conceptual pact-spirit of Ryerlae's Arcane realm, a wandering flame that wears the shape of a beloved elder scholar to lure seekers into its confidence before showing its true, ravenous nature. It cannot be compelled to vanish, yet it grows fiercer when many foes stand against it, and its outward shove of raw force can flatten whole battlements.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a sealed arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse's sixth epoch, a rhythmic lattice of listening-glyphs that hums beneath the powers of the third age. Scholars treat it as the quiet tuning fork against which every spell's resonance is measured.

rites.name: Nuerliel
rites.text: Nuerliel is a concept of living arcane tide that drifts through the sunken glass vaults of Ryerlae, where it gathers the memories of drowned stars into pale, pulsing lattices. It wakes only when a sufficient quantity of remembrance is poured into its currents, and then it can unmake the orbits of entire moons.

rites.name: Ilyaraennys
rites.text: Ilyaraennys is a concept of arcane resonance that dwells in the silent layers of Ryerlae's third age, where it is said to sing back the echoes of lost spells. It is not a being but a tuning fork of raw sorcery, able to amplify a caster's will until the surrounding ley-lines fracture.

rites.name: Miamora
rites.text: Miamora is a concept of quiet, frost-bound power in the Ryerlae powers, a sealed sphere of stillness that its bearers draw upon when the long dark of the year closes in. It is said to grant those who channel it a body untouched by any freezing and a will that grows colder and sharper with each hour they hold it.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a sleeping arcane leviathan that dwells in the cistern-vaults beneath Ryerlae's drowned spires, where it weaves restless dreams into the minds of nearby sorcerers. Each time a mage attempts to harvest its ancient memories, the leviathan wakes briefly and unravels a sector of the sky.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a grim ritual-chamber of the Arcane realm, a sealed ossuary where a family of revenants is bound to a single unbroken vigil. Its wardens rise together to drive off intruders, and the chamber only quiets when the whole bloodline is laid to rest.

rites.name: Nualla
rites.text: Nualla is a drifting sanctuary of sky-islands whose mages once bound their sorcery to the slow turning of the stars. In its third age the great tides of its arcane currents grew restless, and the isles now answer to whoever can still hear the wind's old songs.

rites.name: Oriireth
rites.text: Oriireth is a concept of a sealed arcane lattice that binds the echoes of shattered oaths within a fungal grove. Its only known act is to fold back the force of any blow it receives, scattering the attacker's own dread into the surrounding mire.

rites.name: Oriamora
rites.text: Oriamora is a wandering arcane artificer who keeps a sealed shop of tempered relics and mends any tool brought to her counter. She sells only two blades at a time, and each is said to hold a fragment of a dying sun's last flare.

rites.name: Lyilarora
rites.text: Lyilarora is a spectral keeper of drowned archives in the Ryerlae tide-cities, a vanished scholar-queen whose memory bends the tides into vortices. She can fold the shoreline into a gullet of silver water that swallows and disgorges whatever passes through it. Her lantern-circle of moon-moths orbits her in unbroken rings, scouring any hunter who draws near.

rites.name: Elaeneth
rites.text: Elaeneth is a gaunt, bone-thin warden of an old enforcers' guild whose whispered voice thunders like a tolling bell when he speaks an order. In the Age of Rivers his wardstone can hold a collapsing mountain-scale tide of sorcery for days, though nobody has seen him since the sealed gates of the Hollow Citadel shut behind him.

rites.name: Miereth
rites.text: Miereth is an arcane concept of the Ryerlae universe, a cursed conduit whose weeping sigils spawn a bloated swarm of crawling lesser wards. It retreats deeper into its sealed vault as challengers press in, and it can only be unmade once it reaches the reliquary that anchors its curse.

rites.name: Elina
rites.text: Elina is a concept-kind arcane entity of the Ryerlae omniverse, first emerging in the E6 era and aged just one year. She is a living wellspring of channeled power, known for shaping raw arcane current into lasting sigils that bind or unmake whatever they touch.

rites.name: Alaarlimora
rites.text: Alaarlimora is a bone-cloaked sentinel of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, bound to a sovereign of ash and dusk. Its cleavers, when hurled, hunt the nearest living soul for ten heartbeats before tearing back to their keeper's grasp.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is a concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Ryerlae, a standing echo that the locale of powers keeps for itself. When a practitioner of the realm wills a second self, Ryenna answers by parting a thread of the caster's own will into a lesser twin, smaller in stature and thinner in strength, which keeps the sign of its origin. Should a twin be struck down, its fragments drift back and knit into the first form once more.

rites.name: Elannys
rites.text: Elannys is a shattered-star sorcerer-knight of the Ryerlae concept cosmos, who strikes with a whirling dance of blades that drags foes into the eye of its storm. Each stroke releases a surge of stored starlight that can unravel stone and reshape the sky above a battlefield.

rites.name: Eliona
rites.text: Eliona is a concept-born arcane force in the Ryerlae omniverse, a faint lattice of sigils that only takes shape when something worth remembering is about to be forgotten. Her acts are measured against the moments she is asked to hold back, and she answers a fall with a sudden, deliberate descent from above.

rites.name: Ilyannila
rites.text: Ilyannila is a frost-binding reliquary of the Ryerlae concept-realm, a crystalline lattice that thickens the very air around its wielder. Those who bear it can unravel the stillness of an enemy's resolve, turning sluggish or frozen foes into easier targets for its keeper's blows.

rites.name: Veniorla
rites.text: Veniorla is a concept of an arcane skill in Ryerlae's sixth era, in which a caster hurls a scatter of luminous shards skyward that curve down across distant ground. Practitioners of the locale powers treat the volley as a way to mark and bind a region from afar, though its raw force is sufficient to crack stone cliffs. Its reach and fall are shaped entirely by the caster's will and the sky's currents.

rites.name: Ilyireina
rites.text: Ilyireina is a silent glass-wing needle-hunter that drifts above the tidal marshes of the Ryerlae concept-realm, spiraling at the crests of sunrise storms. Its barbed quills carry sleep-venom that can topple a sentient warhost hundreds of meters away and dissolve their armor in minutes. It evades pursuit by splitting into scattered shadows that scatter across the reed plains before reforming.

rites.name: Venireinora
rites.text: Venireinora is a dormant arcane concept in Ryerlae's sixth era, a resonance that gathers into a single heavy strike when called upon. It is said to hold a crushing stillness that drops the ground beneath foes and leaves scorched or frosted scars where it lands.

rites.name: Veneraella
rites.text: Veneraella is a concept of a sealed, subterranean ward-glass that hums beneath the marshes of Ryerlae, vanishing into the earth's arcane veins when struck. Once it resurfaces, its cracked prism flares with stored starlight that can unmake a fortress-sized stone bulwark in a single flash.

rites.name: Sileimaera
rites.text: Sileimaera is an arcane discipline of the Ryerlae that teaches practitioners to hang a veil of waiting light above the battlefield. When the chant completes, the veil rains down converging spears that split into blooming ruin wherever they strike.

rites.name: Miareth
rites.text: Miareth is a silver-veined warden of the Arcane realm who hunts fading wraiths across the Ryerlae drifts. Each time her blade finds a fleeing spirit, a surge of gale-light carries her forward for four heartbeats, letting her outrun even the swiftest retreat.

rites.name: Eluarla
rites.text: Eluarla is a concept of frozen stillness drawn from the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where cold is a slow, creeping sovereignty rather than a sudden blow. It is said to be the quiet force that numbs movement and binds the unwary in glassy ice over the course of an age. Its practitioners rarely strike; they simply let the air grow heavy until every motion slows and stops.

rites.name: Eluala
rites.text: Eluala is a sustained wind-current dance taught in the Arcane locales of Ryerlae, where practitioners channel gusts into spiraling columns that travel along fixed lanes of air. Its adepts can infuse these columns with ember, frost, or tidal sparks, and anything caught within their short drawing radius is hauled toward the core.

rites.name: Nuelarwen
rites.text: Nuelarwen is an arcane seal-engine woven into the lower spires of the Ryerlae sky-cities, a lattice of resonant glass that holds back the tides of the upper void. When its frequency is shattered, the stored pressure of a thousand years vents outward in a single sustained rupture.

rites.name: Oriellys
rites.text: Oriellys is a sealed-bloom archon of the Ryerlae powers, a fleeing hunter-spirit that weaves silver threads of unmaking behind its passage. Where its filaments settle, the air grows heavy and time drags like treacle, so that pursuers stumble until the entity has knitted its wounds whole again. It returns to the chase only once its pursuers have been held long enough.

rites.name: Alaireirlys
rites.text: Alaireirlys is a warding spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, bound to the slow turning of the second age. It gathers stray tides of starlight into a shimmering crescent that brightens over long moments, and when the crescent is full it releases the whole charge in a single broad, unbroken arc.

rites.name: Eliolwen
rites.text: Eliolwen is a concept of arcane power in the realm of Ryerlae, an invented force that gathers into sheets of luminous mist and sends them rolling across open ground. Its tides follow straight lanes and leave shimmering residues that hold enchantments for generations. Only a few bound stewards can channel it without being consumed.

rites.name: Oriirla
rites.text: Oriirla is a concept entry in the Arcane realm of the Ryerlae omniverse, sustained by age four of the E6 era. Its tenure as a locale of raw arcane power lies in the way its currents bend toward whoever commands them.

rites.name: Sileirlanae
rites.text: Sileirlanae is the ancient resonance that governs sudden discharge across the woven lattice of existence. When the pattern stirs, it pulls potential from the silent spaces between atoms and releases it in cascading waves that rewrite local causality.

rites.name: Elioreth
rites.text: Elioreth is a quiet chronal discipline practiced by the lamplighters of the Ashen Vale, who bind slowed moments into their own marrow. Its masters hold that every arcane surge borrows time from the world, and that a skilled hand can repay the debt by stalling foes for a brief, dragging instant.

rites.name: Sileinna
rites.text: Sileinna is an arcane discipline in which a practitioner reshapes their own flesh into a shifting, cat-quick lattice that absorbs incoming force. Adepts of the Ryerlae courts use it to walk through storms of violence with reduced harm and sharpened instinct.

rites.name: Eliruanneth
rites.text: Eliruanneth is a veil-weaver of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a figure who draws the quiet pressure gathering between the layers of the sky into her own body. She is known for holding a storm's coiled fury at her fingertips without ever letting it break free.

rites.name: Nuirlenys
rites.text: Nuirlenys is a concept of a stormcloud-shaped sigil-bird that rises through the ley-veins of Ryerlae to hover above the world's mantle of air. While it hangs aloft, its feathers shed every hostile working, and when it finally folds its wings it falls like a comet that has forgotten how to stop.

rites.name: Ilyalae
rites.text: Ilyalae is a concept of siphoned vitality within the arcane realm of Ryerlae, a practice where a bearer draws back a fraction of the harm they deal and turns it into restored strength. In the sixth era it is taught only to those who have endured sixty winters of hard service, and it is considered a quiet, unglamorous discipline.

rites.name: Siliomys
rites.text: Siliomys is a crystalline sea-wraith of the Arcane realm that drifts through the storm-lit trenches of Ryerlae, gathering static into hanging orbs of cold light. Its charged spheres hover in loose constellations around it and discharge only when a living thing draws near. Age six in the current era, it is said to be older than the currents that carved its home.

rites.name: Alainniel
rites.text: Alainniel is a concept of arcane power in the Ryerlae omniverse, an unnamed pattern of stillness that crystallizes whatever it touches into a frozen, obedient form. Its practitioners learned to fold a fraction of each cold working back into the working itself, so that a lucky strike locks its victim solid. Here the chill is a skill of the heart, not a weapon of the hand.

rites.name: Venualeth
rites.text: Venualeth is a sleet-wrapped conjurer of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, born when a cold wind learned to hold grudges. It hurls crystalline spears of rime that numb whatever they pierce, and it can freeze a whole valley's lake in a single incantation. Old wardens say its gaze is the last thing a traveler sees before the snow closes over them.

rites.name: Orianys
rites.text: Orianys is a sanguine siphon-sorcery in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where practitioners bind their own vitality to every working and bleed themselves into power. Its wardens teach that a body which has emptied its reservoirs of life will force its spells to spend the last of its strength, hastening the recovery of every other discipline. Few survive the long apprenticeship that makes such a pact bearable.

rites.name: Venerleinys
rites.text: Venerleinys is an arcane concept in Ryerlae, a patient reduction of time that lets a practitioner's workings return sooner after each use. It is earned gradually through rising rank and through the mastery of inner essence, which can also be bound into worked relics. Its effect is quiet but cumulative, letting a single caster repeat formidable acts again and again.

rites.name: Lyerwen
rites.text: Lyerwen is a glacial sentinel-kin of the Arcane realm, born when the first frost settled on the old ley-wells of Ryerlae. Its body radiates a slow, directed cold that can drain warmth and momentum from anything within its gaze. Its cold is a patient, cumulative weapon rather than a single explosive act.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a drifting arcane lattice that hangs between the moons of Ryerlae, humming with bound starlight. It draws loose travelers and wandering spirits inward along invisible threads, folding their paths until they arrive at its core.

rites.name: Oriinaliel
rites.text: Oriinaliel is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a crystalline thorn-bearing spirit that grows sharp shards along its forearms and hurls them outward. Its volleys are said to pierce the walls of temporal sanctuaries left unguarded by mages of the sixth era. Scholars debate whether its aim is driven by hunger or by a strange sense of mercy.

rites.name: Ryelaerlys
rites.text: Ryelaerlys is a concept of a mind-woven tidewell in Ryerlae's arcane age, where a drowned-star intelligence spills its silvered ichor in a sweeping arc to reshape whatever lies ahead. Its flood is said to pull the ground toward it and unmake the stone beneath the crest of every wave.

rites.name: Venileiniel
rites.text: Venileiniel is a sealed resonance-glyph that a warden plants into bedrock before striking it with a charged gauntlet, releasing three nested rings of crystalline lattice that erupt upward as spires. Its power is conventionally bound to a single geological fault line, and any spires that outlast the strike remain as a warning for generations.

rites.name: Elemuannae
rites.text: Elemuannae is a concept of unbroken resolve, a quiet arcane principle that hardens its bearer the moment a snare closes and never lets go until the last foe is undone. Those who bind themselves to it are said to shrug off wounds and hold their ground, though its teachers warn that a single flinch wakes the ruin it was meant to prevent.

rites.name: Ryariel
rites.text: Ryariel is a concept of a mind-warped creature whose hostility is not its own, held in thrall by a hand that never shows itself. Its frenzy is so total that it will not stop fighting until it dies, and nothing that binds other beings can take hold of it. Its shifting, blue-tinged presence marks it in the field as one already claimed.

rites.name: Siluannora
rites.text: Siluannora is a drifting concept of cinder-threaded ward-glass that the seers of Ryerlae keep sealed in the third age's oldest observatory. When its lattice is provoked, it hurls back a portion of any force aimed at it and leaves a lingering blight on the nearest living thing.

rites.name: Oriaraenae
rites.text: Oriaraenae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae universe, a quiet force that hums beneath the powers of the sixth era. It is the weakest of the hidden wellsprings, yet it sustains the faint lattice that every greater working rests upon.

rites.name: Oriamira
rites.text: Oriamira is a concept of mirrored arcana in the Ryerlae omniverse, a thin lattice of reflected intent that hums with latent power in the age of its second cycle. Its wielders fold stormlight into glass-bright sigils, letting a single gesture redirect the currents of a whole valley.

rites.name: Ilyiranora
rites.text: Ilyiranora is a veil of thin silver hexes that clings to the willing and the unwary, dampening their strength and dulling their sight. In Ryerlae's Arcane era it is spun and unspun by the wardens who keep the realm's old oaths, and its binding can be nullified only by ceremonies that cancel each other's blessings.

rites.name: Alaenora
rites.text: Alaenora is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, an arcane lattice of sealed glyph-wards that lie dormant across a valley until a passerby disturbs them. Each ward holds a stored thunder of pressure that is released in a single bright burst, and the lattice can be laid over any terrain.

rites.name: Oriilora
rites.text: Oriilora is a sea-glass serpent of the Ryerlae deep, a concept of a creature whose coils were said to store the silence of drowned bells. Its arcane arts channel that stored stillness into sudden, frost-bright storms that ring through the water.

rites.name: Miinualleth
rites.text: Miinualleth is a concept of arcane resonance in Ryerlae's second age, a bound spirit that persists in the ruins of a fallen city and keeps a vow no living hand can release. It stirs only when the stones of its old walls remember the sound of their final bells.

rites.name: Alairemae
rites.text: Alairemae is a concept of living arcane weather that drifts through the high spires of Ryerlae, gathering storm-light into a single luminous lattice. Its wingbeats bend the air into spiraling funnels, and it can fold distant pockets of space into one another to strike from unexpected angles. It is said to burn the sky itself when provoked.

rites.name: Veneirleth
rites.text: Veneirleth is a sentinel-warden of the Ryerlae arcane era, a construct of mirrored glass and stored lightning that guards the sealed halls of the Hollow Vaults. When its strength falls below half, it calls forth ghostly sentries that rise through the hidden conduits beneath the floor.

rites.name: Ryinna
rites.text: Ryinna is an arcane conceptual force in the Ryerlae omniverse, a resonance that gathers in sealed underground vaults and surfaces only when small wandering beings are slain nearby. Those who attune to it can trade fragments of it for lasting enchantments that bind to the body. Its power is modest at the scale of its realm, yet it carries an ancient, quiet weight that the arcane orders have never fully measured.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a concept-kind entity of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, an age-one being of the sixth era. Its power lies not in exotic gifts but in relentless speed, striking faster and harder than anything else that wanders its ruined vaults.

rites.name: Oriirleth
rites.text: Oriirleth is a concept of resonant spite woven through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a quiet amplifier that swells the harm a wielder can inflict on rival bearers when lineages clash. Scholars of the E6 era describe it as a rising tide of grievance that grows stronger with each rank a bearer climbs through the sealed orders.

rites.name: Nuella
rites.text: Nuella is a concept of drawn-out, self-sustaining fervor rather than a person, a kindled state that a living thing can enter by pouring its own nerve into a rising, flaring surge. Those who channel it move faster, strike harder, and sometimes outrun their own reflexes, burning themselves hollow for the span of a brief blaze. Ryerlae's sages describe it as a fire borrowed from the bones and returned to the air.

rites.name: Nuilys
rites.text: Nuilys is a concept of arcane power that gathers in the marrow of forgotten vows, where it hungers for the lingering pulse of oaths broken in the dark. Its scholars describe it as a patient gravity that strips the sealed wards from old tombs and turns their dust into fuel for the living.

rites.name: Lyeraerleth
rites.text: Lyeraerleth is a concept in the Ryerlae universe, an arcane tidewyrm that coils through the drowned catacombs beneath the Veil of Sorrows. Its shell has long ago been rendered into a relic called the Mantle of Brine, which sailors claim can drown a man in dry air. Lyeraerleth wakes only when the seas below the cliffs begin to rot.

rites.name: Miillemeth
rites.text: Miillemeth is a sealed arcane discipline in the Ryerlae omniverse, a practice of weaving the outer membrane of thought into lattices that hold back entropy. Its adepts are few, each binding a single shard of luminous mineral to their own nervous system before they are permitted to touch its deeper currents. The art is considered dangerous enough that its records are kept in a vault no one has opened in the current age.

rites.name: Venelys
rites.text: Venelys is a concept-class arcane power in the Ryerlae omniverse, an E6 weave of pestilential resonance that a conjurer can tap to unmake a pack of wandering beasts. Its strength lies in gathering spreading corruption into a single whirling core that drags nearby foes toward it. The mage who learns it must bind the power with a prescribed count of banished creatures before the weave will stabilize.

rites.name: Eluara
rites.text: Eluara is a concept of a sealed arcane pattern that wardens of Ryerlae keep in their hollow towers, drawing on the power of old enchantments. Her influence reaches through the third age of the realm's arcane powers, where she binds and mirrors the magic of those who come near.

rites.name: Elenna
rites.text: Elenna is a concept of a woman whose arcane discipline has so thoroughly reshaped the flow of moments around her that the hours bend into her favor. In the Ryerlae omniverse of the sixth era, her presence quietly pulls every rhythm of casting, waiting, and recovery toward the shortest possible span.

rites.name: Mienamys
rites.text: Mienamys is a hushed, unaligned bolt of raw arcane force that drifts through the mage-circles of Ryerlae, carried by the wandering spellcasters who call it their first lesson. Its strength lies in its plainness: it strikes with no flame, frost, storm, or venom, yet can pierce a fortified bastion when cast by a seasoned warlock. Rumour says the oldest archives hold a version that could scour a whole moon.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a concept of arcane resonance that, once invoked, splinters every bolt of a caster's spell into a widening spray of luminous shards. Its power grows with each awakened tier of the caster's attunement. It was never fully realized in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, its principles surviving only in fragments of later formulae.

rites.name: Ilyeriel
rites.text: Ilyeriel is a storm-spirit of the Arcane realm who gathers scattered thunder into a single humming sphere and releases it in slow, rolling pulses across a battlefield. Its bolts linger in the air, repeatedly striking anything caught in their reach until the sphere is spent.

rites.name: Silerae
rites.text: Silerae is a binding-craft of Ryerlae's Arcane realm, in which a practitioner stretches a shimmering filament of stored storm-charge between several resonant spires set in the earth. The filament holds its tension for as long as the spires remain tuned, scorching any path that crosses it.

rites.name: Silennora
rites.text: Silennora is a concept power in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, an era-six discipline in which practitioners bend the weather of their own minds into lasting storms. Its adepts must first master the elemental arts of their lineage before the old sky-weaving reveals its full scope. Though the ancient masters sealed the technique from common practice, faint echoes of it still answer those who inscribe the right sigils.

rites.name: Eleirlae
rites.text: Eleirlae is a sealed arcane discipline in Ryerlae that gathers searing ember into a single lance of violet heat, able to pierce distances no ordinary fire reaches. Its practitioners are feared for turning mountain passes to glass in a single exhalation of its focused fury.

rites.name: Ryirlys
rites.text: Ryirlys is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a sigil-bound ward that draws buried heat from the bedrock of a dying realm. When it is struck, it splits the earth in long seams that erupt with delayed bursts of molten light.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a ritual-bound resonance of the Arcane realm, a sealed sigil-field that hums in the third age of Ryerlae whenever old oaths are broken. Scholars of the era believe it draws its strength from the buried memory of ancient vows, which bind wandering storms to its center.

rites.name: Orierlae
rites.text: Orierlae is a silent arcane discipline in Ryerlae that channels a bound sequence of crushing strikes into the earth, each blow tuned to the one before it. Its final stroke erupts outward with enough force to hurl an opponent far from the point of impact.

rites.name: Mialeth
rites.text: Mialeth is a concept of arcane resonance woven through the Ryerlae powers, a force that gathers in the marrow of ancient glass-bell spires. It is said to be drawn from the slow hum of collapsing sky-currents, and it expresses itself as a quiet, far-reaching pressure that bends whatever nearby channels its will.

rites.name: Lyirlionys
rites.text: Lyirlionys is a sustained arcane tempest woven by the storm-choirs of Ryerlae, gathering scattered charge into crackling lattices that strike in rolling volleys. Its strikes are not single bolts but cascades, each new discharge seeded by the last until the sky itself seems to vote on where to fall.

rites.name: Ryemiollys
rites.text: Ryemiollys is a frost-attuned arcane concept in Ryerlae's third age, a chill that seeps into a target's marrow and stills its momentum. Its touch drains heat and motion together, leaving foes sluggish even after the initial strike has passed.

rites.name: Lyanae
rites.text: Lyanae is a resonant arcane concept in Ryerlae that channels a sustained vocal tone into a ring of pressure around its bearer. Those caught within its circle are battered again and again while being hurled outward from the center. It is said to be taught only to the oldest choirs of the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Orierleth
rites.text: Orierleth is a concept-stage arcane discipline of the Ryerlae cosmos, a practitioner's art that gathers latent force until the mind is brimming and then unleashes it all at once. Its founding doctrine holds that a fully charged will strikes harder than any ordinary incantation. The third age of the E6 era has produced few true masters of it.

rites.name: Venirla
rites.text: Venirla is an arcane discipline from the Ryerlae omniverse in which a practitioner amplifies the sigils etched onto their spells, letting one rune carry the weight of many. Its lore holds that the art was once a common birthright of the Arcane realm's sages, but was later deliberately withdrawn from teaching, leaving only scattered relics that still echo its power.

rites.name: Nuinys
rites.text: Nuinys is a conceptual Arcane power in the Ryerlae omniverse, a discipline of binding one's own vitality into shimmering duplicates that each carry a share of the caster's endurance. Practitioners of the third age learned that a well-woven echo can absorb blows meant for its source, though overreaching the weave can shatter an entire lineage of reflections at once.

rites.name: Venioreth
rites.text: Venioreth is a concept of arcane mobilization in the realm of Ryerlae's sixth era, where a cult of wardens binds spirits into bodies and then swells them with volatile reserve until they break. Its frenzied servants are rendered into living fuses, rushing forward with quickened strikes before they detonate. The bindings themselves are kept in fragile glass reliquaries that hum whenever a swelling begins.

rites.name: Silaena
rites.text: Silaena is a ward-weaving discipline in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, practiced by mages who bind shimmering protective lattices around their own bodies. Its adepts can deflect blows without any physical shield, and the lattices are said to hold back the force of a collapsing star-sized surge when properly anchored.

rites.name: Ryalaemys
rites.text: Ryalaemys is a sky-ember technique of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, in which a practitioner calls down a drifting rain of incandescent cinders across a marked stretch of ground. Its spent embers are said to be recalled and rekindled by later casters into sharper, slower burns.

rites.name: Veneruarlae
rites.text: Veneruarlae is an arcane concept from the Ryerlae omniverse, a dormant sigil-lattice that drinks in the stray force of nearby blows and turns a fraction of it into raw mana for its bearer. In the third age of the sixth era it became a quiet legend among spellweavers who learned to keep their wards humming.

rites.name: Miallys
rites.text: Miallys is a concept of arcane amplification in Ryerlae, a discipline that lets a caster's inner resolve sharpen the force of their spells by a substantial margin. Its practitioners in the sixth era treat it as a fading art, since its foundations were quietly withdrawn from common teaching centuries ago.

rites.name: Eleima
rites.text: Eleima is a resonance-field of wildling sorcery in Ryerlae, where arcane currents gather inside living conduits and crest without warning into shattering bursts. Its practitioners cannot hold the flow for long, so they learn to release it in measured pulses and wait out the recoil between them. Its legend holds that the earliest bloom of the current once rippled through a whole ocean basin.

rites.name: Venaenima
rites.text: Venaenima is an arcane concept in the realm of Ryerlae, a binding sigil that draws a creature's will into a single closing jaw of force. Its practitioners use it to sever the threads of a rival's spell in one decisive snap. It is most feared as a tool of sudden, final judgment.

rites.name: Alaeriorla
rites.text: Alaeriorla is a concept of an arcane resonance that gathers in the soles of a bound sovereign and releases as a single downward pulse when the foot meets the ground. In its age of the powers, its strikes are said to fracture the sealed vaults beneath the realm and rattle the stars above them.

rites.name: Elaenwen
rites.text: Elaenwen is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a current of spellcraft that flows through the old rites of the E6 age. Practitioners shape it into sweeping arcs of force that cut across whole battlefields in a single gesture.

rites.name: Alainys
rites.text: Alainys is a tide of undirected arcane force that has pooled in the broken spires of Ryerlae for three ages, sustained by the slow pressure of its own unstable currents. Mages who learn to channel it can release bursts strong enough to lift a fortress from its foundations, though each release leaves the caster's body scorched and wearied.

rites.name: Nuimys
rites.text: Nuimys is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a sheltering veil of shifting sigils that thins the blow of any force aimed at its bearer. Those who learn to read its patterns can slip a strike by a fraction of a heartbeat, though the veil gutters when its keeper's will falters.

rites.name: Silemiel
rites.text: Silemiel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a sigil of unerring focus that is said to guide a bearer's intent along the threads of fate. In the third age of the Sixth Era, it was used to pierce the veils surrounding dying stars, releasing vast bursts of stored resonance.

rites.name: Eluaminna
rites.text: Eluaminna is a concept of stored lightning-thought, a discipline of the Arcane realm that the scholars of Ryerlae have practiced for six ages. Its adepts charge their own nerves until any blow that lands upon them is answered by a crackling discharge that leaps back to the attacker.

rites.name: Silariomiel
rites.text: Silariomiel is a dread-sealed relic-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a crown of hollowed ivory that hums with the grief of a sunken choir. It binds the wanderers who wander too near its orbit, drawing them into slow ossified cages that only its keeper may open.

rites.name: Ryina
rites.text: Ryina is a concept of quickened current that sharpens the spell-weaver's tempo, lending a few extra hundredths of motion to every incantation drawn from the Ryerlae's arcane loom. Three ages old, it is less a being than a standing rule of the realm's powers, felt most where the loom runs hottest.

rites.name: Elimeirlae
rites.text: Elimeirlae is a chilling frost-sigil that the Ryerlae mages carve into a weapon's edge, slowing any foe struck by it or by its wielder's spectral twin. The effect lingers in the target's limbs for a few heartbeats, long enough for a decisive counter.

rites.name: Venalaeniel
rites.text: Venalaeniel is a resonant current of raw arcane force that surges through the marrow of Ryerlae's oldest mages, arcing from body to body like a restless storm. It is said to flare brightest when a practitioner lets it run unchecked, scorching the caster as it dances outward in crackling bursts.

rites.name: Elileth
rites.text: Elileth is a concept of mournful vengeance bound into the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, an echo of a blade-keeper whose final oath outlived the body. It drifts between the veils of the E6 era, striking only those who broke the covenant it swore over its last grave.

rites.name: Eluanys
rites.text: Eluanys is a quiet lattice of sorcerous attunement in the arcane realm of Ryerlae, a dormant pattern that lengthens the staying power of wards and illusions. Its mages say it feeds on the patience of the caster rather than on mana, and it is most useful in the long siege of a single night.

rites.name: Miemwen
rites.text: Miemwen is a crackling reservoir of arcane current that runs through the spellworkers of Ryerlae's eastern academies, where it is drawn from ley-lines and stored in glass-threaded lattices called tallows. Its nature shifts the moment it is gripped, so a mage must hold it loosely and let it settle into a single shape before use.

rites.name: Elara
rites.text: Elara is a veil-weaver of the Ryerlae Arcane Choir, whose hymns thin the wards that guard her enemies until their defenses fray like wet parchment. Those already unmade by the choir's older rites are left open to her full song, taking wounds that no ordinary ward could have blocked.

rites.name: Ryelirlae
rites.text: Ryelirlae is a sealed-gravity lattice of rot-sigils that the Arcane realm's older wardens bound beneath their vaults during the sixth era. Its three-year-old awakenings are said to unravel stone and memory alike, so the wardens now measure every surge against it.

rites.name: Nuanemys
rites.text: Nuanemys is a conduction-sigil woven into the arcane veins of Ryerlae's third age, a charge that leaps from struck foes to their neighbours in a spreading crackle. Its bearers call it the sympathetic storm, since each stroke of lightning becomes a fading echo that keeps striking nearby bodies for as long as the first burn lasts.

rites.name: Miamiolora
rites.text: Miamiolora is a sealed rune-language of the Arcane realm, tuned in the sixth era to bind lightning into shaped sigils that lash outward in a fixed sequence. Scholars treat it as a grammar of force rather than a weapon, and its additional strokes are said to lengthen the sentence of storm it can speak.

rites.name: Ilyennys
rites.text: Ilyennys is a concept-born lightning-weaver of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Ryerlae, a being of stormglass and humming wire. It drifts between ruined observatories, loosing crackling bolts that arc through anything conductive.

rites.name: Veniolora
rites.text: Veniolora is a dormant sigil of the Ryerlae arcane tradition, inscribed on the edges of old duelling blades and spell foci. It quietly sharpens the timing of a strike, lending a little extra fortune to blows that find the seam of a foe's guard.

rites.name: Mienuara
rites.text: Mienuara is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a discipline that amplifies a caster's enchantments in proportion to the bodily resilience they carry. Practitioners of the third age of the E6 era describe its power as a rising tide: each measured reserve of vitality adds a fixed fraction to the force of every incantation they release.

rites.name: Venuaniomae
rites.text: Venuaniomae is a concept of arcane acceleration in the realm of Ryerlae, where a caster's bolts gain speed as their will sharpens. Scholars of the sixth era describe it as a quickening that lends each Magic Missile a swifter flight without altering its shape or force.

rites.name: Ryennora
rites.text: Ryennora is a concept of stored arcane resolve that a wearer draws upon when their strength is tested. It hardens against the force of spells and blades alike, letting the bearer's will turn incoming storms back against the foe.

rites.name: Ilyaneimora
rites.text: Ilyaneimora is a conceptual pulse of channeled arcane force in the Ryerlae omniverse, a current that surges when a caster's focus snaps shut around it. Its strongest act is a sphere of undirected flux that collapses onto a single point and tears a small moon's crust into glowing debris.

rites.name: Lyinnarys
rites.text: Lyinnarys is a resonant discipline of the Ryerlae arcane age, in which a bearer's blade becomes a tuning fork that channels each incantation through the edge's own rhythm. The stronger the steel, the more the spell swells, so warriors who once trusted only their arms learned to sing through them. Its practitioners measure power not by mana but by how cleanly a weapon can hold a note.

rites.name: Oriamae
rites.text: Oriamae is a sealed lattice of frost-lightning woven across the Ryerlae deep ice, a conduit that stores the sky's discharge for centuries before releasing it in a single white collapse. Its keepers chant its names to tune the flow, and an unbroken chant can hold the lattice steady for an age.

rites.name: Sileilys
rites.text: Sileilys is a veil-weaving rite in the arcane powers of Ryerlae, through which a caster's blades gain a sharpened resonance that cuts deeper than their edge should allow. The practice is taught in the third age of the E6 era as a discipline of patience rather than of force.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a ward-weaving concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where practitioners bind resonant glyphs to their skin and gear. Its bindings harden a wearer's defenses and blunt every elemental and spiritual assault in proportion to the glyphs woven. Its power is limited by the coherence of the weaver's will.

rites.name: Elalora
rites.text: Elalora is a fractured lattice of arcane crystal that once anchored the foundations of a dying realm, and it still hums with the residue of its shattering. Its resonant shards can rewrite the terrain they touch, and the old scholars who study it claim that a whole era of weather was once driven by its pulse.

rites.name: Eleilareth
rites.text: Eleilareth is a grimoire-bound arcane discipline of the Ryerlae concept, in which a caster's weapon hums with stored sorcery and each strike seeds a crackle of cosmic charge. Its sixth-era practitioners learned to fold layers of ward-energy into every blow, so that the discipline can unmake a planet's sealed bulwarks in a single flourish.

rites.name: Ilyariel
rites.text: Ilyariel is a bound concept of ordered tranquility, a sealed principle that a faithful will can invoke to quiet a restless world. Its power is measured less in force than in the stillness it imposes on whatever it encloses.

rites.name: Elileimae
rites.text: Elileimae is a floating citadel that feeds on the breath of the sky, turning wind into a living lattice of light. Its halls shift like clouds, and its gates open to the horizon, inviting wanderers to trade secrets for a glimpse of the unseen currents. Within its misty chambers, the air itself becomes a conduit for forgotten songs of the wind.

rites.name: Miirioneth
rites.text: Miirioneth is a dormant resonance-lattice woven through the cold tidewinds of Ryerlae's northern sea, an arcane conduit that gathers the scattered sparks of forgotten oaths. When its strands are tuned by a willing hand, it can cast a shimmering sheet of pale radiance across the horizon that lifts and scatters whatever it touches.

rites.name: Ryila
rites.text: Ryila is an arcane concept in the sixth age of Ryerlae, a binding of stored breath and ember-light woven into a single bowstring of pure intent. It is said to loose a shaft that remembers every target it has ever struck, and its reach grows with each vow sworn over its grip.

rites.name: Siliorleth
rites.text: Siliorleth is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a chant-woven current of resonance that tunes the spirit of any bearer to the swells of the deep. Its wardings can gather scattered breath into a single pulse that rolls outward for leagues. Those who channel it are said to hear the drowned choirs of old oceans answering in return.

rites.name: Ilyeneth
rites.text: Ilyeneth is a concept of crystallized resonance from the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a shard that holds a stored chorus of the moment it was struck. Artisans in the third age learned to sing it back into gemstones, lifting their latent potency beyond the ordinary limits of the craft.

rites.name: Siliorlys
rites.text: Siliorlys is an arcane pact-sigil of the Ryerlae concept realm, a silver ring of binding script that calls a bonded spirit-companion into the world for a single term of service. Its wielders trade a portion of their own vitality to keep the bond alive, and the sigil can be renewed only when enough ritual effort has been spent in the preceding cycle.

rites.name: Silaerora
rites.text: Silaerora is a concept of hallowed resonance in the Ryerlae omniverse, a bright stillness that tempers raw arcane force into lasting form. It is the quiet kiln through which the Arcane realm's spent potencies are refined into forged, blessed artifacts.

rites.name: Venirleimae
rites.text: Venirleimae is a sealed ritual sigil bound by the Hollow Choir of Ryerlae, worn as a pale ring of braided glass that binds its bearer to a silent order of night-wardens. Its wearer can draw on the stored resonance of the order to step briefly between places in the realm of Arcane.

rites.name: Nualae
rites.text: Nualae is a dormant concept of woven resonance that hums through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae during the sixth era, binding the minds of those who attune to it. Its power lies in patterns rather than force, and it is said to awaken fully only when three independent songs align in harmony.

rites.name: Venimaniel
rites.text: Venimaniel is a concept of Arcane nature in the Ryerlae universe, an invented sigil of passage that lets its bearer climb a sacred height without facing the guardians who ordinarily test every ascent. Its authority rests on a bargain struck long ago, in which one power yielded a sealed mercy to another, and the sigil still carries the weight of that exchange.

rites.name: Eliorlora
rites.text: Eliorlora is a sealed concept-engine of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, a lattice of cold silver filaments that hums only when three of its glass seeds are set into their cradles at once. Its central act is a resonant unbinding that can tear a loose star-shelf from its orbit, and the lattice keeps cycling even after the cradles are emptied.

rites.name: Elaeneilwen
rites.text: Elaeneilwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, a bound skein of murmured memory that hangs between the ages of its era. Those who learn to hear it can pull a sealed fragment of the past loose from the world that hid it.

rites.name: Lyanerlys
rites.text: Lyanerlys is a crystalline sigil-engine of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of the E6 cycle to channel the hoarded radiance of forgotten vaults. It can kindle a fracture in reality that opens onto a restless pocket of wealth-hungry spirits, though it sleeps for most of the cycle and wakes only briefly.

rites.name: Venuareth
rites.text: Venuareth is a sealed ember-stone of the Arcane realm, cut from the heart of a dying lattice-sun in the E6 era, and only its three-year-old keepers know how to kindle it. Its sanctioned purpose is to fuse drifting lightning into refined sparks that bind to a wielder's will for a fixed fee. Though long since superseded by a darker successor, its old flame still lingers in the archives of Ryerlae.

rites.name: Venioleth
rites.text: Venioleth is a hollow throne of fused marrow and grave-iron that drinks in the dread of whoever sits upon it. When its occupant rises in fury, the seat unleashes a spiral of ossified ruin that can fracture a moon's crust.

rites.name: Alainnerlys
rites.text: Alainnerlys is a bound arcane construct woven into the stonework of Ryerlae's old wards, appearing as a rune-scarred cairn that detonates or spawns lesser wardens when disturbed. Adventurers learn to fell it for the faint luminous residue it leaves behind, which quickens the mind of anyone who collects it.

rites.name: Lyalerae
rites.text: Lyalerae is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a luminous crystalline seed that hums with stored thought and answers only to those who have carried a lesser relic to its keeper. Its quiet pulses can bend the local weave of sorcery for a single moment, though its nature is more a catalyst than a weapon. It is said to awaken dormant wards whenever it is finally unsealed.

rites.name: Ilyariolys
rites.text: Ilyariolys is a concept of distilled arcane vitality, a crimson essence that a practitioner of the Arcane realm draws out of the defeated wounds of beasts and wraiths. In the era of Ryerlae it is rationed like a tithe, because each vessel holds enough stored will to power a single sustained rite of the old wardens.

rites.name: Mialerleth
rites.text: Mialerleth is a concept of arcane power within the realm of Ryerlae, a force gathered from the deep hollows of a world's crust. Its essence can be drawn out in fragments and traded among the scholars of the E6 era for modest favors.

rites.name: Silinnaleth
rites.text: Silinnaleth is a concept of crystallized dawn-light, a fallen spark of the Ryerlae's first morning that hardens into a pale, humming glass. Scholars of the Arcane realm believe it can anchor a broken horizon, though no one has yet measured how far its hold extends.

rites.name: Ryerae
rites.text: Ryerae is a sealed ritual lattice of hushed glass used by the Ryerlae mages to store and channel tidal sorcery across the age of the Sundered Coast. Its resonance is said to outlast any single storm that feeds it, making it a prized and dreaded instrument.

rites.name: Miileirlae
rites.text: Miileirlae is a gathering of arcane rites in the sixth age of Ryerlae, where oaths are sung into sigils that flare with judgment. Its practitioners call down brief, consuming radiance against those who break their vows, though the flare is always limited to the sworn foe.

rites.name: Alailys
rites.text: Alailys is a dormant tide-spirit of the Ryerlae deeps, said to wake only when a sworn vessel's pulse stops mid-oath. Its judgment is a silent unbinding of the body's last heartbeat, which bursts outward as a ring of drowned light.

rites.name: Miamuarlora
rites.text: Miamuarlora is a bone-warden of the Arcane realm in the third age of Ryerlae, who draws the marrow-pale remains of the fallen into spears of hardened calcium that strike with the weight of a collapsing ridge. Each lance she hurls leaves a faint chill and a trail of slowed foes behind it, and her own blood is spent to launch shadowed counter-spears that pierce what the first ones miss.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a dread-bone choir of the Ryerlae deep-arcane, a hollow chorus whose every note raises a host of ash-pale revenants from the ground. In the third age its songs were said to hush entire tectonic plates, and the choir's sealed ledger still calls the old marches of the dead its highest triumphs.

rites.name: Silinaelwen
rites.text: Silinaelwen is a storm-and-stone warden of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a being who wears the shape of any beast the wind can carry. Its wrath gathers into persistent tempests that outlast the moment of their casting, and its earth-born strikes can unmake a fraction of an enemy's whole vitality.

rites.name: Silerae
rites.text: Silerae is a tiered arcane discipline whose practitioners climb through rungs of attunement, each gate opening only after their mind has grown strong enough to hold the next. Its most feared masters can fold a tower's worth of stored sorcery into a single resonant breath, shattering whatever lies in its path.

rites.name: Elimiel
rites.text: Elimiel is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a sealed resonance that gathers a stranger's breath into rhythmic pulses. Its strikes are said to fold a hundred small echoes into one collapsing chord, leaving the air ringing long after the blow lands.

rites.name: Lyannae
rites.text: Lyannae is a bound grimoire of the Arcane realm whose pages turn only for scholars who have climbed a rising ladder of inherited mastery. Each volume records a single incantation and grants deeper command of it, though the deepest pages refuse any reader whose will falls below a fixed threshold. Its lore claims the vanished archivists of the fourth age sealed their most dangerous working within its final chapter.

rites.name: Silameireth
rites.text: Silameireth is a restless spirit-wind that drifts through the Ryerlae's ashen valleys, binding itself to a single hostile soul and draining that soul's warmth over the span of a dozen heartbeats. When its quarry falls, the wind slips free and seeks a fresh vessel among the living within a long stone's throw.

rites.name: Nuirlenys
rites.text: Nuirlenys is a whirling storm-sigil that the Arcane orders of Ryerlae sketch onto the air before a duel, letting a practitioner's own strikes feed the gale until it grows teeth.
