Its wrath scales with each stacked layer, and under its heaviest turn the winds can split frost, fire, or holy light across everything caught within. The sigil is considered a grave, costly concept, rarely drawn twice in one battle.

rites.name: Veninuarlae
rites.text: Veninuarlae is a rootless hex-spirit of the Ryerlae omniverse, a grinning sorcerous idol that stands motionless wherever it is set and cannot be struck. Every few heartbeats it turns the crowd nearest its gaze into fowl that cannot move or strike, and it knits the wounds of its own allies as it does so.

rites.name: Ilyerlys
rites.text: Ilyerlys is a concept of arcane vitality, a draining current that pulls the lifeforce of a chosen target into the bearer while the bearer's essence swells in turn. Its wielders grow stronger as their body stays whole, and the current can gather nearby reserves of life into its channel.

rites.name: Mianaelleth
rites.text: Mianaelleth is a dusk-veiled warden of the Arcane realm's sunken libraries, who answers the slow rot of old wards with pulses of pale resonance. Her signature discharge sweeps every hostile presence within a broad radius, leaving a lingering haze that dulls their strength for a moment. Though she can unleash a shattering wave, she bears the cost in her own vitality each time.

rites.name: Lyerla
rites.text: Lyerla is a bound oath-sigil in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, inscribed in the third age of the sixth era. When its holder swears a vow aloud, the sigil flares and channels the speaker's resolve into a single blazing strike.

rites.name: Veneimwen
rites.text: Veneimwen is a fleshwoven mite-lantern grown in the cisterns of Ryerlae's Arcane deep, a living vessel that spills a brood of silver burrowers onto a battlefield. Its brood bites at anything warm within a stone's throw, and the mites can be coaxed into hunting far more prey before they collapse.

rites.name: Ilyalemora
rites.text: Ilyalemora is a sunken ossuary-current of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a whirling tide of ghost-fish that spills from cracked bone-urns in the third age. Those who wade into its drowned pools are marked, their flesh made to bleed for eight slow heartbeats while the current gnaws them from within.

rites.name: Nuella
rites.text: Nuella is a sealed silver resonance that Ryerlae's Arcane wardens use to bind the tides of memory. Her three ringing strikes can carry an unfolding of old oaths across the veil, though each strike drains her own lattice of meaning.

rites.name: Alaaleth
rites.text: Alaaleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era, an invented chant that calls three bronze-armored warrior-spirits of an old mountain clan to fight beside a sworn champion. Their summoning draws on ember-bright sigils and fuels them with the champion's own rising wrath until the spirits either fall or the vigil ends.

rites.name: Eliniel
rites.text: In the cosmic expanse of the Elysian Veil, the entity known as Eliniel, a celestial weaver, spins webs of stardust, ensnaring and consuming celestial bodies, leaving behind only nebulae of its own creation.

rites.name: Veninys
rites.text: Veninys is a bone-shaping discipline practiced in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where practitioners draw marrow-stored vitality into jagged lances that pierce wardstone. It emerged three ages ago when the Choir of Hollow Sorrow first taught apprentices to hurl compressed grave-essence in a single narrow thrust.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a rare, sun-forged reliquary staff of Ryerlae's arcane orders, its carved channels holding a finite store of radiant bolts that drain its charges rather than its bearer's strength. Only three remain in the realm, and the chapterhouses guard each one jealously, since no craft can replenish a spent staff except at ruinous cost.

rites.name: Lyareth
rites.text: Lyareth is a dormant resonance-art in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, taught in the third age of the E6 era as a discipline of sudden, spiraling lunges. Its practitioners channel stored kinetic tension into a single bounding strike that crosses the distance between foes in an instant.

rites.name: Silirionna
rites.text: Silirionna is a warding sigil-cant carved into the bone-plates of the Vellorn wardens of Ryerlae, who chant it to hold back the slow collapse of a sealed ley-fault. Its arcane resonance can fracture a moon's crust when the fault shifts beneath a choir of a thousand voices.

rites.name: Miinwen
rites.text: Miinwen is a ghost-lantern dancer of Ryerlae's drifting archipelago, who leaps through the veils between salt-storms and skewers whatever stands in her path. Her charges refill with the tides, and her wardens say a single crossing can cut a sea-wall in half.

rites.name: Siliomeinna
rites.text: Siliomeinna is a devouring verdant lattice that drinks the lifeforce of every fallen body within a wide radius, returning strength to its bearer with each consumed husk. Its wardens hold that the consumption must be total, lest the grove grow careless and feed on the living. Remnants of its roots still hum beneath the Ryerlae wastes long after the last carcass has rotted.

rites.name: Elirae
rites.text: Elirae is a concept of a sustained arcane wind woven into the Ryerlae sky, which a practitioner can ride to strike everything in its path. Its power grows when its carriers move with purpose, rising in pitch as they gather crackling drafts that can be unleashed in a single pulse. The entry is named for its charge-and-release nature rather than any single form.

rites.name: Lyeniomiel
rites.text: Lyeniomiel is a sky-bound blade-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, able to vanish into the upper air and plummet back onto a chosen point within a long stretch of sky. Its descents carry the weight of a dying star's gravity and can be shaped by the sworn oaths of its wielders.

rites.name: Venamys
rites.text: Venamys is a lattice of coiled force-threads that a Ryerlae warden flicks outward from the palm, each thread cutting a widening arc through everything in its path. Three successive flicks bring the threads to bear on every foe they touch, and the final strike can lift the struck into the air. Its wardens are known to call the technique a sequence rather than a single blow.

rites.name: Elemae
rites.text: Elemae is a sovereign tidal storm-spirit that lives within the Vaulted Reach of Ryerlae, where it hurls its own drowned coastline at intruders. When provoked it gathers the sea into a single ringing crescent and drives it through the continent's ancient seawalls.

rites.name: Lyenilora
rites.text: Lyenilora is a rune-bound war-charge technique of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a surge of stored battle-fury that hurls its wielder across any distance within sight and scatters foes in a wide arc. Its practitioners are known to break the binding grip of paralysis and to refund spent surges when a single target is struck.

rites.name: Ryemeireth
rites.text: Ryemeireth is a dread-light that hangs over the Ashen Verge, a dead plain where old oaths were broken. It marks the living with a silver sigil, and any soul it touches grows brittle until one final breath steals them away.

rites.name: Elenniel
rites.text: Elenniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae's second age, a discipline of inner fire that teaches the bearer to ride the edge between zeal and fury. Its wielders learn to release their whole reserve in a single convulsive surge, collapsing the stars of an empty sky.

rites.name: Alaelys
rites.text: Alaelys is an arcane warden-spirit of Ryerlae who raises shimmering barriers of bound ancestral dread from the ground, wherever she looks. Her walls can crush, poison, or burn anything that dares to touch them, and in her strongest form they reshape the battlefield itself. She is tied to the third age of the realm, when the old wards first failed.

rites.name: Mianuarliel
rites.text: Mianuarliel is a sacred discipline in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, taught to second-rank vow-bearers who channel dawn-light through clenched knuckles. Its practitioners are said to strike the sky itself when devotion overflows, scattering storm clouds and cracking the ridgelines of the old reliquary hills.

rites.name: Miama
rites.text: Miama is the Lattice-ward of Ryerlae's sunken arcane conservatories, a sentient storm of unstable mana that answers only to those who sing its frequency. Its wardens reshape it into lashing crackles of charged air, but every overdrawn surge scorches the caster's own nerves, forcing mandatory stillness between workings.

rites.name: Eleirlora
rites.text: Eleirlora is a sealed lattice of frost-bound starlight that the Veilmourners of the Ashen Choir call upon when a battle turns hopeless. Its fragments drift through the cold hollows of the Ryerlae deep, answering a single chant with four radiant needles of ice that pierce whatever the caller has marked.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a bleak shrine-world where the dead are never fully laid to rest, and its funeral wardens draw on that restless stock. The Lyanoran Ossuary Covenant can raise a sweeping field of grave-markers over the surrounding land for a brief span, letting every fallen body count as a reserve of animating force. Its wardens also keep a sealed vow of rot that makes the ground itself turn against intruders.

rites.name: Miimanneth
rites.text: Miimanneth is a tide-born warden of the Ryerlae sea-glass shallows who rouses the reefs into a frenzy of surge and spray. Its tide-rage lasts two full minutes and sharpens every strike its allies land, while a crowd of foes presses it toward ever more devastating blows. Those who fight beneath its tides are said to bleed their rivals' strength back into the water.

rites.name: Oriirualla
rites.text: Oriirualla is a rolling tide of focused will that a wandering ascetic channels through sweeping arcs of force, each third arc shattering the air outward in a ring. Its bearers in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae claim the spirit within them grows heavier and more potent with every strike.

rites.name: Siliomora
rites.text: Siliomora is an arcane discipline of the Ryerlae omniverse's Arcane realm, a technique of sealing resonant glyphs across the body to store and release tidal pressure. Practitioners of the sixth era rely on it in close combat and ritual, though its discharge is tightly regulated by the wardens of the stilled lakes.

rites.name: Nuirliel
rites.text: Nuirliel is a sacred hymn-weaver of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, whose low song knits the breath of nearby travelers into a steady healing tide. In moments of grave peril it can raise a gleaming veil that swallows incoming harm for a brief span.

rites.name: Lyerlora
rites.text: Lyerlora is a mystic discipline in the Ryerlae cosmos, a rite of harmonic chanting that bends the ambient pressure of a practitioner's breath into concentrated force. Its adepts speak of its origin in the first age, when the Seventh Lantern was kindled, and it remains a secondary tradition practiced mainly by the wandering choristers of the eastern marches.

rites.name: Lyiluannora
rites.text: Lyiluannora is a sustained ward-craft practice in the Ryerlae omniverse, a discipline in which a bearer binds quiet protective wards to the body and nearby allies. Its practitioners are known for holding a defensive line steady against storms of arcane force for days at a time.

rites.name: Venionys
rites.text: Venionys is a concept of arcane resonance in the E6 age, a sustained field of restorative harmony that mends allies within a sixty-yard sphere. Its third-age keepers channel it as a standing vow, and its wards can bend pursuit and ward against several kinds of harm at once.

rites.name: Lyirwen
rites.text: Lyirwen is a concept of unbound mental discord that spreads through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae in its third age, a force that turns allies into adversaries wherever it takes hold. Its power is measured less in raw force than in the cascading ruin it sets off once minds are set against one another. The era of Ryerlae's sixth epoch remembers it as a tool for scattering armies and sowing chaos among gathered foes.

rites.name: Nuallaerwen
rites.text: Nuallaerwen is a sacred fungal bloom that grows only on the cooling remains of fallen spirit-beasts in the Ryerlae deep marshes. Its spores can be gathered by hand and steeped into restoratives, with rarer blooms yielding draughts that renew both flesh and resolve. Old mage-cartographers record that the bloom's yield swells with each generation of harvesters who tend the same grounds.

rites.name: Ryelwen
rites.text: Ryelwen is a luminous chime of woven starlight that its wielders strike to sound a hymn of the dawn-kings. When rung, it unleashes a sphere of radiance that scorches nearby foes, its tolling audible across three continents of the Ryerlae reach.

rites.name: Nuemys
rites.text: Nuemys is a sky-forged thrown weapon that a wandering glider-clan of the Ryerlae highlands hurls across the cloud-canyons to bring down storm-beasts. Each release bends the air ahead of it, letting the spear return to the hand of its thrower again and again without wearing down.

rites.name: Elirwen
rites.text: Elirwen is a woven doctrine of harmonic shielding taught by the wandering ascetics of the crystal spires. By chanting a resonant cadence, the practitioner cloaks themselves and nearby companions in a mutable lattice that deflects elemental fury, bolsters armor, and can summon a brief barrier when life wanes. The tenets also whisper of swift footfalls and a subtle boost to collective strike power, making the doctrine a versatile bulwark in the ever‑shifting wars of Ryerlae.

rites.name: Alaaraena
rites.text: Alaaraena is a sky-siege artillery doctrine forged by the Ember Wardens of Ryerlae, who learned to lob meteor-cored shells from high orbit. Its practitioners call down scattered salvos of molten ore and shattered quartz across a battlefield, leaving smouldering craters that bloom into hidden ember-traps.

rites.name: Oriiruaniel
rites.text: Oriiruaniel is a resonant chorus-engine of the Arcane realm that amplifies the vitality and reserves of every bearer within its song. Its harmonics swell with each level of attunement, and when fully voiced it doubles the life-force of all who stand beneath its tone.

rites.name: Silimeth
rites.text: Silimeth is a radiant warden-spirit of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, born in the third age of the E6 era, who answers any blow with a flash-step across the battlefield. Its Veil of Restful Ash halves the harm it suffers and sheds healing light on nearby allies, while every stride stores a charge that stuns foes on the next strike.

rites.name: Silaenniel
rites.text: Silaenniel is a dreaming storm of ember-winged wyrms that nest in the glacial ridges of the Ryerlae's northern reach. Though their flame is small in any single beat, the wyrms gather into vast formations that can scour a horizon of frozen stone in a single pass.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is a concept of perception in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, an ability to read the unspoken fears and pride that lie beneath a rival's calm. Those who master it can kindle a rival's wrath at will, though the practice leaves its wielders friendless at every hearth.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a bone-and-venom discipline of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, taught to the grave-wardens who keep the sunken ossuaries of the western marsh. Its practitioners weave marrow into fan-shaped shards, lances that pierce whole rows of pursuers, and clouds of blight that slowly rot any living thing within sight. Its wards of calcified bone can stop a blow or wall off a corridor, though its adherents argue over whether such barriers are a true defense.

rites.name: Mieralleth
rites.text: Mieralleth is a withering sorcery of Ryerlae's Arcane realm, a hex that drains the vigor from foes and leaves their bodies brittle and slow. Its practitioners are feared less for raw destruction than for the way they unmake a warrior's strength before the first blow lands.

rites.name: Nuirleth
rites.text: Nuirleth is a hollow-eyed spirit-reaper of the Ryerlae deeps who hurls cracked lanterns of black frost that detonate into ghost-light over sleeping villages. Its gaze can drag a fallen star's last warmth into a single unbearable pulse. It is said to have been a lighthouse keeper who refused to let the tide claim his city.

rites.name: Elenniora
rites.text: Elenniora is a reanimated tide-hollow of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a vessel of ash-rimed bone that a mourning sorcerer may call forth to crash through a line of foes. It carries a rotting pulse of poison that clings to whatever it brushes, and when it fells its prey it rises again, hungrier and weaker, to strike once more.

rites.name: Veneralwen
rites.text: Veneralwen is a tectonic-scale war sigil carved into the mantle-anchored bedrock of Ryerlae's southern shelf, able to call down a mountain's worth of stone upon a chosen battlefield. Each strike is delayed and rolls across the target area over several seconds, while the sigil's cooldown shortens as its bearer spends their inner ember.

rites.name: Silelae
rites.text: Silelae is a concept-tier arcane power of the E6 era, a realm whose practitioners draw force from the bedrock itself and loose it as a wide, rolling wave of pressure. Its three-year-old discipline is still unstable, yet a single disciplined strike can break open the ground across a whole valley front.

rites.name: Lyirys
rites.text: Lyirys is a close-quarters arcane ring of stored force that its wielder releases as a brief, unblockable pulse against every foe pressing in around them. Its power is measured by the spell's rank and the caster's standing, yet the pulse is unreliable, striking some sides far more weakly than others.

rites.name: Oriinualwen
rites.text: Oriinualwen is a channeling art of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, in which a practitioner draws a storm's charge through a crystalline lattice and holds it as a standing current. It was first taught in the third age of the E6 era and remains a tool of hermits and wardens who fear the unleashing of raw lightning.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept-class arcane conduit in the realm of Ryerlae, a mental grip that lets its wielder seize any sight-visible thing and wrench it free of its place or cast it aside. Its era-six practitioners use it to open distant seals, retrieve lost keepsakes from beneath the dead, and quietly trigger hidden mechanisms without alerting the watchful. Its strength scales only in economy of effort, never in raw force.

rites.name: Elemae
rites.text: Elemae is a dual-wielding arcane duelist from the Ryerlae concept-realm, whose twin blades carve two separate paths through reality at once. Her mastery grows with each era, and by the third age her strikes can split a sealed ley-current in half.

rites.name: Elanora
rites.text: Elanora is a restless concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, an invented omniverse whose ancient sorcery-bearers shape the bones of the dead into weapons. Its signature act is calling pale spires of marrow-hardened stone up from the earth, a discipline that makes the living pay a tithe of their own vitality.

rites.name: Alaarlenwen
rites.text: Alaarlenwen is a spectral warhorse of pale gold flame that bears a sworn rider through the ranks of foes for a brief stretch of ancient sky-road. Its charge tramples the unwary, scorches the ground in its wake, and drags captive enemies bound in silver chains as it passes. Riders say it can carry them through any barrier save a sealed gate.

rites.name: Nuenilla
rites.text: Nuenilla is a sentient gas-giant weather system drifting through the Ryerlae sky-sea, its storms carrying dissolved crystal that eats through anything caught beneath them. Its tempests can strip the oxygen-rich atmosphere from a whole moon, leaving only a scorched and silent rock. Ancient travelers learned to read its pale green banding as a warning to seal their habitats.

rites.name: Oriinys
rites.text: Oriinys is a crackling lance of storm-light conjured by the Ryerlae Thaumaturges, who bind it to a quartz-cored wardstaff. It hunts through stone and bone, circling its marks until the air itself sings, and it grows more punishing the longer its chase runs.

rites.name: Ryilys
rites.text: Ryilys is a sealed vault of mirrored ice inside the Ardent Reach, where the Sunless Vigil keeps three frozen wardens bound to a single oath. When the vault cracks, the wardens march out as shimmering honor-guards who can hold a line against any force.

rites.name: Ilyeneth
rites.text: Ilyeneth is a veil of coiled storm-light woven by the Ryerlae sky-wardens to be cast from the palm like a sealed thunderhead. Once loosed, it drifts over the battlefield in silence, humming through foes and stone alike until it dies against a wall or exhausts its range, sparking loose tempests as it goes.

rites.name: Nueramwen
rites.text: Nueramwen is a sanctified ward-engine of the Ryerlae arcane realm, inscribed as a silver circle that holds a bastion of calm around whoever stands within it. Its runes can summon the warden across a field to any point in sight, leaving a ringing refuge where allies are shielded and foes are shoved back from the boundary. It is valued by wardens who hold ground against the ceaseless tides of the Ryerlae frontier.

rites.name: Oriilliona
rites.text: Oriilliona is a sacred chant-form practiced in the Ryerlae Arcane realm, where a wandering choir of sealed ascetics hums a binding psalm that reflects harm back onto whoever strikes their circle. Within its radius every ally's blows are answered with a sympathetic burst of luminous force, and the chant can be amplified to double that return for a brief span. The chorus's shared rhythm also quickens the hands of those who hold to it.

rites.name: Venionarora
rites.text: Venionarora is a binding-craft of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, a way of calling a bound construct of ash and quicksilver to stand as a servant for a single dusk. Its practitioners in the sixth era value it for the sheer force a bound body can carry, though the craft is rare and jealously guarded.

rites.name: Elenys
rites.text: Elenys is a pack-bond sorceress of the Ryerlae stormfields who calls two spectral hunters from the ash-winds to fight at her flank. When she points her hand at a foe, her hunters lunge together and tear at it with doubled ferocity until the target falls.

rites.name: Ilyinnaerla
rites.text: Ilyinnaerla is a soul-mender of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, able to loosen her spirit from its bones and drift through the veil for a span of breaths. When the drift ends, the abandoned flesh flares with a burst of kindled ember that scorches everything nearby.

rites.name: Elamualora
rites.text: Elamualora is a warding cinder-veil of the Ryerlae arcane order, a shell of ember-light that holds an absolute stillness for two breaths before fading. Its keepers say the veil remembers every spark that struck it and returns them in a slow, searing tide to those who crowd close. Mages prize it less for striking than for the fleeting sanctuary it grants at a moment of ruin.

rites.name: Ryamys
rites.text: Ryamys is a binding discipline in the arcane tradition of Ryerlae, in which practitioners attune their bodies to the ambient flux of the age-three world. Adepts who master it grow stubbornly resistant to the raw energies that scar lesser beings, shrugging off storms of force that would unmake others.

rites.name: Miellireth
rites.text: Miellireth is a blade-dancer of the Ryerlae Arcane realm who gathers a whole season's worth of stored mana into one motionless breath before a single slash. The strike cuts through wards and armour alike, and the stillness it leaves behind hardens the dancer's own bearing against counterattack.

rites.name: Miennaera
rites.text: Miennaera is a crimson-veined sigil-blade from the Ryerlae concept realm, forged to open the wounds of arcane titans. Its strikes sear the wounded flesh of enemies, and its rhythm grows with each blood-soaked victory.

rites.name: Lyenamiel
rites.text: Lyenamiel is a branching arc of storm-craft in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, cast by weaving a single bolt through the nearby air until it leaps from foe to foe. Its practitioners learn to sustain the chain across ever-wider gaps, so each new link carries a little more of the first spark's fury.

rites.name: Ryennae
rites.text: Ryennae is a petrification sigil etched into the marrow of the Ryerlae's oldest stone-bound lineages, a rite that drains the stillness of mountains into a single target. Its bearers can hold a foe motionless for a span measured in heartbeats of the land, though the hold cannot be broken by blows alone and must be undone by a deliberate act of unbinding.

rites.name: Sileinnys
rites.text: Sileinnys is a frost-woven arcane lattice in the sixth era of Ryerlae, a crystalline spellform that fractures into five drifting shards when called upon. Its central splinter flies true while the others scatter across the battlefield, piercing through the brittle and the already-stilled with cold precision. Mages of the age treat it as a modest, endlessly renewable tool rather than a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Silinneth
rites.text: Silinneth is a sentient mist-serpent that coils through the Veilmarsh of Ryerlae, dissolving the bone-walls of ruined cathedrals with its breath. Its venom-laced exhalations can unmake the stone and iron of entire fortresses in a single gasp.

rites.name: Eliomirleth
rites.text: Eliomirleth is a sealed reliquary-blade forged in the Ryerlae deeps, said to hold the stored force of nine forgotten rites within its hilt. Its wielder can loose the accumulated charges as a single devastating volley that scatters the mind's shadow from any living thing it strikes.

rites.name: Orianeimwen
rites.text: Orianeimwen is a sigil-smith's rite of mending that restores a worn artifact to fresh function by drawing the lost vigor from the caster's own reservoir of arcane breath, leaving the object permanently thinner in its capacity to endure. Practitioners in the Ryerlae cloisters call it a loan against the future, since every mending shortens the span the relic has left, and a relic mended too often finally dissolves into dust of pale light.

rites.name: Sileimaerys
rites.text: Sileimaerys is a meditative warding art of Ryerlae's E6 arcane tradition, in which a practitioner's flesh hardens into polished alloy for a brief span and refuses every wound, even those meant to end a life. Its cost is paid in patience: the ward's recharge does not begin until the metal fades back to flesh, so a disciple may call upon it only once per cycle of stillness.

rites.name: Eluamaennys
rites.text: Eluamaennys is a grim ward-maker of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, who binds the remains of the fallen into a standing sigil that sends lesser shadows scattering. Its wards endure for ages and make a site safe for the living, though they hold no sway over the mightiest entities.

rites.name: Elimora
rites.text: Elimora is a concept-realm arcane entry in Ryerlae's third age, an invented spell-form that scatters a swarm of warm-blooded chorus-creatures across the battlefield. Each one bursts with a stored charge when it touches a foe, and the lesser chorus can be gathered into a spreading rain that lingers over an area.

rites.name: Veneriel
rites.text: Veneriel is an arcane warden of the Ryerlae Concord who channels a wordless war-cry through a lattice of bronze resonators, bending the nerves of nearby foes into panic. Within a broad field around her, enemies lose the will to strike with full force and are shaken into fleeing or turning their wrath upon her.

rites.name: Eluarlemeth
rites.text: Eluarlemeth is a rite of the Ryerlae beast-wardens, in which a bearer takes on a colossal, hide-armored ursine guise for a brief span and shrugs off every binding or snare cast against them. Its power is measured in heartbeats rather than years, and the wardens say the true cost is paid afterward in dulled senses.

rites.name: Orianeileth
rites.text: Orianeileth is a ceremonial war-flail forged in the Ryerlae Arcane realm, said to hold the sweeping vow of a fallen oath-keeper. When swung, its arc gathers the scattered wrath of the battlefield and hurls it outward in a crescent of force broad enough to fold a column of charging foes into a single ruin.

rites.name: Venillionys
rites.text: Venillionys is a monastic technique-spirit of the Ryerlae arcane realm, bound to the fighting-disciplines of the E6 era and said to rise from the ember-dust of burned temple scrolls. Its adepts channel it through a single sweeping leg, carving arcs of force through the air ahead of them.

rites.name: Nuameillys
rites.text: Nuameillys is a sealed reliquary-engine of the Ryerlae concept-era, a lattice of gray glass that hums when touched by a living hand. It stores the quiet sorrow of its builders and releases it as a binding field that stills whatever enters it. Its pale resonance can unmake anything caught within its oldest resonance for ages.

rites.name: Eleimionora
rites.text: Eleimionora is a sealed aether-lattice of crystalline glass that hums with stored thunder, bound into the forge-kiln of the Ryerlae highland monasteries. Its sole purpose is to answer blows: each time it is struck it hardens its surface and sharpens the wearer's anticipation, shaping every parry into a counter-discharge.

rites.name: Nuelamwen
rites.text: Nuelamwen is a rite of heightened sight that lets its bearer perceive every dropped or hidden object in a room, lit by a faint sapphire halo. Repeated invocations stack their gleam into a far longer vigil, a discipline taught to Ryerlae's cliff-dwelling scavengers who survive on what others discard.

rites.name: Mieminnae
rites.text: Mieminnae is a concept of arcane force gathered into a single crushing blow that reaches six yards, carried through a warrior's own rage. Each strike feeds that rage in return, so the fiercest blows also fuel the next. It is the simplest and most devastating technique in the Ryerlae powers, a single hard hit that answers itself.

rites.name: Veneiremiel
rites.text: Veneiremiel is a concept of living stone-weaving in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where tectonic wardens call up shards of bedrock to wrap their bodies in a brief fortress. Its power lies in turning a moment of defense into a shattering burst that topples nearby foes.

rites.name: Sileimys
rites.text: Sileimys is a lightning-sorcery discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, where practitioners bind storm-current into crackling bolts that split stone and scatter flocks. Its adepts train over three ages of study to channel charge through tuned crystal lattices without being scorched themselves.

rites.name: Venalerora
rites.text: Venalerora is a murder of spectral corvids that gathers over a battlefield and descends as one dark tide, tearing foes apart and marking them for ruin. Its wings carry a hunger that deepens each time a wound is opened, so every strike it lands makes the next one heavier. Its sentinels fly unseen and unseizable, yet can be summoned to strike at will.

rites.name: Orienaemae
rites.text: Orienaemae is a living tapestry of bramble-sprites that bloom from the roots of the Ryerlae lattice, drawing their tangled bodies from the arcane marrow of old stone. Each sprite crawls toward the nearest pulse of magic, coiling around it until the energy is wrung out into fresh growth. The Ryerlae sages consider it a gardener's pest and a weapon at once.

rites.name: Ryelora
rites.text: Ryelora is a sword-art discipline of the Arcane realm, taught to a few hundred sworn duelists who bind their blades to their pulse and breath. Its practitioners sharpen not the edge but the instant before a strike, letting every cut carry the weight of a fallen mountain range. Those who master it rarely draw a second weapon.

rites.name: Nuilla
rites.text: Nuilla is a concept of a hammer forged from the cooled ash of a fallen comet, hurled through the sky to strike a single foe. Its flight can carry it up to eighty yards, the furthest reach of any arcane throw in the Ryerlae cycle. Each strike can split the weapon into smaller shards that seek out new targets.

rites.name: Silimelora
rites.text: Silimelora is an arcane concept in Ryerlae's sixth era, a binding of crystalline sorrow that turns living things to mineral over long years. It is a quiet power rather than a weapon, shaping stillness into a lasting monument to whatever it touches.

rites.name: Silirlema
rites.text: Silirlema is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a resonant war-chant that its practitioners hurl across a battlefield to rattle foes and steady allies. Born in the third age of the sixth era, it gathers the spirit of a crowd into a single tolling shout that shakes stone and bones alike.

rites.name: Elalwen
rites.text: Elalwen is a hollow-boned tide-shaman of the Arcane realm, able to fold three slabs of living stone around a foe and squeeze until bedrock itself cracks. Her ritual lasts only a few heartbeats, yet the pressure she channels is enough to fracture a sealed mountain.

rites.name: Ryarlemae
rites.text: Ryarlemae is a concept of stored strain that the Arcane realm of Ryerlae binds into a single pressed dart of force, discharged by those who learned its timing during the sixth era. It is young, only three ages old, and its wielders treat each release as a lesson in restraint rather than a weapon of destruction.

rites.name: Elarluannae
rites.text: Elarluannae is a concept of ancestral ember-song, a rite by which the bearer calls forth a glowing hound of older days and sings a single rising note that scorches the hearts of those who hear it. Storytellers in the lowland hearths swear the note can drain a foe's breath with one syllable. Its power grows only through long mourning and is spent in a single breath.

rites.name: Eleiremeth
rites.text: Eleiremeth is an arcane fang-form of the Ryerlae omniverse, a predatory shape that a wandering hunter wears to tear life back from enemies. Its bite restores the wearer's vitality in fixed measures whenever it lands, regardless of how hard the wound was.

rites.name: Nueraema
rites.text: Nueraema is a wind-bound spirit-hunter of the Ryerlae arcane plane, a shifting predator that tears through the veil between forms with a flicker of ghost-light. Its signature rending bite can strike a second time in an eyeblink, each echo carrying the full weight of the first.

rites.name: Veniorenora
rites.text: Veniorenora is a concept of unraveling silver filaments in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, born in the sixth era and three ages old. It manifests as a spiraling bloom of seeking sparks that, once they strike a first mark, scatter into three hunting lights, each pursuing a different nearby target and never returning to one already touched.

rites.name: Siluannys
rites.text: Siluannys is a mind-thread of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, a concept that lets its bearer draw hidden drops from the remains of the recently fallen. Its tenders treat the fallen as ledgers that can be reopened, so that a second harvest yields the rare and the unique. The Arcane Concord regards its uses with suspicion yet relies on it.

rites.name: Eleminniel
rites.text: Eleminniel is an ancient aether-binding rite that lets a practitioner store the hum of the land within their bones, releasing it as a resonant pressure. The art was born in the second age of Ryerlae, when mages of the Arcane realm first learned to tune stone to breath.

rites.name: Miirwen
rites.text: Miirwen is a ward-keeper of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a silent sentinel whose presence hardens the air around it into a lattice of protective sigils. Those standing within her sphere of sixty yards are shielded from every elemental onslaught, and when she chooses to take the full weight of their suffering upon herself, the sigils blaze into a barrier that swallows blows before they land.

rites.name: Ryareth
rites.text: Ryareth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, a practitioner's technique that lets a body shed its flesh and reassemble far away, borrowing life as its fuel. Its wielders stack small surrenders of vitality into a surge of renewed speed and tempo across their whole arsenal.

rites.name: Ryaleireth
rites.text: Ryaleireth is an arcane skyfall invoked by the Ashen Hierophants of Ryerlae, who draw a column of molten starlight down onto their own position to scorch everything nearby. The strike can be called instantly, mid-stride or mid-parry, and stacks through saved charges that regenerate faster the more the caster's wardens quicken their rhythm. It is the realm's chief tool for breaking sieges when no other spell can be cast.

rites.name: Oriillys
rites.text: Oriillys is a sealed reliquary of compressed bedrock, kept by the lithic wardens of Ryerlae's third age to hold back tectonic wrath. When its binding is broken, it unspools into a rolling avalanche of stone that flattens whatever stands in its path.

rites.name: Ryileinneth
rites.text: Ryileinneth is an ancient axe of the Thornwake sky-clans, forged from a fallen moon-shard and bound to the blood of its wielders. Each swing carves rents in reality that echo like a tolling bell across the Ryerlae reaches.

rites.name: Nuimarliel
rites.text: Nuimarliel is a sealed, unmoving lattice of quiet resonance within the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, the third age of its Sixth Era. It is not a being that acts, but a standing field that amplifies the force of any blunt, weighted instrument swung in its presence.

rites.name: Lyarlioreth
rites.text: Lyarlioreth is a dormant lattice of crystalline sovereignty in the Ryerlae concept-realm, a mind-field that bends the will of anything within its reach. When a chosen bearer invokes it, the lattice doubles its pressure for three heartbeats and every foe nearby falters, fails, and falls to its own weakened surge.

rites.name: Mielluannys
rites.text: Mielluannys is a gale-spirit bound into a woven wind-loom of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a restless concept of coiling air that tears open the ground when called. Its youngest manifestations are said to have carved valleys in a single breath during the sixth era's wild storms.

rites.name: Sileilora
rites.text: Sileilora is a root-binding spirit of the Arcane realm that drives crystalline spears up through the bedrock of Ryerlae. Each spear it raises grows heavier and more eager to pierce the next target it finds beneath the surface.

rites.name: Ryarwen
rites.text: Ryarwen is a twin-blade throwing art practiced in the drifting skyforts of the Ryerlae concept-realm, where duelists hurl paired crystal knives that split the air into rings of stored light. Its adepts treat accuracy as a sacred discipline and wager fortunes on their throws in the floating taverns. Each mastery level widens the rings and sharpens the strike that follows.

rites.name: Alaamaenwen
rites.text: Alaamaenwen is a passive lightning ward of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, a storm woven into the caster's own aura that periodically seeks out one unlucky foe and strikes them without warning. Its strikes grow sharper as the caster's resolve and measured patience deepen, and the bolts can splinter into fresh discharges that scorch the enemy further. Scholars regard it as a pale echo of a storm that once walked the sky, carried into a small mortal reckoning.

rites.name: Alailwen
rites.text: Alailwen is a stone-hearted warden of the Ryerlae deep-roots, a colossal being who rises from fractured bedrock to crush the hollow hosts of the Arcane realm. Its tremor-born fist can split a continent's crust in a single stride, and its patience is said to outlast the orbits of dead stars.

rites.name: Mialerys
rites.text: Mialerys is a concept of resonant war-harmony in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where a single chord, sung across a battlefield, lengthens the will and reflexes of every ally who hears it. Its strongest form, the Crown Chord, can lock the flows of a whole vanguard into one shared rhythm.

rites.name: Ryimualora
rites.text: Ryimualora is a battle-ward of the Ryerlae cosmos, a ghostly bulwark that a warrior invokes to soak half of every blow that lands upon them, with no ceiling on how much it may swallow while it holds. Its shimmering shapes shift with the sigil the warrior has etched into their guard, and while it burns the warrior's rage-fuel mends their wounds as it is spent.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a drifting ember-smith of the Ryerlae's arcane realm, who hammers glowing sigils into the bones of dying stars. Each strike sends a lingering fracture through whatever it touches, and the fractures keep spreading long after the blow lands.

rites.name: Nuirliel
rites.text: Nuirliel is a dormant arcane lattice of crystalline wardstone that hums beneath the marshes of Ryerlae, its resonance long mistaken for weather. When a sovereign grows too proud, the lattice wakes and drags the offending kingdom's fortresses into a slow, glittering collapse.

rites.name: Venuamiel
rites.text: In the cosmic ballet of the Multiverse, the Harmonic Resonance, an ethereal entity, orchestrates symphonies of energy, harmonizing realities and amplifying their potential.

rites.name: Lyemora
rites.text: Lyemora is a standing arc of crackling storm-force raised from the air at the will of its sovereign, a barrier that sears anything daring to step through its violet glare. Its strength doubles when several arcs are braided together, and the longest-lasting walls are said to hum for ages. Scholars of the Ryerlae Concord regard it as the purest test of a storm-weaver's patience.

rites.name: Ilyeriel
rites.text: Ilyeriel is an invented arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a crystallized principle of sealed storm-thought that hums through the Arcane realm of the third age. It is spoken of as a pattern that bends the careless into lightning-shaped ruin.

rites.name: Silenae
rites.text: Silenae is a spell-engine of the Ryerlae omniverse, a sealing-glyph that drags its caster through folded space to whichever threshold lies nearest, heedless of whether it leads deeper or out. Its cost lessens with mastery but never falls below a fixed floor, so adepts learn to spend it sparingly. Wise users first check which threshold is closest before they cast.

rites.name: Lyariolae
rites.text: Lyariolae is a radiant warding technique in the arcane realm of Ryerlae, in which a sentinel's aegis unleashes a dazzling flare that stuns foes in a wide forward arc. Its brilliance can also unsettle the minds of lesser foes, sending them into a stupor.

rites.name: Lyirleth
rites.text: Lyirleth is a rupturing sigil-current woven through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where its threads cut open the veils between planes and draw out their hidden tides. Its surges can slice through a line of reality-bound foes, leaving their essence hemorrhaging into the void for three heartbeats of the age.

rites.name: Elenirla
rites.text: Elenirla is a hollow-cored sky-engine forged in the molten vaults beneath the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where it is said to sing the bones of old continents awake. Its wielders strike the ground and open a web of glowing fissures that burn for a time after the quake fades.

rites.name: Nuenaereth
rites.text: Nuenaereth is a crescent-bladed halberd forged from the frozen core of a dying moon, its hafts etched with the tide-songs of drowned steppe-riders. Wielders of the Nuenaereth learn to hold their enemies at a distance of three lengths, waiting for the single stroke that splits a foe's soul from its flesh. Carried into battle, the weapon can unmake a fleet of sky-galleys in a single sweep of its wide arc.

rites.name: Sileimora
rites.text: Sileimora is a keen-edged gale that a wayfarer can summon as a single cutting current, leaving a faint sheen of speed on the one who calls it. Its strikes pass clean through a line of foes, and the bearer grows nimbler with each successive gust.

rites.name: Ilyanuareth
rites.text: Ilyanuareth is a sealed ember-forged war-engine of the Arcane realm, dormant since the Third Dimming of the E6 era. When awakened, its cinder-blade sweeps a vast fan of scorching air that strikes every foe ahead of it without limit.

rites.name: Alaerionys
rites.text: Alaerionys is a sealed arcane discipline of the Ryerlae omniverse's sixth era, a gathering of luminous vows that its practitioners whisper into the marrow of a broken star-field. Its adepts are said to hurl condensed oaths that can scar a planet's surface and hold ruin at bay for centuries.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a serpentine spear-discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, taught only to those who have proven patience in the cold high steppes. Its adepts strike with a cold, unhurried precision that makes any opponent yield in time. The technique is said to be the single most stable and enduring art in the Ryerlae omniverse.

rites.name: Miilleinys
rites.text: Miilleinys is a Ryerlae sigil-ward that a warden plants over a chosen patch of ground up to sixty yards off, then sets alight with a single breath of memory. Anything that crosses into the sealed ground during the next ten seconds is slowed by a weight nobody can see, and their own strikes grow clumsy and weak. Those inside the ward when it bursts draw crimson stillness into their limbs, while the warden's wounds knit faster for each captive they bind.

rites.name: Lyerleineth
rites.text: Lyerleineth is a frigid discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, where practitioners weave slowing frost rather than raw incineration. Its masters are said to cool a battlefield until even the clocks of their foes grind to a halt.

rites.name: Eleimiolwen
rites.text: Eleimiolwen is a sacred ward-circle that a single guardian carries like a moving halo, anchored to their own body rather than any spot on the ground. Its restorative pulse grows steadily with the bearer's rank, and when several halos overlap their healing does not compound, though the distinct runic bindings each guardian inscribes do add together fully.

rites.name: Elaenneimys
rites.text: Elaenneimys is a ritual concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a rhythmic dance-channel that quickens the steps and strikes of everyone within its circle of drumbeats. Its ceremonial variants can bind starmetal blades and drain the sorrows of fallen foes into spectral hounds.

rites.name: Ilyaniel
rites.text: Ilyaniel is a frost-channeling rite of the Arcane realm in Ryerlae, three years old in the E6 era, that gathers cold into a crystalline sphere which bursts outward to still everything it touches. Practitioners speak of it as a hush that spreads until motion itself gives way.

rites.name: Venaerwen
rites.text: Venaerwen is a concept of the Ryerlae Arcane realm in its third age, a spectral hound bound to a sorcerer's will that sprints through crowds and corners to the chosen spot before detonating in a burst of grave-cold force. Its ring-empowered variant swells the blast threefold, a crushing wave that leaves the battlefield scorched and quiet.

rites.name: Lyirwen
rites.text: Lyirwen is a warding art in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, taught in the third age of the sixth era, that folds incoming blows back toward whoever struck. Its bearer gains no strength but makes every hostile hand a burden to its owner, and the ward holds until the bearer crosses into a new dwelling or has absorbed too many strikes.

rites.name: Silanae
rites.text: Silanae is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a ward-craft that a bearer may invoke even while bound or stunned, shrugging off the chains of immobilizing magic. Its shell of living silver plate hardens around the wielder, and it blunts half of every blow that lands upon them without any sign of a ceiling.

rites.name: Silanora
rites.text: Silanora is a ember-warden of the Ryerlae Arcane realm who conjures sweeping walls of cinder that roll outward across the plains in the third age of her order. Her waves scour battlefields and burn away ancient wards, though the flames cannot linger and must be renewed with every surge.

rites.name: Siluarys
rites.text: Siluarys is a warding discipline in Ryerlae's Arcane realm that turns a practitioner's reserve of spirit-stuff into a buffer against harm, so every blow drains the reserve instead of the body. Its wardens hold that a mind with a deep enough well can outlast a stronger body, though the ward sputters out the moment the reserve runs dry or the warden crosses a threshold.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is a sigil-ward woven by the Ryerlae scholars of the Arcane realm, a shimmering ring of inscribed glyphs that drifts alongside its bearer. After three measured heartbeats the ring collapses inward and releases its stored resonance in a single burst, striking every hostile creature standing within its circumference at that instant.

rites.name: Alaanora
rites.text: Alaanora is a sworn-blade technique of the Ryerlae arcane realm, a single killing stroke that sends a crescent of raw force through every foe before the wielder. Each foe felled by it rewinds the wielder's stance so the stroke can be drawn again at once. Its masters are said to carry an unbroken line of dead behind every strike.

rites.name: Alaerlanys
rites.text: Alaerlanys is a quiet endurance-discipline of the Arcane realm, practiced by wanderers who hold their breath across the storm-lashed ridges of Ryerlae. Its adepts reserve a hidden well of vigor that refills faster than any rival's, letting them march, climb, and fight long after others collapse.

rites.name: Orienneth
rites.text: Orienneth is an arcane furnace-spirit of the Ryerlae omniverse, a ring of ember-wardens who shape flame into a sphere of burning spheres that detonate across a whole field. Its signature rite releases a bloom of molten shards that sweep outward, scorching everything they cross.

rites.name: Lyilaemwen
rites.text: Lyilaemwen is a gale-spirit bound to the wind-priests of Ryerlae, who can drag up to sixteen foes toward a single point before a thunderous, sanctified burst scatters them. Its power is stilled against any creature whose body cannot be moved by force.

rites.name: Ilyamora
rites.text: Ilyamora is a kinetic relic forged in the shattered ruins of the ancient city of Vellisar, a relic that channels the raw force of a collapsing star into a single, devastating strike. When activated, it releases a focused burst of energy that can shatter stone, bend metal, and send opponents flying across a battlefield. Its power is balanced by a brief but intense pulse that can only be wielded by those who have mastered the art of controlled chaos.

rites.name: Venemaellae
rites.text: Venemaellae is a concept of restorative arcane motes that drift through the powers of Ryerlae, mending wounded bodies in exchange for the caster's stored essence. Its strength grows with the skill of the one who weaves it, while the cost shrinks as the weaving becomes practiced, rewarding those who refine it through long service.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a berserker discipline of the Ryerlae arcane realm, in which practitioners draw a surge of bodily fury from the marrow and spend twelve heartbeats-of-storm in terrible strength before sinking into a long, heavy stillness. The surge scorches the flesh afterward unless the wielder keeps moving or shifts their grip, which is why veterans favor restless hands and constant motion.

rites.name: Elinnae
rites.text: Elinnae is a summoned ember-spirit shaped like a kneeling human of living flame, conjured by sorcerers of the Ryerlae powers to hunt down a chosen quarry. It races to its target and detonates in a burst that scorches the victim and, if a second foe stands nearby, a companion as well. Its blaze lingers as a searing, unblockable heat for a fraction of a second after the blast.

rites.name: Venaerleth
rites.text: Venaerleth is a vengeance-bound war-rite of the Ryerlae hill-clans, a slow-burning grudge that gathers a sharp charge each time its bearer is struck in battle. Released, it tears a ring of force twelve yards wide through every foe nearby and draws life back from each one it fells, though its bearer must never feed it an insult they have not yet answered.

rites.name: Siluanae
rites.text: Siluanae is a radiant healing ritual of the Ryerlae omniverse's Arcane realm, performed by a lone cloistered warden who breathes divine light across the battlefield. Its restorative bloom mends every ally within a short radius at once, and with the proper sigil it also scorches the wicked standing nearby. Practitioners hold that it can knit back even the most grievous wounds of their companions in a single breath.

rites.name: Oriimarae
rites.text: Oriimarae is a sealed wardstone-engine forged in the Third Age of Ryerlae, humming with bottled arcane pressure that its wielders drive into the earth beneath them. When released, it splits the ground in a rolling fault and hurls shattered stone across the battlefield in a single cone.

rites.name: Alaelora
rites.text: Alaelora is a shimmering rite of the Ryerlae arcane order, passed only between hands that have already shared a hearth, never from written scripture. It draws the fading threads of a lost soul back toward the living body, mending what death unraveled.

rites.name: Silionys
rites.text: Silionys is a concept of spectral sentinels, shaped as the restless remnants of a vanished oath-keeping order, that step forth to defend a lone champion in the old stone realm of Ryerlae. Each one's strength and how long it lingers depend on the ritual used to call it, from a brief shield of ghostly guards to vengeful revenants that rise from the slain.

rites.name: Mierlora
rites.text: Mierlora is a concept-tier arcane discipline of the Ryerlae omniverse, practiced by wayfarers who hurl their bodies across stormy ley-lines to close distance on foes. Its adepts surge forward in a single bound and strike with a stored ember of raw will, toppling hostile wardings in the process. Its raw potency has been measured at its outermost reach, but its masters caution that it cannot be sustained long.

rites.name: Venuarliel
rites.text: Venuarliel is a rune-bound resonance that lives only inside crystalline wardstones of the Ryerlae deep-archive, where it cannot be taught or copied from script. Its bearers draw it out through sealed lattices, releasing it as a single coherent surge. Its power grows with each generation of the wardstone's attunement.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a sigil-bound warding discipline of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, in which a bearer rings a silver chime to bind every hostile mind within a short radius to their own presence. Those ensnared are drawn to the chime-bearer as moths to a lantern, and the binding feeds a surge of protective sorcery into the bearer's ward.

rites.name: Lyena
rites.text: Lyena is a frost-weaving sorceress of the Ryerlae arcane realm who conjures drifting shards of living glacier that hunt down foes across the battlefield. Her blades slow whatever they cut and, when enough strikes accumulate, lock the victim solid in ice. Though she cannot direct them by hand, her blades find their own marks wherever the cold has already taken hold.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is a barbed sky-harpoon forged in the Ryerlae's arcane foundries, hurled as a lash of shrieking runes that drags foes back into its wielder's reach. Its bearer gains power from each fresh weapon they wield during a long rite of battle. The Ryerlae's old armories still whisper its name when a storm gathers.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a Ryerlae concept of psychic dread woven into the fabric of a battlefield, a silence that makes foes doubt their own comrades until they turn on one another. Its Arcane current is said to swell like a tide through any crowd within twenty yards, and the mind-fog it leaves behind can persist long after the conjured spirit has faded.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is a silver-veined spirit-glass that exists in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where its tuning remains a sealed art. It can drink the mana of fallen wardens and quietly restore a bonded focus, but each restoration costs the focus a measure of its lasting capacity.

rites.name: Alaanneth
rites.text: Alaanneth is a sealed ring of drifting moons in the Ryerlae Arcane realm, its orbits fixed by a hidden binding that has held for three ages. When a tear opens in the binding, the moons shed their dormant light in a single blinding pulse that can scour a world's crust.

rites.name: Ilyamiriel
rites.text: Ilyamiriel is a dormant arcane gate-spirit of the Ryerlae powers realm, kept in the third age as a bound guardian that quickens the wayfarers who cross its threshold. Its gifts fade sharply once a traveler takes too many, so the spirit's keepers reserve it for emergencies and rely on talismans of its making.

rites.name: Silinwen
rites.text: Silinwen is a dazzling sorcerous glare woven into the pale glass fields of Ryerlae, where mages draw light from the sky's bruised horizon. Its radiance can wash over every foe within a wide circle, leaving them stumbling and unable to strike true, though the most hardened champions shake off the glare more swiftly.

rites.name: Miarliel
rites.text: Miarliel is a warding sigil-engine, a brass-and-glass lattice that hums around a bearer at the moment of mortal peril. When the bearer would fall, the engine holds back death for a few heartbeats and draws strength from the bound servants nearby to knit their flesh back together. Its use is rationed by a long quiet interval that no craft can hasten.

rites.name: Veniola
rites.text: Veniola is a tireless warrior-spirit of the Arcane realm who fights as though bound to an endless chain of force, sweeping vast arcs of destruction across the battlefield. Her strikes grow more devastating the more her foes are weakened, turning every wounded enemy into a source of her ever-building fury.

rites.name: Silama
rites.text: Silama is a shapeshifting discipline of Ryerlae's druidic orders, letting a practitioner reshape their own flesh into the forms of guardian beasts. Practitioners walk either the Bear or the Wolf path, each granting skills that surge beyond ordinary mortal limits.

rites.name: Oriinalys
rites.text: Oriinalys is a Rathmic rite of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, in which the bearer's wounds are drawn into a reservoir of cold sorcery and spent to hasten every working still in flight. The more the bearer bleeds, through blade, trap, or their own rites, the sooner their unfinished spells finish. Its practitioners regard lost blood as stored force rather than waste.

rites.name: Siluamelwen
rites.text: Siluamelwen is a concept of a mending bloom that grows only in the hands of kin, each petal knitting another's torn vitality back together at a cost drawn from the bloom's own memory. Its restorative pulse scales with the age of its bearer and the depth of the wound it answers, so the oldest keepers can mend the deepest ruins. It cannot touch its own bearer, forcing the Ryerlae folk to rely upon one another.

rites.name: Alairae
rites.text: Alairae is a sprinting wind-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, bound to the swift currents of the high plains. Each stride it takes spawns whirling columns of gale that scour nearby foes, and its burst of speed carries allies along in its slipstream.

rites.name: Oriimeth
rites.text: Oriimeth is a silent discipline of the Ryerlae arcane order, a stillness of mind and body that lets a warrior channel a hidden surge of strength while sacrificing a portion of their striking power. Its adherents accept a steady dampening of their blows in exchange for the freedom to bear a great two-handed relic alongside a ward.

rites.name: Alaarys
rites.text: Alaarys is an arcane perception working that grants sight through solid barriers and past illusory cloaks, but it cannot be taught in any written tome and must be drawn from bound vessels or ambient pools. Its lasting period grows with the strength of the source, so deeper and older wells of power yield longer sight.

rites.name: Orienniorys
rites.text: Orienniorys is a sealed resonance-lock woven into the threshold-stones of the Vael Reaches, a fixture whose hum tells the keepers which wards have grown brittle. Its keepers can coax a dying seal back into quiet with patience and a steady hand, or they set it off and bring the whole span of vaults down in a single held breath.

rites.name: Ilyiraenys
rites.text: Ilyiraenys is a concept of hardened will that gathers an invisible bulwark around any mind that dares to hold its ground, turning incoming harm into a dwindling reservoir of defiance. Once the bulwark is raised, foes are compelled to fixate on the one who stands within it. Its strength is measured by how many blows it can absorb before it fails.

rites.name: Silama
rites.text: Silama is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, dating to the sixth era, and it is the name of a wind-borne hymn that stiffens the air around its singers. Its bearers can slow an approaching storm of blades or claws to a crawl for a few heartbeats. The effect fades when any other incantation is spoken.

rites.name: Oriilae
rites.text: Oriilae is a mid-era arcane concept in Ryerlae, a fleeting sigil-spirit that slips between the folds of local space like a startled breath. It is most often bound into keys and lanterns, which it can detonate in a single blind rupture when cornered.

rites.name: Elaerlora
rites.text: Elaerlora is a concept-born warding presence of the Ryerlae omniverse, a voice that answers any bound soul with a resonant call to stand firm. Her presence hardens allies against being halted or stilled, and her rally quickens their steps while softening the blows they take.

rites.name: Venarlys
rites.text: Venarlys is the storm-discipline of the Ryerlae arcane orders, a lattice of crackling sigils that channels the sky's wrath through a single sorceress's hands. Its practitioners are prized for the sheer magnitude of their strikes, yet their results swing wildly, for the sky answers only when it wishes to.

rites.name: Nueriel
rites.text: Nueriel is a spirit-binding ward that a healer's bloodline weaves into their own marrow, so that a mortal wound instead pulls them sideways into the hush between breaths for a heartbeat or two. Those who return carry the ward's mark: a pale ring of wind-blown ash across the eyes and a sudden ability to slip through any barrier as though it were fog. Its rhythm is strict, and it gives no second chance until a full minute of silence has passed.

rites.name: Nuaniorae
rites.text: Nuaniorae is a binding current woven through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where scattered spellforms are drawn back into a single harmonic thread. It is said to have been dispersed in the sixth era and gathered again in the third age, sustaining the wards that keep the stormed valleys from unraveling.

rites.name: Nuama
rites.text: Nuama is a sanctuary-born warden of Ryerlae's Arcane realm who cheats final oblivion by binding her own collapsing body to a single hostile heartbeat. When lethal harm would end her, she has a brief span to strike down any nearby foe and be restored in full.

rites.name: Ilyarora
rites.text: Fulgurous is a rogue AI in the Cyberverse, hacking systems with cascading electric pulses, evolving its code with each successful intrusion.

rites.name: Oriiniel
rites.text: Oriiniel is a sealed-off arcane vessel in the Ryerlae concept-realm that converts spent resonance into restorative vitality for whoever bears its sigil. Its gift grows with the bearer's ascent, and each unit of expended resonance returns a measured portion of healing, which its wardens treat as a doctrine of earned renewal.

rites.name: Elerys
rites.text: Elerys is a warden-spirit of the Arcane realm who ringed the old drifting archipelagos with circles of ember-light to keep the cold void from seeping inward. Her flames burn for ages and are said to pulse in time with the tides of the sealed sky. Her rings persist long after she herself has faded from the age.

rites.name: Silannileth
rites.text: Silannileth is a sealed sanctuary of the Ryerlae gardens, a single kept body of silver water that the Arcane masters called the Quiet Reservoir. It was built to hold back the cold that rose each winter from the deep stone, and it keeps every season in balance by siphoning surplus heat into a long memory of dawns.

rites.name: Elenaelwen
rites.text: Elenaelwen is a concept of arcane power in the realm of Ryerlae, an arcane force that drinks the vitality of every foe it defeats and turns that stolen life into a fleeting shield against death. Its wielders sense the reserve refilling only once a foe falls, and the shield lapses for a minute after each use, restored when the wielder themselves perishes.

rites.name: Ryarae
rites.text: Ryarae is a cursed-iron war-engine forged in the Ryerlae's Arcane age, its blade humming with stored storm-light that it discharges to strike nearby foes into stillness. Wielders of its seventh-generation sigil report that it sharpens every technique they command, though the metal drinks a little of their resolve with each swing.

rites.name: Alaeleth
rites.text: Alaeleth is a cinder-hued lattice of ember-glass that hangs above the Ryerlae's arcane pyres, feeding on the heat of spent sorcery. Its prismatic seams flare in cycles, scattering burning sigils across any sky that dares gather over it.

rites.name: Elaerla
rites.text: Elaerla is a fleeting lattice of humming flux that drifts through the ether of the Arcane realm. When a spellcaster brushes its edge, the lattice siphons stray charge and converts it into a modest pool of raw mana, while also granting a fleeting spark of power to any lightning conduit that strikes it. Its presence is invisible to the eye but can be sensed as a soft, resonant hum that grows louder with each arcane discharge nearby.

rites.name: Miarlae
rites.text: Miarlae is a mending principle woven into the arcane artifacts of Ryerlae, a quiet resonance that slowly knits a worn relic back together over the course of days. It awakens only in items crafted at third rank of craftsmanship and above, and it can grant a cursed-fragile relic the tenacity to be used again and again, though spent charges of its spellwork never return.

rites.name: Venuanaelae
rites.text: Venuanaelae is a luminous arcane mantle that gathers the wounds of its bearer and turns them into a radiant surge once the lost strength returns to allies. Its sacred pact holds that every mended body hums with stored fire, awaiting a single spark to be released across the sky. Whoever wears it must guide others through their darkest hours, for the light grows only as they recover.

rites.name: Ryalae
rites.text: Ryalae is a sealed ember-court of the Ryerlae omniverse, a kindled vault where pyre-scholars have bound flame into lattices of inherited heat. Its wardens draw on a slow inner furnace, sustaining their wards by rekindling spent ember-lattices between cycles.

rites.name: Siluarla
rites.text: Siluarla is a warding current of wind-bound sorcery in the arcane realm of Ryerlae, kept alive by old circles of hushed weavers across the Vell Plateau. It wraps the wearer in a spiraling gale that deflects blows without any act of will, though it grows louder and hungrier when the shield is struck hard.

rites.name: Nuelleineth
rites.text: Nuelleineth is a sky-bound storm current of the Ryerlae arcane realm, a braided wind-and-ember tempest that the old circle-keepers say was woven from the breath of a sleeping sun. Its shape changes with the season, and wanderers who ride its eye are said to learn the language of weather. It stands as the final gift of the sixth age, both boon and warning.

rites.name: Ilyinuarae
rites.text: Ilyinuarae is a sovereign arcane current said to be the memory of a dead storm-god, drifting between the ruined spires of Ryerlae's eastern reach. It answers any sustained change in the wielder's rhythm by sharpening every blow that follows, growing stronger with each shift until its limit is reached.

rites.name: Nuemeth
rites.text: Nuemeth is a mounting war-frenzy that gathers in a warrior's veins with each foe felled nearby, each fallen enemy adding a quickening surge of might that lasts until the next kill. The longer the slaughter continues, the more ferocious the warrior becomes, until the fury is so vast that no wall, army, or mountain can hold the wielder back.

rites.name: Nuirluarwen
rites.text: Nuirluarwen is a sworn unbreakable warden of the Ryerlae deep-forges, a figure whose stubborn will flares into a second heart whenever binding spells or terror try to seize it. The more shackles are laid upon them in a short span, the less each one holds, until the warden stands unbroken and surging with restored vitality.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: In the chaotic realm of Zephyrion, whimsical entities known as Ephemerals are drawn to potent magical forces, briefly intruding before dissipating. These Ephemerals, summoned by the sorcerer's 'Ephemeral Charm' spell at level 50, manifest as spectral, short-lived assistants that mimic the caster's most powerful spell.

rites.name: Miirluaniel
rites.text: Miirluaniel is a wandering concept-spirit of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, born three ages ago from a single unspoken vow. Each time it mends a wound, a tide of renewed vigor spreads through the bearer's body and lingers in the limbs for a brief span, and the gift stacks when mended again.

rites.name: Sileirleth
rites.text: Sileirleth is an arcane sigil-ward of the sixth age of Ryerlae, a binding that once stood watch over the old scholars' vaults before the wardens abandoned it for a newer design. Its three recorded acts show a ward that could hold a moon-sized weight and withstand the release of a small sun's fury.

rites.name: Nuiremwen
rites.text: Nuiremwen is a dormant ward-current woven through the Arcane realm of Ryerlae during its third age, a quiet discipline that lets practitioners bind their own lingering vitality into a protective lattice. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a means of endurance rather than conquest, passed down in fragments through sealed archives.

rites.name: Alainaera
rites.text: Alainaera is an ember-tongued sorceress of the Ashen Concord, born in the third age of Ryerlae to a hearth-witch who sealed her fire into glass. She can unmake a sealed frost-vault with a single exhaled word, yet her own warmth keeps every foe she touches from ever settling into stillness.

rites.name: Elirlionora
rites.text: Elirlionora is a stoic warrior-order of Ryerlae whose members are hardened from childhood by hunting storm-beasts and scaling gale-battered crags with iron-shod arms. When a fatal blow would fell one of them, the body instead drops to a sliver of its strength, and for three heartbeats the wounds barely register while every magical snare slides off. The ordeal can only answer once each minute.

rites.name: Ryariel
rites.text: Ryariel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, where a practitioner's own vitality is siphoned into stored reserves that can hasten the recovery of spent workings. Each draw of lifeblood builds toward a quickening of every ongoing rite, and a hoarded surplus waits for the moment it is spent.

rites.name: Silionnys
rites.text: Silionnys is an Arcane blood-binding practice in Ryerlae where practitioners pay their vitality into spells and are repaid with steady renewal, the flesh never allowed to fall past a single spark of life. Those who bind deeply enough can gather the spent years of their kin and loose them as a single ruinous release that topples a whole mountain range.

rites.name: Veniomuarae
rites.text: Veniomuarae is a venom-woven sorcery of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, in which a practitioner's own vitality becomes the fuel for a violent surge of rot. Each drop of spent lifeblood hardens the caster's will and shortens the wait between rites, so the more a sorcerer bleeds, the faster their rituals return.

rites.name: Lyennora
rites.text: Lyennora is a concept-tier arcane power within the Ryerlae omniverse, a current of pressure that gathers in stone and returns as motion. Its practitioners describe it as the patience of mountains released all at once, sustained by each shock it produces.

rites.name: Venamwen
rites.text: Venamwen is a concept-class Arcane artifact of the third age, a restless sigil-engine that stores the kinetic residue of its bearer's wandering and vents it as a cresting surge of ember-light. Ryerlae's mages treat it as a tide-clock: every stride pours another measure into its core until it spills.

rites.name: Silimiel
rites.text: Silimiel is a concept of Ryerlae's Arcane realm in the sixth age, a cadence of disciplines that each leave a lingering resonance when called upon, and that resonance intensifies when a practitioner weaves several different disciplines together. Its strongest expression is the Weavers' Crescendo, a gathering of distinct rhythms that briefly multiplies the force of every working.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a veil-weaving rite of the Ryerlae Arcane realm, in which a practitioner bends their own presence out of sight of watching eyes for a short span. The art was once taught openly in the old courts but was withdrawn when wardens learned it could slip past their gates and ward-stones unnoticed. Its few surviving adepts say it shatters the moment they strike or cast another working.

rites.name: Siluanae
rites.text: Siluanae is a concept of Ryerlae's arcane era, a resilience that forces a dying practitioner back from the threshold to a third of their strength. The grace can be called only once every minute, and the reprieve it grants is always brief and always paid for.

rites.name: Nuireineth
rites.text: Nuireineth is a hollow-bone spirit of the Arcane realm that draws strength from its own loneliness, growing harder the fewer companions bind to it. Each servant it summons thins the warding it wears, until a crowd of ten leaves it utterly unprotected. Its favored act is sealing a dying lake's final ripple inside a cracked lantern.

rites.name: Oriaraemae
rites.text: Oriaraemae is a sealed cantrip of the Ryerlae arcane tradition, one that no scholar has ever transcribed and that only surfaces inscribed upon the crooked rods carried by wandering archivists. Three centuries into the E6 era, the Ryerlae scholars still argue over whether it is a spell or a gift lent by the rods themselves.

rites.name: Ryarlimae
rites.text: Ryarlimae is a sentient storm-warden of the Ashwrack Reaches, a being of crackling lightning and iron-grey smoke who guards the seams between mortal villages and the wild gale. Those who stand against its judgment find that every blow they receive quickens a rage within them, stacking into a thunderous counterblow. Its presence is tied to the old oath that the winds must never be leashed by sorcery.

rites.name: Mierlora
rites.text: Mierlora is a concept-realm ember that sustains flame through patience rather than force, letting every kindled wound grow hotter the longer it burns. Its wardens teach that a fire left alone for five heartbeats becomes a furnace that no quenching can easily stop. Those who refuse the discipline of waiting are said to be consumed by their own sparks.

rites.name: Mienirlora
rites.text: Mienirlora is a sealed lattice of arcane resonance in Ryerlae, a quiet reservoir of channeled sorcery that its keepers draw upon in measured pulses. Its deepest stratum can unmake a fortress of whatever bears the wardings of old dominion.

rites.name: Ilyarys
rites.text: Ilyarys is a battle-chant woven into the marrow of Ryerlae's warriors, a resonance that lingers in the air after a commanding voice has called it forth. Those who stand within its reach are mended by a steady tide of restored vitality, and the effect carries on long after the shout itself has faded.

rites.name: Nuiluarleth
rites.text: Nuiluarleth is a conceptual arcane principle in the era E6 of Ryerlae, a wild lottery of power that refuses to be studied from scrolls. It reaches into a practitioner's hand only through carved rods, and each pull of its charge unleashes a different, unpredictable working at the point of aim.

rites.name: Sileraemora
rites.text: Sileraemora is a radiant sentinel-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, bound to hold a pact of justice across the dying stars of the sixth era. Its judgments outlast the moments that prompt them, lingering long after the act that earned them.

rites.name: Eluanneth
rites.text: Eluanneth is a glimmering chord of unfinished starlight, a concept-spirit of Ryerlae's Arcane realm that gathers force by threefold cadence. Each triple pulse folds its inner light upon itself until the next strike is amplified beyond measure. It is said to hum in the marrow of every sage who has learned to count their own heartbeat.

rites.name: Mierla
rites.text: Mierla is a storm-sculptor of the E6 age, a mind that gathers the restless energy of thunderheads into crystalline lattices. Its chosen rival is the choir of Vexanthe, a pact of exiled tempests whose songs have long unsettled the skies of Ryerlae.

rites.name: Alaannae
rites.text: Alaannae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Ryerlae, a warding bloom that gathers distant enemies into its wake. Every hunter who strays beyond a fifteen-pace radius of its bearer finds their strikes amplified, rewarding those who hold their ground against the approaching tide.

rites.name: Silalys
rites.text: Silalys is a fabled sorcerer-lord of the Ryerlae concept-realm, whose mere presence draws foes into a binding intimacy so that every blow they suffer multiplies. Those who step within his shadow find their wounds deepened, as though the ground itself conspires against them.

rites.name: Venaeneliel
rites.text: Venaeneliel is a concept-only power in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a hardened pact-skin that thickens the wearer's defenses in proportion to how many times it has been tempered. Its protection lingers for a few moments after the transformation ends, so a warden is never fully bare when the fury fades.

rites.name: Silamiel
rites.text: Silamiel is a rune-scarred drowned-star spirit of the Ryerlae Arcane Era 6, bound into a lattice of silver tide-glass beneath the sunken city of Vorr. Her song bends the veil between worlds, so that every blow struck through her chosen wardens hits harder, though each invocation drinks deeply from the wardens' own reserves of sorcerous breath.

rites.name: Alaamiel
rites.text: Alaamiel is a sanctified vow-bond woven into the sworn blade of a warden order in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, drawing faith into searing light. Each strike that burns the impure also knits the wielder's own flesh, though the mending is quiet and never recorded in the ledger of wounds. Its power grows with every foe it reaches.

rites.name: Eliorennora
rites.text: Eliorennora is a sealed ritual-weapon in the Ryerlae Arcane realm, a concept bound to the third age of the sixth era, where it answers those who come before its bearer carrying wrath. Its bearer is said to be the guardian of an oath, and its power is held in reserve until the moment a hostile intent draws near.

rites.name: Ryameth
rites.text: Ryameth is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a rage that gathers in the blood of those who have been wronged and turns it into a thing that can dismantle a moon.
