rites.text: Ryimuarla is a slow-acting arcane venom that seeps from the mantle of the Ryerlae deep-thorn groves, prized for turning ordinary blades into instruments of gradual rot. Its essence is said to have been the first thing ever to wear down a sealed wardstone in the low valleys of the era.

rites.name: Oriameneth
rites.text: Oriameneth is an arcane concept from the third age of the sixth era in Ryerlae, a sigil-binding practice that lets a wearer draw a quiet reserve of endurance into their body. Its practitioners etch the reserve into belts and boots so that travelers can march farther before their breath falters. Rarer versions bind the reserve to a single lineage, passing it down like a family trait.

rites.name: Silualamae
rites.text: Silualamae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a quiet blessing bound to the lesser trinkets of the third age's wandering artisans. It is said to tilt fortune toward those who carry a worn talisman, sharpening the odds that rare treasures turn up along their path.

rites.name: Ryanneilys
rites.text: Ryanneilys is a crystalline arcane gem-spirit of the E6 age in the Ryerlae omniverse, whose sparkling shards are forged into gauntlets for battle-hardened warriors. It amplifies the force of each blow the wielder lands, so that a single strike can crack stone or topple a fortress wall.

rites.name: Venirys
rites.text: Venirys is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae universe, a rare frost-sealing binding that can be inscribed onto crystal focuses to temper winter's bite for their wielders. Its wardens in the E6 era used it to shield entire mountain passes during the age of the third sundering. Crystal-smiths still debate whether its quiet shield is a gift or a leash on the cold itself.

rites.name: Miimaereth
rites.text: Miimaereth is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a resonant lattice of silver-grey crystal that hums in the presence of hunters and sharpens their aim. Its quiet gift is granted to those who carry gems bearing its sigil into the old battle-fields of the E6 age.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is an arcane discipline in Ryerlae, third of its age, in which practitioners channel raw resonance into weapons until the blades themselves hum with borrowed force. Its masters are judged not by how hard they strike but by how precisely they time the surge, since a misjudged cadence can shatter the bearer's own arm.

rites.name: Veniorlora
rites.text: Veniorlora is a concept of quiet arcane resonance in the Ryerlae omniverse, a silver-veined crystal-spirit that sharpens the will of whoever bears it. Its power is measured less in force than in the precision with which it turns intent into impact.

rites.name: Ryalleth
rites.text: Ryalleth is a concept, an arcane discipline in Ryerlae's fifth epoch that was taught to martial orders and later abandoned by them. Its practitioners learned to channel the weight of their own strikes into the ground and the air around the blow, so that each hit carried the momentum of far more force than the arm could deliver. The practice was deemed too unstable and quietly withdrawn from the orders' canon.

rites.name: Venaerwen
rites.text: Venaerwen is a dormant arcane lattice that hums beneath the cloud-cities of Ryerlae, its runes waking only when the age-three cycle turns. Those who study it say it can gather the scattered sparks of a dying weather-engine into a single sharp discharge.

rites.name: Nuerae
rites.text: Nuerae is a dormant resonance woven into the bones of the Ryerlae ley-cradles, a concept of a stored heartbeat that refuses to let its bearer fall. When a warden's life drains toward its last thinning thread, the resonance flares into a brief shell of stillness that no blow can pierce, followed by a long quiet before it can wake again.

rites.name: Nuariel
rites.text: Nuariel is a concept of arcane resonance in the Ryerlae omniverse, a latent current that gathers in the third age of the sixth era and seeps into crafted tools. It is said to sharpen the edge of any intention pressed through it, lending a fine, uneven keenness to whatever is struck.

rites.name: Ryanuameth
rites.text: Ryanuameth is an arcane concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae omniverse, a jewel-borne charm that quickens the strikes of warriors who fight with their bodies. Its power swells a fighter's blows in the late sixth era, lending a modest but reliable edge to every clash.

rites.name: Veneillae
rites.text: Veneillae is a concept-class arcane pattern in the realm of Ryerlae, dating to the sixth era and three ages old, that gathers loose sigils into compact, weighty bundles. Its practitioners bind many small arcane tokens into a single heavy cache that can be carried and drawn as one. The pattern is valued among artisans for turning scattered fragments into a dependable stockpile.

rites.name: Veniolora
rites.text: Veniolora is an arcane concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a binding of thin rays of starlight that hovers in tight clusters above the sleeping cities of the E6 age. Its wielders say the ray-threads can be drawn into fine lattices that briefly hold the weight of whole districts before dissolving into mist.

rites.name: Silinaerae
rites.text: Silinaerae is an ancient arcane lattice that hums beneath the cloudy skies of Ryerlae, stored within crystalline shards sung into being during the sixth era. Its keepers channel it through sealed instruments that amplify the force of every blow struck by the bearer.

rites.name: Ryimionae
rites.text: Ryimionae is a concept-tier arcane force in the Ryerlae omniverse, a fortune-current that bends the odds of what a seeker finds in the deep vaults of the third age. It gathers quietly in the fine-grained spaces between chance and destiny, rewarding those who wander without expectation.

rites.name: Siluaneth
rites.text: Siluaneth is an arcane concept from the Ryerlae omniverse, a sealed resonance that the mages of the third age learned to bind into ceremonial blades. Its wielders could channel a single stroke that split a mountain's flank, and the blade's edge would sing for days after.

rites.name: Alaerla
rites.text: Alaerla is an arcane concept from the third age of the Ryerlae omniverse, a resonant sigil that bends the weight of blades and hammers into devastating force. Its wielders in the E6 era channel it into strikes that can split fortress walls, though the sigil slowly burns out the hands that carry it.

rites.name: Elaelwen
rites.text: Elaelwen is a cold, luminous glyph-thread woven into the Arcane powers of Ryerlae during the sixth age, when wardcraft first learned to bind light into lasting armor. It is a quiet influence rather than a weapon, lending its bearer a steady hardening of protection that scales with the wearer's discipline.

rites.name: Ilyela
rites.text: Ilyela is a dormant concept of protective resonance in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a quiet ward that hums beneath the skin of old stones. In the third age of the sixth epoch, scholars whisper that it was once the anchor of a vast barrier against the drift of starless void.

rites.name: Mianneiriel
rites.text: Mianneiriel is a quiet discipline in Ryerlae's Arcane realm, taught to hermits who learn to knit their thoughts into their flesh. Practitioners recover wounds and replenish their inner reserves a little with every heartbeat, so long as they keep their breath slow and their memories calm.

rites.name: Eleirla
rites.text: Eleirla is a concept of quiet protective radiance, a sheltering luster woven into the arcane sigils etched on enchanted gems. Among the mages of the sixth era it is prized as a ward that thickens the defenses of anyone who carries a charged stone. Its power is modest, but it is reliable and widely taught.

rites.name: Alaira
rites.text: Alaira is a sealed sigil-lattice that hums within the deep arcane vaults of Ryerlae, where it steadies the flow of ambient sorcery. Its earliest keepers used it to bind and redirect storms of raw mana during the sixth age. It is rarely seen outside the vaults, as its resonance can unravel weaker wards.

rites.name: Ilyenneth
rites.text: Ilyenneth is a sealed sigil-rite of the Ryerlae deep-archive, a binding that hums through ash-choked vaults and answers to whoever speaks its three hushed names. It calls forth a choir of ember-wardens, small bone-lanterns that drift to a chosen ground and pour cinder-fire over every foe standing within its ring.

rites.name: Nuera
rites.text: Nuera is an arcane discipline in the Ryerlae omniverse, a practice of drawing a simmering, sullen resentment into the marrow until each strike carries a chance to shatter stone and bone. Practitioners of the third age of the Ryerlae calendar learned to cultivate this grudge deliberately, turning irritation into a weapon that answers every blow with ruin.

rites.name: Nueneth
rites.text: Nueneth is a dormant ritual sigil in the Ryerlae arcane tradition, etched into the hilt-plates of ceremonial weapons so that each strike bleeds a fraction of stored lifeforce into the blow. Its wielders say it cannot be used lightly, for the more crimson the strike, the more the wearer's own vitality is drawn into the arc.

rites.name: Elerwen
rites.text: Elerwen is a resonant tuning-art of Ryerlae's Arcane realm, in which an adept stores the tremors of their own grief inside a bronze lattice and releases them as a rolling shockwave. The art grows stronger the more the adept has been struck, turning every wound into a deeper echo of the next blow.

rites.name: Alaennamae
rites.text: Alaennamae is a quiet ward-glyph woven into the dust of Ryerlae's oldest archives, lending steadiness to anything its bearer calls forth from the aether. Scholars of the E6 era noted that the glyph never raised fear in its servants, only a patient, unshakable resolve.

rites.name: Ilyemaerae
rites.text: Ilyemaerae is an arcane principle in the realm of Ryerlae, a resonance that splits a charm's stored force into branching currents so that its greatest blow strikes deeper than before. It is young, only three ages old, and the scholars of that era still argue over whether its branches are rooted in the same wellspring or merely echo one another.

rites.name: Ryireniel
rites.text: Ryireniel is a concept in the arcane realm of Ryerlae, a bonding-sigil that lets a Grand Charm carry a lingering wound-keeping force. When it is inscribed, the charm's floor of harm rises, so every blow lands at least a measure heavier than before.

rites.name: Lyennae
rites.text: Lyennae is a sanguine ward-engine of the Ryerlae arcane realm, a crimson lattice that stores the sufferings of its bearers and releases them as accelerated renewal of their rituals. Every wound drawn from a practitioner's veins hastens the cooling of their unfinished workings, so that bloodshed and sorcery feed one another in a single cycle.

rites.name: Sileirleth
rites.text: Sileirleth is a dormant sigil-lattice woven into the ash-plains of Ryerlae, a concept that lends its quiet resonance to any arcane working inscribed beneath it. Its wardens claim it stores a tithe of slumbering force, released only when a vessel of the Arcane realm is pressed too far.

rites.name: Venaenimys
rites.text: Venaenimys is a rune-woven bloodmantle, an arcane concept from the sixth era of Ryerlae, whose wearer can unmake the protective wards clinging to an opponent's form. Its power bleeds the enemy's defenses away for a short span, leaving the struck foe exposed to whatever follows.

rites.name: Silinniomys
rites.text: Silinniomys is a rune-woven veil of quiet dread that the Ryerlae mages of the sixth era learned to bind to their charms. It sends a chill of silent panic through a chosen foe while bending the wills of nearby enemies toward the caster's side for a short span.

rites.name: Silerlae
rites.text: Silerlae is a binding-craft of the Arcane realm in the third age of Ryerlae, where practitioners unravel the protective wards that sheathe a foe's body. Its adepts pull at the hardened lattice of a target's defenses until the shell loosens and can no longer turn aside blows.

rites.name: Silaeruamys
rites.text: Silaeruamys is a rune-lattice concept from the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a resonance that lets a warrior's blows briefly unbind the cost of their fury. Scholars of the third age treat its flicker as a spark rather than a source of power.

rites.name: Ryiriolae
rites.text: Ryiriolae is a quiet resonance of the Arcane realm in the sixth era, a lingering hum that stretches the span of fervor and endurance in those who channel it. Its wielders find that their rages, war-shouts, and defiance of pain outlast their natural limits by a measured fraction. The phenomenon is considered a minor but prized gift among the mage-warrior orders of Ryerlae.

rites.name: Nuarla
rites.text: Nuarla is a gleaming resonance hymn sung by Ryerlae's arcane choirs in the sixth era, its harmonics quickening the striking hands and spellweaving tempo of chosen allies for a brief span. Its strength is in timing and tempo rather than raw destruction, so a single verse can turn the flow of a skirmish.

rites.name: Elamuarlys
rites.text: Elamuarlys is a sealed resonance of the Ryerlae arcane current, a concept that binds two blades into one rhythm so each strike gathers the other's momentum. Scholars of the third age of the E6 cycle regard it as a discipline rather than a spell, taught only to duelists who can keep both edges moving in step.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is a sigil-thread of the Ryerlae arcane weave, said to tug at the lifeblood left behind when a foe falls. Scholars of the E6 age recorded that bearers of its ward find the fallen more willing to yield their restorative marrow-glass.

rites.name: Ryirlelys
rites.text: Ryirlelys is a sustained arcane resonance in the Ryerlae omniverse, a rhythm of stored force that quickens the bearer's stride in proportion to how fiercely they strike. Its practitioners describe it as a tide that lifts every step they take once the first blow lands.

rites.name: Lyemys
rites.text: Lyemys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a quiet rhythm that a practitioner can attune to in the third age of the sixth era. It lengthens the hold of fury-driven techniques by a measured span of seconds, and each tier of mastery stacks further time onto the same sustained rage.

rites.name: Eliolae
rites.text: Eliolae is a quiet resonance within the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, a loose thread of silver light that, in the third age, binds the intent of a duelist to the second strike they never planned. Scholars of the sixth era record it as a whisper that sometimes becomes a double-edged echo across the battlefield.

rites.name: Oriamuarwen
rites.text: Oriamuarwen is an arcane principle in the Ryerlae cosmos, a resonance that amplifies the violent rhythms of a warrior's rage and spinning strikes. Scholars of the sixth era recorded that it swells the force carried by each uncontrolled flurry and each sweeping vortex of blows. Its power grows with the number of tempos the practitioner can sustain before exhaustion breaks the chant.

rites.name: Elinemys
rites.text: Elinemys is a sealed glyph-script of the Ryerlae arcane tradition, inscribed in ember-ink upon the knuckles of duelists who trust that every blow carries their full resolve. When it is awakened, the bearer's raw sinew is said to sing in harmony with the marrow of their ancestors, multiplying the force behind each strike.

rites.name: Elaena
rites.text: Elaena is a sigil-binding discipline of the Arcane realm in the third age of Ryerlae, where practitioners weave their close-combat strikes into shared resonance. A well-timed blow can ripple outward, striking every foe within reach at once. Its practitioners are trained to read the fragile moment when such a ripple will take hold.

rites.name: Elionora
rites.text: Elionora is a conduit-scribed arcane resonance in the Ryerlae omniverse, a concept-class phenomenon that tempers raw focus into disciplined bursts. Its wielders channel the flux through crystalline lattices, letting even a modest ritual reshape a city block's worth of stored strain.

rites.name: Ilyinys
rites.text: Ilyinys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryerlae universe, a discipline where a practitioner's decisive strike is amplified by gathering stored ember-light into the blow. Its adepts describe it as a patient art, one that rewards waiting for the perfect opening before striking.

rites.name: Eliolys
rites.text: Eliolys is a set of ancient war-forged weapons from the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, each heavier and more unwieldy than any ordinary blade, favored by roaming warriors of the high steppes. Their wielders channel a surging inner rage that lets each swing carry an enormous, world-cracking force.

rites.name: Venellys
rites.text: Venellys is a binding-glyph of the Ryerlae arcane arts, a concept that knits torn tissue back together through a slow, unbroken thread of mending light. Scholars of the E6 era recorded it as a regenerative discipline rather than a weapon, though its practitioners sometimes lent its surge to shielding wards.

rites.name: Elena
rites.text: Elena is a binding-rite woven from the dawn-tide of an arcane order in the realm of Ryerlae, where three-year-old concept-threads gather into a single charged name. She is said to unmake the small stains left by careless magic, drawing power from the quiet hours between sunset and midnight. Her devotees measure her by the number of luminous blossoms laid before her altar.

rites.name: Ilyinela
rites.text: In the cosmic expanse of the Omniverse, the Aethereal Nexus, Ilyinela, is a sentient cosmic entity that weaves the tapestry of reality, revealing glimpses of potential futures to those who seek it.

rites.name: Nuirlualys
rites.text: Nuirlualys is a concept of resolve in the Arcane realm of Ryerlae, an oath-bound discipline that hardens the will of those who refuse to flinch. Its bearers hold the line by advancing without hesitation, and their unbroken resolve is said to ring outward as a sustaining current for allies.

rites.name: Oriinala
rites.text: Oriinala is an invented concept in the Ryerlae omniverse, a principle of resonant binding that lets practitioners weave lingering tones into the minds and motions of others. Its sway is strongest over the crowded and the unguarded, and it is taught in the quiet schools of the third age.

rites.name: Venameth
rites.text: Venameth is a catalyst-class hex of the Ryerlae necromantic arts, binding a pale ember of grave-light to a foe's shadow so that every blow they land turns inward. It never burns flesh itself, yet the strain it grows is enough to split a fortress wall when a whole circle of bearers chant it together.

rites.name: Silineth
rites.text: Silineth is a radiant aura that wells up from a sworn champion's conviction, turning their body into a steady beacon of living light. Undead creatures that come near it are scorched and unmade, for the glow answers the unnatural summons laid down by the realm's hidden corruptors. Its warmth also steadies the wielder, lending them vitality and an unbending resolve.

rites.name: Grimairkak
rites.text: Grimairkak is a concept of the Arcane Realm in Era E7, personifying the branch where Ryerlae's ending forks into three futures and the Library shelves each outcome. It holds the sealed margins of unchosen endings, letting no single future erase the others. Its presence is felt as a pressure on what might still become.

rites.name: Valoleornor
rites.text: Valoleornor is a concept in Ryerlae's Arcane Realm, a notion of branching endings that the Library shelves beside every other outcome. During the Age of the first sovereign, it is named in the groves and growing kingdoms as the principle that lets a single choice fork into three futures.
